Yún Chū also sensed the tension. It seemed Marquis Xuānwǔ had some grievance with Xiè Jǐngyù. But Xiè Jǐngyù was merely a fifth-rank official; how could he have offended a noble of such high standing? There was no opportunity for interaction between them.

But this was none of her concern. She sat in her seat, a faint smile on her lips, exchanging pleasantries with the ladies beside her.

At this moment, the maids began serving the banquet dishes.

Each table had the same spread: four main dishes, four hot dishes, four cold dishes, and four plates of fruits and desserts. It looked quite lavish.

But Yún Chū noticed that each dish was only half-full, clearly, the servants had cut corners.

The men might not notice such details, but the noblewomen present were all experienced household managers. They exchanged glances, puzzled. How could the Xiè family, a fifth-rank official household, fail to host a proper banquet after so many years in office?

Old Madam Xiè began to regret her decision.

She should not have entrusted the banquet preparations to Xiè Pīn, an unmarried young lady.

Looking at the disdainful and contemptuous expressions of the ladies, it was as if the Xiè family were beneath notice.

Xiè Pīn did not dare to look at Old Madam, keeping her head bowed low, cursing Hè Xù in her heart once again.

"Everyone may not be aware," Yún Chū spoke up, "but the south has had no rain this spring, which may lead to a poor harvest in autumn. This could result in many refugees. The Xiè family did not dare to be extravagant with this banquet because hosting a grand celebration would only gain us face, but the silver spent on it could save dozens of lives if used for disaster relief. Between face and lives, I believe everyone here knows which weighs more."

"Excellent!" Qín Mínghéng was the first to applaud. "Madam Xiè’s concern for the nation and its people is truly admirable, it puts the rest of us to shame!"

Old Madam was truly impressed by her granddaughter-in-law. Just as the banquet was about to become a laughingstock, these words turned the Xiè family’s embarrassment into a virtuous deed.

Even Marquis Xuānwǔ had praised it, now, who would dare say the Xiè family’s banquet was unpresentable?

Sure enough, the disdain in the guests’ eyes faded, and they began to speak of the Xiè family’s great virtue, wishing Old Madam longevity and blessings.

Old Madam picked up her chopsticks: "We’ve chatted for so long, everyone must be hungry. Let’s eat."

She took a bite of the crispy fish and could not help but praise it in her heart. Truly, the Yún family’s private recipes were remarkable, even dead fish could be made so delicious.

Just as she was marveling, an inharmonious voice rose from below.

Qín Mínghéng took a bite of the meatball and immediately spat it out. "I only knew Minister Xiè was a director in the Ministry of Revenue. I didn’t realize the Xiè residence was also a salt merchant’s!"

The other guests began to murmur in agreement.

"This dish is far too salty, it’s inedible."

"How can it be this salty? I’ve drunk two cups of tea and still can’t wash down the taste. Are they trying to salt us to death?"

"The Xiè family’s cook has made such a blunder, clearly, the management of the inner household is lacking. The mistress is the eldest daughter of the Yún family, so how can she not manage a household properly?"

"Because Madam Xiè has been ill lately. Look at her complexion, she probably hasn’t fully recovered. How could she have the energy to oversee household matters? In the end, it’s that eldest Miss Xiè who lacks the talent for managing a household, she’s ruined this banquet."

"I’ve heard she’s actually a concubine’s daughter who’s just pretending to be the legitimate eldest. What would she know about managing a household?"

"Earlier, Madam Xiè even tried to smooth things over. Let’s see what she comes up with now that the food is ruined."

---

chapters.title: An Inauspicious Omen
chapters.content:
Old Madam Xiè personally tasted several dishes and found that every single one was inedibly salty.

If one dish was a little salty, it could be chalked up to a cook’s mistake. But nearly all of them were ruinously over-salted, this was clearly deliberate.

She was furious but had no idea how to explain it away.

Yuán Shì had never experienced such a scene and could only force a smile.

Xiè Pīn kept her head bowed as low as possible, trying to make herself invisible.

"I apologize to everyone on behalf of the Xiè family." Yún Chū stood up, her face filled with sincere regret. "For such a major oversight at the banquet, it is my failure in management. I will punish myself with three cups of wine."

She had just lifted her cup when Qín Mínghéng spoke: "Everyone in the capital knows Madam Xiè is still ill. This banquet was not arranged by her, so it’s not your place to punish yourself."

"I am the mistress of the Xiè household. Even if I did not arrange it myself, it is still my responsibility. I deserve the punishment." Yún Chū picked up the cup and was about to drink it all.

Qín Mínghéng’s brows knitted tightly, and he was about to stand up.

But before he could, Xiè Jǐngyù took the cup from Yún Chū’s hand and drank all three cups himself.

Qín Mínghéng’s expression darkened instantly, a faint, almost imperceptible smirk playing on his lips. "Minister Xiè and Madam Xiè truly have a deep bond, it’s enough to make one envious."

For some reason, Yún Chū detected a hint of mockery in his words.

Ignoring the discomfort, she said, "The Xiè family will arrange for someone to quickly order a proper feast from a restaurant. Please, everyone, wait a moment. For now, let us serve the longevity peaches and longevity noodles to bring good fortune."

Madam Yún, Lin Shi, nodded. "I will have my people assist as well."

The Yún family was the most prominent in the capital. With Madam Yún’s help, the guests knew the feast would be prepared swiftly, and the atmosphere eased considerably.

The servants brought out the longevity peaches, pastry peaches made of flour, each inscribed with a large "壽" (longevity) character. The largest one was placed before Old Madam Xiè, while the others were distributed to each table.

After a series of mishaps, Old Madam was already exhausted. She forced herself to perk up and cut into the peach.

But as soon as she did, she let out a scream and stumbled backward, falling off her chair and knocking over the longevity noodles.

The people below looked up in shock, and chaos erupted.

"Heavens! Why are there so many worms inside the longevity peach?"

"My goodness! Real peaches can have worms, but how can a flour pastry have so many disgusting things inside?"

"This is an inauspicious omen!"

Yún Chū’s eyes narrowed.

Last night, after the little one fell asleep, he had mumbled in his sleep about worms. Could it be that all these mishaps at the banquet today were his doing?

Hè Xù might be bold, but he would only dare to cut corners and embezzle a little silver. Dead fish, excessive salt, worms, this had to be the work of Chǔ Hóngyú.

That little one must have known she was unhappy in the Xiè household and was acting on her behalf to vent her frustration.

Seeing Old Madam so frightened that she collapsed, and the Xiè household in disarray, a weight lifted from her chest.

"Everyone, please remain calm." Xiè Jǐngyù stepped forward, trying to stay composed. "Green worms in green pines, green pines live a hundred years. This is an auspicious sign. We apologize for startling everyone. Since the feast has not yet arrived, why not have some tea first? This tea is a tribute from the Western Regions to the palace. You’ll know its quality once you taste it."

Apart from the Yún family and Marquis Xuānwǔ, the other guests were minor officials of the fifth to seventh ranks. None of them had ever tasted imperial tribute tea. Hearing Xiè Jǐngyù’s words, they had no choice but to suppress their thoughts of leaving and wait in their seats for tea.

This time, the tea had been personally overseen by Xiè Shì’ān at Xiè Jǐngyù’s orders. There had been no oversights from start to finish, so he dared to serve it to the guests.

As expected, the imperial tribute tea was of the highest quality. The previously shocked guests began to smile and chat amically.

Old Madam, surrounded by the Xiè womenfolk, was taken away to freshen up.

*Crash!*

A cup shattered on the ground.

Xiè Pīn’s knees buckled in fear. "Old Madam, it’s all my fault! I didn’t prepare the banquet properly. I’ve brought shame to the Xiè family. Just strike me dead!"

Old Madam raised her foot to kick Xiè Pīn, but Yuán Shì stopped her. "What’s done is done. Blaming Pīn now won’t change anything. Besides, Pīn is just a thirteen-year-old unmarried girl. It was wrong to entrust such a big task to her in the first place. I am the one at fault. If I had the talent to manage the household, how could I have let the Xiè family become the laughingstock of the capital?"

"Mother, now is not the time for self-blame." Yún Chū said calmly, "Week Mama, take a few people and detain Hè Xù."

"Yes, tie Hè Xù up first." Old Madam said hatefully. "He dared to sabotage the master’s banquet; he must think his life is too easy. After the banquet ends and the guests leave, I’ll see if I don’t flay him alive!"

Xiè Pīn trembled.

After the banquet, Old Madam would surely punish her as well. She did not know what awaited her.

Week Mama immediately took people to arrest Hè Xù.

Hè Xù had been living in the lap of luxury lately. First, Chén Défú had given him several shops to manage personally, and he had gained many followers. Then, most of the preparations for Old Madam’s banquet had been left to him. He had embezzled a great deal of silver from it. Earlier, while arranging the banquet, he had spent money on wine and pork head meat, eating and drinking with his subordinates at the back gate while gambling.

Just as he was in the middle of his fun, Week Mama’s people suddenly pinned him down.

"What are you doing? What are you doing?" Hè Xù struggled violently. Drunk as he was, his strength was considerable, and two servant women struggled to hold him.

Week Mama ordered someone to strike him with a club, then gagged him. Four servant women dragged him away together.

As they passed under the eaves, they encountered Hè Shì, who had come looking for Hè Xù.

Hè Shì’s mouth fell open in shock. "Week Mama, what’s going on? What has Manager Hè done?"

"It’s none of your concern, Hè Mama. Mind your own business." Week Mama said coldly. "Today is Old Madam’s birthday, and there are many distinguished guests in the residence. As a punished woman, you should not be wandering around... Madam has spared you from a day of confinement, do not waste her kindness."

With that, she led the struggling Hè Xù away.

Hè Shì was anxious. She quickly pulled a few people aside to ask questions and soon learned what had happened in the front courtyard. Her heart sank instantly.

Hè Xù’s arrest was his own doing.

But why should her Pīn’s reputation be ruined?

She suddenly realized, Madam had feigned illness and left the entire banquet preparation to a thirteen-year-old girl. Wasn’t this a deliberate attempt to ruin Pīn’s reputation?

Àn Gē had been punished by Madam to kneel in the ancestral hall.

Wéi Gē had been disciplined by Madam with family law.

Now, Pīn’s marriage prospects had been destroyed by Madam.

Madam’s schemes ran deep!

Once this banquet was over, Pīn’s life would be ruined.

She could not stand by and watch this happen.

With this thought, Hè Shì hurried toward the front courtyard. She had to find Xiè Jǐngyù to discuss a way to salvage the situation.

chapters.title: Xie Jingyu Goes Missing
chapters.content:
In the front courtyard banquet hall.

With imperial palace tea to accompany them, and with Lady Yun, Lin, mediating, and Lord Xuwu present, the guests were still in high spirits.

Xie Jingyu was discussing the current political situation with a few colleagues when his page boy hurried over and whispered, "Master, Mama He says there's an important matter to report."

Xie Jingyu frowned slightly, "Tell her to wait until later."

The page boy nodded and left, but returned shortly after, whispering, "Master, Mama He says it must be now. If it's inconvenient for you to leave, she can come in to report."

Xie Jingyu looked up.

He saw He standing at the entrance of the banquet hall, ready to come in at any moment.

His expression darkened as he stood up and walked over, his voice cold, "What is so urgent?"

He lowered her head, "Master, everyone knows that the birthday banquet was arranged by the eldest young lady of the Xie family. But such a big mistake has occurred. If the reputation of the Xie family's eldest young lady being bad at managing the household spreads, which family would be willing to propose marriage to our Jiao'er as the mistress of their household in the future? You must think of a solution."

Xie Jingyu's expression was very ugly.

Right now, the Xie family's face was completely lost. He had to consider the Xie family first before he could think about his children's marriage.

Moreover, Jiao'er was only thirteen years old. Marriage was still two years away. It was too early to talk about this now.

Seeing that Xie Jingyu was silent, He urged anxiously, "While the birthday banquet hasn't ended yet, why not have Jiao'er make tea for everyone or display some talents to reverse some negative impressions..."

Xie Jingyu didn't know what to say.

If this were a palace banquet, it would be reasonable for a noble miss to dance or play music for the empress and concubines.

But most of the people present were officials of lower rank than the Xie family. If Jiao'er were to perform on the spot, it would truly be a disgrace to the Xie family.

"Enough, I'll handle this matter." Xie Jingyu said coldly, "You do what you need to do. Don't come to the front courtyard to loiter."

He had been with her for more than ten years. How could she not see what he was thinking? She tightened her fingers, "Master, Jiao'er is our first child. She will also be the first child in the Xie family to be betrothed. If there is any mistake in her marriage, it will be difficult for the other children later."

Xie Jingyu's voice grew colder, "What, are you threatening me?"

He quickly said, "I didn't mean that, I..."

As they were speaking, someone suddenly passed by the flower bushes beside them.

Xie Jingyu pulled He to the side.

Soon after, the servants brought back the dishes prepared by the restaurant and served them to everyone.

These were delicacies made by the best chefs from the most famous restaurant in the capital. Normally, one would have to queue for at least half a month to taste them. Now, everyone was delighted to have such a feast.

Old Madam Xie finally let out a sigh of relief. She raised her wine cup to Lady Yun, Lin, in gratitude. She knew that if it weren't for the Yun family's mediation, the Drunken Immortal Restaurant wouldn't have prepared the meal for the Xie family in time.

"Where is Jingyu?" Old Madam Xie looked at the empty seat at the lower end of the table. "Chu'er, do you know where Jingyu has gone?"

Yun Chu smiled, "Just now, Mama He said there was an important matter to report, so my husband went out. He should be back soon."

Old Madam Xie suddenly had a very bad premonition in her heart.

She looked at Zhou Mama beside her, "Go, find Jingyu and tell him to come and attend to the guests quickly."

Zhou Mama took the order and left.

About a quarter of an hour later, Zhou Mama returned, lowering her voice, "This servant has looked around but couldn't find the master. I don't know where he went."

Old Madam Xie took a deep breath.

That He was a troublemaker. On such an important occasion, she actually called Jingyu away. What could be more important than the birthday banquet?

If she had known, she shouldn't have agreed to Chu'er's request to pardon some of the erring servants... But it was too late for regrets now. The old lady said, "Continue searching."

Yun Chu lowered her head and took a sip of tea, hiding the coldness in her eyes.

"Madam Xie."

A deep voice sounded beside her.

Yun Chu put down her tea cup and looked up with a standard hostess smile, "Lord Hou, do you have any instructions?"

Her smile, though not reaching her eyes, was as bright as spring flowers, causing Qin Mingheng to be momentarily distracted.

He took a sip of wine before regaining his composure, "I heard that Madam Xie reburied two of her deceased children. I once stayed in a temple for a while and heard the master say that the deceased who are reburied need to have monks chant sutras for forty-nine days to ensure peace in the next life. I know a few masters. Would Madam Xie like me to arrange this?"

Yun Chu's smile became a bit more genuine.

Apart from the Yun family, this was the first person to show concern for her deceased children.

She smiled, "My brother has already arranged these matters. Thank you for your concern, Lord Hou."

"That child also had the blood of the Xie family. As the biological father, Master Xie doesn't seem to care about his own children at all. How can someone who doesn't care about his own bloodline care about his pillow partner?" Qin Mingheng's voice lowered a few degrees. "Madam Xie, have you not thought about your own future?"

Yun Chu looked up, meeting Qin Mingheng's dark eyes.

To her surprise, she saw a genuine concern in those eyes.

Could it be that Lord Xuwu was truly considering her future?

But this was the first time she had spoken face-to-face with Lord Xuwu. There was no acquaintance between them; they were almost strangers.

How could this man...

"Madam Xie pours her heart out for the children of the Xie family. Will these children truly be filial to Madam Xie?" Qin Mingheng took a sip of wine. "Some things should be cut off when they need to be."

Yun Chu tightened her lips.

Even an outsider could see through this, yet she had to learn it with a lifetime of tragic lessons.

She understood Lord Xuwu's implication. He wanted her to divorce.

She would never divorce in this lifetime because a divorced woman returning to her maiden family would affect the fortune of her sisters.

She didn't care about herself, but she would never let the Yun family suffer because of her again.

She could be a widow, but why divorce?

Yun Chu said, "Thank you for your concern, Lord Hou. This wife and her husband are deeply in love. I don't understand what you mean by 'cutting off when it needs to be cut.'"

Qin Mingheng's expression instantly darkened.

What a deep love.

Xie Jingyu had done such things, yet she was still so devoted.

She was the brilliant eldest miss of the Yun family, the most beautiful woman in the capital, and she was being ruined in the Xie family...

"Old Madam, I have something else to attend to, so I will take my leave now."

Without waiting for Old Madam Xie to respond, Qin Mingheng stood up and left directly.

His presence at the banquet was already a fortune for the Xie family. Leaving early was also reasonable, and no one found it strange.

Yun Chu, however, vaguely felt that Lord Xuwu seemed to have been angered by her words and left in a huff.

The banquet ended, but Xie Jingyu still didn't appear. Old Madam Xie's expression grew darker and darker.

Yet, the old lady still managed to put on a smile to entertain the guests, "The Xie family has invited a troupe. Ladies, please go to the back courtyard. Let's select some plays first."

Most of the male guests left after the banquet, while the ladies followed to the back courtyard to watch the plays.

Yun Chu led everyone there. The courtyard was arranged with tea and refreshments, and everything was ready. The ladies quietly began to watch the plays.

After a few acts, it became a bit boring. One of the ladies suggested taking a stroll in the garden.

---

chapters.title: Scandal in the Back Courtyard
chapters.content:
The Xie residence was not very large; it only had a small garden.

Yun Chu and her mother-in-law, Lady Yuan, led a large group of ladies on a tour of the garden, but everyone seemed uninterested.

One lady hesitated, "I heard that Madam Xie planted many date trees in the residence. Do you know if the date trees have bloomed this season?"

Yun Chu smiled, "Date flowers usually bloom in May at the earliest."

"It doesn't matter if they haven't bloomed. Let us go and see this curiosity." Madam Hu spoke up in support. "Date trees symbolize abundant descendants in feng shui. Let us all go and get some good fortune."

The other ladies, whose statuses were not as high as Miss Yun, naturally followed suit.

Lady Yuan said, "The date trees are planted near the wall in the southeast corner of the residence. If you ladies do not mind the unremarkable date trees, then let us go this way."

The group followed towards the southeast corner.

This area used to be a garden where seasonal flowers were planted. Every spring and autumn, flower-viewing banquets were held here. This year, all the flowers were replaced with date trees.

These were mature date trees purchased and transplanted from the outskirts of the capital. Each tree was taller than the courtyard walls, with lush branches and leaves.

Madam Hu said, "It looks like they will bear fruit this year. At that time, I will come to Madam Xie to ask for some fresh dates to try."

Yun Chu politely replied, "When the fruits are ready, the Xie family will arrange for someone to deliver them to each residence. Please do not mind if the green dates are a bit astringent."

"Hmm, why do I feel like I heard something?" A lady with sensitive hearing spoke up. "From that direction."

Lady Yuan looked over, "That is an uninhabited small courtyard in the Xie residence. Usually, only maids go there to clean."

As soon as her words fell, a gust of wind blew, carrying the sound from the small courtyard. That sound was simply unbearable to hear...

The expressions of all the ladies changed simultaneously.

Among them was Madam Yuan, whose husband was a political enemy of Xie Jingyu. Both were fifth-rank officials, eyeing the same position.

Although the Xie family had no advantages now, what if something changed?

She spoke up, "That sound is very strange. Let's go and see what it is."

She took the lead and walked towards that direction.

Yun Chu smiled.

She had specifically reminded Xie Jiao to add Madam Yuan to the guest list. Madam Yuan had indeed not let her down.

Lady Yuan, a woman in her forties or fifties, how could she not recognize that sound? Seeing Madam Yuan leading everyone in that direction, she was quite frightened.

Yun Chu gently pulled her mother-in-law's hand and lowered her voice, "The servants of the Xie family are not so bold as to do such a thing in broad daylight. If we do not let these ladies investigate, who knows how they will gossip about our Xie family in the future? Let them go and see."

This made sense. Moreover, today was Old Madam's birthday banquet. All the servants were busy with the banquet, so it was impossible for anyone to have time to engage in such improper activities here.

Originally, there was nothing to hide. If she tried to cover it up, people might accuse the Xie family's inner courtyard of being lewd and disorderly.

Thinking of this, Lady Yuan felt much more at ease. The key was that Yun Chu looked calm, which gave her a sense of security. She smiled, "It must be wild cats making noise."

The group of more than ten people took a few steps and arrived at the uninhabited small courtyard.

Once inside, the sound became even more obvious, causing some of the newly married young ladies to blush.

"I've never heard wild cats in heat before." Madam Yuan quickly walked up the steps and pushed open the door in front of her. "Let's see what kind of wild cats they are."

The door opened, and everyone clearly saw a man and a woman on the couch inside, their clothes half-removed, embracing each other.

When they saw the faces of the man and woman, Lady Yuan stood frozen on the spot, her mind thunderstruck, as if she might faint at any moment.

Some of the younger, more bashful ladies retreated repeatedly.

Ladies like Madam Yuan, who were in their thirties and had seen many things, immediately started talking loudly.

"How could it be Master Xie!"

"What is Master Xie doing with a maid in this courtyard on Old Madam Xie's birthday?"

"We didn't see Master Xie during the banquet. So, he was here with a servant, entangled in an improper affair. If we had come a little later..."

Many ladies looked at Xie Jingyu with disdain and at Yun Chu with sympathy.

Yun Chu seemed unable to believe it, standing stupidly in place with no reaction until Lady Yuan pulled her.

Lady Yuan's voice trembled, "Chu, Chu'er, what should we do? What can we do..."

Yun Chu seemed to finally regain her senses. She quickly walked up the steps, bent down to pick up the clothes on the ground, and draped them over Xie Jingyu and He.

She blocked the two of them and looked at the crowd, "Ladies, you have misunderstood. This is not a maid from our Xie family. She is Concubine He. She is very good at singing. Just now, I asked her to go to the front courtyard to sing and perform for the guests. But she is not feeling well, so my husband must have brought her here to rest..."

Lady Yuan's trembling heart finally steadied.

Being intimate with a concubine was better than having an affair with a maid.

Once again, she admired her daughter-in-law. Even in such a chaotic situation, she could think of a way to resolve it. The Xie family truly could not do without Yun Chu.

But this explanation made the ladies present even more sympathetic towards Yun Chu.

For a husband to be intimate with a concubine during a banquet, hiding here and entangling, was a complete disregard for the mistress of the household.

They had long heard that Madam Xie could not have children. Now, she didn't even have her husband's respect. One could imagine how difficult her life was.

Even though Madam Xie was heartbroken, she still had to step forward to protect her husband and the Xie family's reputation. The beloved pearl of the Yun family had fallen to such a state...

"Madam Xie must have many things to handle. We will take our leave now."

"Madam Xie, please attend to your matters. We will meet again another time."

The group of ladies, showing great tact, took their leave one after another.

When they reached the front courtyard, the ladies who were still watching the plays did not understand what had happened. They exchanged glances and everyone suggested leaving.

Once outside the Xie residence, the crowd finally dared to speak up.

"You who were watching the plays in the front don't know, do you? We caught Master Xie and a concubine doing that in the back courtyard."

"In broad daylight, how could they hide and do such a thing? Are they so impatient?"

"That concubine must be extremely beautiful. Otherwise, Master Xie wouldn't be so confused."

"Now that you mention it, I remember. That concubine looked a bit older, and her appearance was not outstanding. She is far inferior to Madam Xie."

"So, Master Xie likes older women..."

The news of what happened in the back courtyard reached Old Madam Xie's ears. She was so angry that her ears roared, and she almost fainted on the spot.

Lady Yun, Lin, had a face as dark as water, as if she might explode at any moment.

She only knew about Concubines Yu, Jiang, and Tao in the Xie residence. When did a Concubine He appear?

Xie Jingyu actually had an affair with a maid in the back courtyard on the day of the birthday banquet and even had his beloved daughter help cover it up.

What kind of humiliation had her daughter endured!

"Mother will go home first." Yun Chu personally saw the Yun family out. "Elder sister-in-law, please advise my mother well. I am fine."

Chu Qianqian's eyes were filled with concern.

The men of the Yun family also took concubines, but it required the approval of the wife. They would never have an affair before that. This was a complete disregard for the wife.

Today, with the Yun family present, Xie Jingyu dared to do such a thing. Who knew how much he usually disrespected Yun Chu...

chapters.title: Who Would Scheme Against You
chapters.content:
The guests had all dispersed.

In the vast courtyard, only the Xie family remained.

Though Elder Madam Xie was advanced in age, she was usually in good health and rarely fell ill. Yet now, she was slumped weakly in her reclining chair.

"Bastard! Vile creature!"

The elder madam glared at the two people kneeling before her, picked up a teacup, and hurled it down.

The shards of porcelain slashed Xie Jingyu’s cheek, and he seemed to awaken from his stupor, the memories before his confusion suddenly flooding back.

He clenched his fists tightly. "Grandmother, I was set up."

He Shi also gradually regained consciousness. She only remembered that Xie Jingyu had pulled her to a small courtyard near the rockery to talk, and the two of them had ended up arguing.

Not wanting to quarrel with Xie Jingyu, she had poured a cup of tea from the pot on the table and handed it to him.

They sat facing each other, drinking tea, and then... then they remembered nothing else... only vague recollections of them seemingly caught in a passionate moment, surrounded by the guests at the birthday banquet...

She also remembered being called "Concubine He."

"Set up?" The elder madam sat up straight. "Who would set you up?"

"That must be Concubine He, of course." Concubine Tao, supporting her large belly, spoke coldly. "Everyone knows that Concubine He harbors improper feelings for the master. To drug the master at such an occasion, isn’t she just trying to force the issue, to cook the raw rice into cooked rice, to become the mistress by climbing the branch?"

He Shi immediately retorted, "It wasn’t me. I didn’t scheme against the master, nor have I ever thought of becoming a concubine..."

"If it wasn’t you, then who else could it be?" The elder madam’s eyes seemed to spit fire. Although she knew He Shi had no intention of becoming a concubine, the Xie family had suffered such humiliation because of her restlessness. If she had stayed obediently in the small temple, would there have been so much trouble?

Xie Jingyu pressed his lips tightly together. After a long silence, he said, "It was the Yuan family."

He and Lord Yuan were both fifth-rank officials in the Ministry of Revenue. Lord Yuan had held this position for over a decade and was nearing forty this year, yet had never had a chance for promotion.

This time, there was an opportunity to become a higher fifth-rank official. Originally, it was almost certainly his, Xie Jingyu. But for some reason, Minister Yu had suddenly taken a dislike to him. Coupled with the recent rumors about the Xie and Yun families spreading throughout the capital, the position had suddenly become open to many possibilities.

If the news of his improper relations with a maidservant in the inner quarters spread to the imperial court, he feared he would not be promoted for the next five or six years.

Lord Yuan must have wanted to take this opportunity to push him down, making him lose his chance completely.

He Shi tightened her lips.

She always felt that the Yuan family’s reach wasn’t this long. She felt it was someone from the Xie residence who had schemed against her.

Among those with the ability to do such a thing were the several concubines and the madam. But none of them would want another woman by the master’s side, so they had no motive to scheme against her.

After much thought, she still couldn’t figure out who had framed her.

"Now, investigating who set this up is meaningless. We should find a way to minimize the damage." Yun Chu spoke slowly. "A court official and a maidservant from the residence engaging in improper relations at the elder madam’s birthday banquet, if this reaches the ears of the Censor, not only will my husband find it difficult to be promoted, but he might even be demoted and stripped of his power... It was because I considered this that I addressed He Mama as Concubine He in front of those madams. To avoid giving people a handle, we must now enter Concubine He’s name into the Xie family registry..."

Yuan Shi let out a long sigh of relief. "Chu’er, you are indeed thorough in your thinking."

"No, I don’t want to be a concubine." He Shi’s face paled. "Madam, I never wanted to be a concubine."

Concubine Tao spoke in a panic, "He Shi once harmed the child in my womb. If she becomes a concubine, my child will be in danger."

Xie Jingyu spoke, "He Shi cannot be a concubine."

Concubine Tao, Concubine Jiang, and Tingyu all showed relieved expressions.

They had known all along that He Shi was old and no longer attractive. The master would never look at her, and even if she offered herself, she would not receive the slightest pity from him.

Yun Chu became even more certain in her heart that He Shi’s identity must have some hidden background.

The more she refused to be a concubine, the more Yun Chu had to elevate her to that position. Otherwise, why would she have orchestrated this entire play?

She spoke, "Then does my husband have a better idea?"

Xie Jingyu pressed his lips tightly together.

He couldn’t think of a second solution.

"I do have another idea." Yun Chu paused. "Have He Mama drink a cup of poison to end her life. Then this matter will naturally pass."

He Shi collapsed weakly to the ground.

Xie Jingyu’s lips pressed into a tight line, falling into deep conflict.

Elder Madam Xie spoke sternly, "Concubine or poison, choose."

Yuan Shi truly did not understand. "He Shi, you admire Jingyu, yet you refuse to become his concubine. Is becoming a concubine such a painful thing?"

He Shi trembled all over, tears welling in her eyes as she looked at Xie Jingyu pleadingly.

Xie Jingyu closed his eyes and said softly, "Then let Concubine He be entered into the Xie family genealogy."

In this dynasty, even concubines could be entered into the family genealogy, all thanks to a lady who had defended the nation centuries ago, greatly elevating the status of women.

Yun Chu stepped forward and helped He Shi up. "Concubine He, from now on, we will serve the master together as one family. What is your given name?"

He Shi, still in a state of fear and unease, instinctively replied, "He Lingyuan."

Yun Chu smiled faintly. "Father-in-law is usually busy, so we won’t trouble him to come back specially. Husband, why are you still kneeling? Let’s go to the ancestral hall first, retrieve the genealogy, and enter Concubine He’s name."

Xie Jingyu struggled to get up from the ground.

His body was unsteady, and he could barely stand.

Yun Chu moved aside, mainly to avoid Xie Jingyu collapsing onto her. She didn’t want to have to take extra baths that night.

She turned around and led the way out.

Watching her figure, Concubine Tao sighed. Why couldn’t she be as composed as the madam? Just the thought of the master having another woman by his side made her heart feel like it was being pricked by needles. The only consolation was that she was with child, which gave her some support. As for He Shi, being so old, it was unlikely she could conceive. Over time, the master would probably forget all about her...

Yun Chu and Xie Jingyu, accompanied by He Shi, left the courtyard.

As soon as they were gone, the elder madam ordered sharply, "Bring that He manager over here!"

Week Mama had already brought He Xu and had him waiting nearby. Now that the masters’ matters were settled, it was He Xu’s turn.

Week Mama pressed He Xu to his knees and presented a large bundle. "Elder Madam, this was found in He Xu’s room."

The elder madam took a look and saw that it contained hundreds of taels of gleaming silver.

"You have quite the nerve!" The elder madam furiously kicked him.

He Xu had originally entered the Xie residence with He Shi, claiming to be her cousin from the same clan, so he had been shown some favor.

Because of this connection, in just four or five years, He Xu had become a high-ranking steward in the outer courtyard. The Xie family had treated these siblings with great kindness, yet they had both dug a pit for the Xie family, one had brought great shame upon them, and the other had embezzled their silver!

Week Mama continued, "Just now, this servant went to several shops to investigate and found that the shops under He Manager’s supervision have been operating at a loss for the past half month."

Those shops were located on the main street and couldn’t possibly be operating at a loss. It was obvious that He Xu had embezzled the money.

"Give him twenty strokes of the board, then throw him out!" The elder madam’s head was about to explode. "He is never to set foot in the Xie residence again!"

He Xu, with his mouth gagged, tried to explain, but was held down by four sturdy maids. After twenty strokes of the board, the grown man fainted from the pain. He was then thrown at the entrance of a dilapidated temple in the outskirts of the capital, where beggars gathered.

---

chapters.title: What Should I Do
chapters.content:
As the head of the Xie family, it was most appropriate for Xie Jingyu to open the ancestral hall and retrieve the genealogy.

The entire process was very simple: write He Shi’s name in the genealogy, then offer incense and kowtow. From then on, He Shi was officially a member of the Xie family.

Yun Chu smiled. "Concubine He shall reside in Bihe Garden."

He Shi was somewhat surprised.

Bihe Garden was located next to the Xie residence’s garden, a courtyard with an excellent location, usually used to receive distinguished guests. She hadn’t expected the madam to let her stay there.

Xie Jingyu’s expression was extremely complicated.

He thought back to four years ago, when she was pregnant. He and Tingyu had climbed into the same bed. He still remembered her expression that morning.

Lost, heartbroken, pained, incredulous... At that time, he had clearly felt that Yun Chu cared deeply for him.

But now, from beginning to end, her face carried a faint smile. He couldn’t see her disappointment in him, nor her hostility toward He Shi...

It was as if she didn’t care about him at all.

A confusing emotion surged in Xie Jingyu’s chest.

"Presumably, my husband and Concubine He still have words to exchange. I’ll go attend to other matters."

Yun Chu curtsied and turned to leave the ancestral hall.

After her figure disappeared from the doorway, He Shi opened her mouth to speak, but was met with a loud slap from Xie Jingyu.

The sound of the slap echoed, and He Shi was completely stunned.

She covered her face and hastily said, "It wasn’t me, truly not me. I know my place. How could I dare to harbor delusions of becoming a member of the Xie family..."

"I know it wasn’t you, but if it weren’t for you, my reputation wouldn’t be in the gutter." Xie Jingyu could well imagine the looks the others would give him when he attended court tomorrow. He took a deep breath. "It was you who gave the Yuan family the opportunity to scheme against me. It was you who obstructed my official career..."

Tears streamed down He Shi’s face.

She truly couldn’t believe that she had been slapped by the man she loved most. Her heart ached terribly.

But she knew that if this matter wasn’t clarified, the day she became a concubine would be the day their relationship shattered.

"Master, are you certain it was the Yuan family?" He Shi choked out. "Why haven’t you considered that it was Madam who orchestrated all of this? As the mistress of the household, she has complete control over the entire Xie residence. It would be all too easy for her to do this. Otherwise, how can you explain why Madam lifted my confinement, and why she suddenly brought so many people to that small courtyard?"

A cold smile appeared on Xie Jingyu’s face. "So you’re saying that Yun Chu went through all this trouble just to make you a concubine?"

No woman, no matter how little she cared for her husband, would scheme to have her husband and another woman engage in improper relations in public.

"You, accepted by Yun Chu with such generosity, yet you question her so much." Xie Jingyu waved his hand. "If you cause any more trouble, the Xie family will not tolerate you."

With that, he turned and left.

He Shi collapsed weakly to the ground, covering her face as she sobbed.

Yun Chu slowly walked back to her own courtyard. As soon as she stepped in, someone thudded to their knees in front of her.

It was Xie Pin.

Her face was filled with panic as she grabbed the hem of Yun Chu’s skirt. "Mother, what should I do? My reputation is ruined. What should I do..."

She had ruined the Xie family banquet. Whenever outsiders mentioned the Xie family’s banquet, they would certainly think of her, the eldest daughter of the Xie family. Which family would dare to marry her as their mistress now?

She had once even considered becoming the princess consort of the Fourth Prince. Now, all hope was shattered.

"Mother, please help me..."

Xie Pin cried until she was out of breath.

Yun Chu helped her up. "Sister Pin, didn’t I tell you? You’re still young. It’s fine to make mistakes as long as you correct them."

Xie Pin sobbed, "Mother, teach me, how do I correct this?"

"The latest would be at Grandmother’s birthday banquet next year to make a spectacular comeback. That would require a year’s time." Yun Chu smiled at her. "Think carefully. What banquets will the Xie family be hosting soon?"

Xie Pin stopped crying and thought hard.

As long as the elder madam was alive, the grandfather and grandmother couldn’t host birthday banquets. A flower-viewing banquet was also out of the question. What about a tea party?

But with the Xie family’s current status, and after such a scandal, no one would come to a tea party.

"Brother An is about to take the county examination." Yun Chu said. "If he can become a xiucai, won’t the Xie family have a reason to host a banquet?"

Xie Pin’s expression was hesitant. Generally, a banquet was held only if one became a juren. Hosting one for a xiucai would be laughed at, wouldn’t it?

"Xiucai may be common, but being the top candidate is not." Yun Chu smiled. "If any family in the capital has a child who becomes the top candidate in the county examination, wouldn’t they host a grand banquet for guests?"

Xie Pin’s eyes widened. "Mother, I understand."

For the sake of the Xie family’s reputation, for her own reputation, Xie Shian must become the top candidate in the county examination. There was no other choice.

Yun Chu thought back to her previous life. When Xie Shian had become the top candidate, Xie Jingyu had just been promoted to a higher fifth-rank official. At the banquet, father and son had toasted the guests, exuding an air of vigor and spirit.

After a day of exhaustion, it was now completely dark.

Once she had some free time, Yun Chu’s mind once again drifted to the child.

She hurried back to her inner chamber. On the table by the window sat an ugly wooden carving. Holding it in her hand, her heart finally settled somewhat.

That night, Yun Chu slept soundly.

The next morning was clear and sunny. Spring was gradually fading, and the first hints of early summer were in the air.

Xie Shian was the first to come pay his respects. His expression was as usual, as if yesterday’s events had not affected him at all.

After paying his respects, he went to the school to study. Following that, the concubines, accompanied by the younger children, came together.

This was the first time He Shi had paid her respects as an official concubine of Xie Jingyu.

"Concubine He looks in good spirits." Concubine Tao, seated in her place, deliberately picked a quarrel. "It seems Bihe Garden has good feng shui."

Tingyu felt a pang of jealousy. Back then, the madam had arranged a courtyard for her that didn’t even have a proper name. Why could Concubine He live in Bihe Garden while she and Yun Ge had to live in the most remote part of the residence?

Despite her thoughts, she kept a smile on her face. "It seems the master is quite fond of Concubine He."

No matter what the other concubines said, He Shi remained silent, standing properly with her head lowered.

Yun Chu spoke, "It just so happens that the residence is preparing to make summer clothes. Later, I’ll have two maids go measure Concubine He’s size and make four sets for each season."

He Shi looked up and saw the other concubines’ hostile gazes. She didn’t dare to accept, quickly refusing.

Yun Chu, however, said, "You are also a half-mistress of the Xie residence. Dressing so shabbily would only bring shame to the master. Take what is rightfully yours. Pushing back and forth is too petty."

He Shi had no choice but to say, "Thank you, Madam."

After the conversation was over, Yun Chu waved her hand, dismissing them.

As they left, Tingyu looked around but saw no trace of the child. She guessed that Yun Ge must have been mistaken.

Tingfeng stood to the side, indignant. "Madam, that He Shi deliberately seduced the master. Why are you still so kind to her?"

"From now on, do not address her as He Shi. She is now Concubine He." Tingshuang said, "Madam has her own plans. You’re just a maid; don’t pry too much. Go to the front courtyard and see if Manager Chen has arrived."

Of course, she knew why the madam was so kind to Concubine He. The higher the madam elevated Concubine He, the harder her life in the residence would become...

chapters.content:

The process was very simple. He wrote He Shi’s name in the genealogy, then offered incense and kowtowed. From then on, He Shi officially became a member of the Xie family.

Yun Chu smiled. "Aunt He shall reside in Bihe Garden."

He Shi was somewhat surprised.

Bihe Garden was located next to the Xie residence’s garden, a courtyard with an exceptionally good location, usually reserved for distinguished guests. She never expected the madam to allow her to live there.

Xie Jingyu’s expression was extremely complicated.

He recalled the New Year’s Eve before, when she was pregnant. He and Tingyu had shared a bed. He still remembered her expression that morning—

Lost, heartbroken, pained, disbelief… At that time, he had clearly felt that Yun Chu cared deeply for him.

But now, from beginning to end, her face carried only a faint smile. He could not see her disappointment in him, nor could he see her hostility toward He Shi…

"I suppose my husband and Aunt He still have more to discuss. I’ll go attend to other matters."

Yun Chu curtsied slightly, then turned and walked out of the ancestral hall.

After her figure disappeared from the doorway, He Shi opened her mouth to speak, but instead received a loud slap from Xie Jingyu.

*Slap!* He Shi was completely stunned.

She covered her face and hastily said, "It wasn’t me, truly not me. I know my place. How would I dare to presumptuously dream of becoming a member of the Xie family…"

"I know it wasn’t you," Xie Jingyu said. "But if it weren’t for you, my reputation wouldn’t be in ruins." He could well imagine the looks the others would give him when he attended court tomorrow. He took a deep breath. "It was you who gave the Yuan family the opportunity to scheme against me. It was you who obstructed my official career…"

Tears streamed down He Shi’s face.

She truly could not believe that she had been slapped by the man she loved most. Her heart ached terribly.

But she knew that if this matter was not clarified, the day she became a concubine would be the day her relationship with him shattered.

"Master," He Shi choked out, "are you certain it was really the Yuan family? Why haven’t you considered that it might have been Madam who orchestrated all of this? As the mistress of the household, she controls the entire Xie family. It would be all too easy for her to do such a thing. Otherwise, how can you explain why Madam lifted my house arrest, or why she suddenly brought so many people to that small courtyard?"

A cold smile appeared on Xie Jingyu’s face. "So you’re saying that Yun Chu went through all this trouble just to make you a concubine?"

No woman, even if she no longer cared for her husband, would scheme to have her husband and another woman caught in a compromising position in broad daylight.

"Yun Chu has magnanimously accepted you, yet you doubt her so much." Xie Jingyu flicked his sleeve. "If you cause any more trouble in the future, the Xie family will not tolerate you."

With that, he turned and left.

He Shi collapsed to the ground, covering her face as she sobbed.

---

Yun Chu slowly returned to her own courtyard. As soon as she stepped inside, someone *thudded* to their knees in front of her.

It was Xie Pin.

Her face was filled with panic as she grabbed the hem of Yun Chu’s skirt. "Mother, what should I do? My reputation is completely ruined. What should I do…?"

She had messed up the Xie family banquet. Whenever outsiders mentioned the Xie family’s banquet, they would surely remember her, the eldest daughter of the Xie family. Which family would still dare to take her as their mistress?

She had once even thought of becoming the princess consort of the Western Prince. Now, all her hopes were shattered.

"Mother, please help me…" Xie Pin sobbed, gasping for breath.

Yun Chu helped her up. "Sister Pin, didn’t I tell you before? You’re still young. Making a mistake is fine as long as you correct it properly."

Xie Pin wailed, "Mother, teach me, how do I correct it?"

"The latest would be at Grandmother’s birthday banquet next year. You’ll have a full year to turn things around with a brilliant performance." Yun Chu smiled at her. "Think carefully, what banquets will the Xie family be hosting soon?"

Xie Pin stopped crying and thought hard.

Grandmother was still alive, so Grandfather and Grandmother couldn’t hold birthday banquets. A flower-viewing banquet was also out of the question. A tea party?

But the Xie family was of such low status, and after such a scandal, no one would come to a tea party.

"Brother An’s institute examination is coming up soon." Yun Chu spoke. "If he can pass as a *xiucai*, won’t the Xie family have a reason to host a banquet?"

Xie Pin’s expression hesitated. Normally, a banquet was only held if someone passed as a *juren*. Holding a banquet for a *xiucai* would invite ridicule, wouldn’t it?

"Though *xiucai* are common, a *anjou* (top scholar in the examination) is not." Yun Chu smiled. "If any family’s child becomes the top scholar in the institute examination in the capital, who wouldn’t host a grand banquet for guests?"

Xie Pin’s eyes widened. "Mother, I understand."

For the sake of the Xie family’s reputation, for the sake of her own reputation, Xie Shian *had* to become the top scholar in the institute examination. There was no other choice.

Yun Chu recalled her past life, when Xie Shian had become the top scholar, Xie Jingyu had just been promoted to a fifth-rank official. Father and son had toasted the guests at the banquet, exuding an air of vigor and ambition.

After a long day, the sky had already darkened completely.

Once she had free time, Yun Chu’s mind once again drifted to the child’s figure.

She hurried back to her inner chamber. On the table by the window sat a very ugly wooden carving. Only when she held the carving in her hands did her heart settle somewhat.

That night, Yun Chu slept soundly.

---

The next morning, the sky was clear. Spring was gradually fading, and the first hints of early summer were in the air.

Xie Shian was the first to come pay his respects. His expression was as usual, and yesterday’s events seemed to have had no effect on him.

After paying his respects, he went to the schoolhouse to study. Soon after, the concubines arrived with the younger children to pay their respects as well.

This was He Shi’s first time paying respects as an official concubine of Xie Jingyu.

"Concubine He looks in good spirits." Concubine Tao, seated in her place, clearly picking a fight, said, "It seems the feng shui of Bihe Garden is quite good."

Tingyu’s heart was filled with bitterness. Back then, the mistress had assigned her a courtyard that didn’t even have a proper name. Why was Concubine He allowed to live in Bihe Garden while she and Yun Ge were stuck in the most remote corner of the entire residence?

Despite her thoughts, she kept a smile on her face. "It seems Master is quite fond of Concubine He."

No matter what the other concubines said, He Shi remained silent, lowering her head and standing properly to the side.

Yun Chu spoke. "It just so happens that the residence is preparing summer garments. Later, I’ll have two matrons go measure Concubine He’s size. We’ll make her four sets of clothes for each season."

He Shi could see the other three concubines’ hostile gazes if she lifted her head. How could she dare to accept? She quickly refused.

But Yun Chu said, "You are also half a mistress of the Xie residence. Dressing so shabbily would only bring shame to Master. Take what is rightfully yours. Pushing it away would be too petty."

He Shi had no choice but to say, "Thank you, Madam."

After the conversation was over, Yun Chu waved her hand, dismissing them.

As they left, Tingyu looked around but saw no trace of the child’s existence. She guessed that Yun Ge must have been mistaken.

Tingfeng stood to the side, indignant. "Madam, that He Shi deliberately seduced Master. Why are you still so kind to her?"

"From now on, do not call her He Shi. She is now Concubine He." Tingshuang said, "Madam has her own plans. You’re just a maid; don’t pry into matters that don’t concern you. Go to the front courtyard and see if Manager Chen has arrived."

Of course, she knew why Madam was being so kind to Concubine He. The higher Madam elevated Concubine He, the harder her life in the residence would become…

chapters.title: The Marquis Picks Up a Handkerchief
chapters.content:
Tingshuang relayed the gossip she had heard outside to Yun Chu.

"News of the Xie family’s affairs spread across the capital last night. They say that Minister Xie of the Ministry of Revenue is lecherous, during Grandmother’s birthday banquet, he and a concubine engaged in daytime debauchery… They also say the concubine is old and ugly, and that Minister Xie has a unique and unusual taste… In short, everyone in the capital is discussing the Xie family. Master’s reputation is completely ruined. Of course, the eldest daughter’s reputation for poor household management is also well-known…"

Yun Chu asked, "What was the Old Madam’s reaction?"

"It’s said that early this morning, she smashed everything in her room. The servants were all too terrified to speak." Tingshuang said softly. "She even called for a physician this morning, saying the Old Madam’s liver qi was stagnant. Many prescriptions were written."

"With everyone outside discussing the Xie family, won’t the Old Madam’s illness only worsen?" Tingxue fretted. "Will Madam have to go attend to her in her illness later?"

Tingshuang shook her head. "Last night, the Prince of Pingxi brought in seventy or eighty bandits into the capital. The attention of the entire capital has been drawn to this. Strange things happen every day in the capital. In less than ten days, everyone will have forgotten about the Xie family’s scandal. The Old Madam’s illness will naturally improve."

As they spoke, Tingfeng entered the side hall with Chen Defu.

"Greetings to Madam." After bowing, Chen Defu said, "Last night, this old servant followed Madam’s instructions and went to the ruined temple outside the city. Sure enough, I saw He Xu there. His buttocks were beaten to a pulp, and his clothes had been stripped clean by the beggars in the ruined temple. He was lying there completely naked. If left unattended, he wouldn’t have lasted three days. This old servant took him into the city, found an inn, and called a physician to treat his wounds. He woke up this morning."

Yun Chu closed her teacup lid and said, "Manager Chen, continue to take good care of He Xu. Find a suitable opportunity to take him to a gambling house."

He Xu was addicted to gambling. Every day in the residence, he set up small gambling games for a group of servants to play with him. She refused to believe He Xu could resist the temptation of a real gambling house.

She continued, "Investigate the name He Lingying thoroughly. Report any leads, no matter how small."

Chen Defu bowed his head. "Yes, Madam."

After Chen Defu left, Tingshuang softly asked, "Does Madam suspect that Concubine He’s identity is problematic?"

Yun Chu did not hide the truth from her. "Concubine He might be the daughter of a convicted criminal. However, in the past fifty years, among the families in the capital that were seized and exiled, there has been no He clan. I don’t know if I’m mistaken."

Tingshuang’s eyes widened in shock.

If Concubine He was from a family of convicted criminals, according to the law, she would be forced into prostitution for generations. Yet the Xie family had taken her as a concubine.

The consequences… she didn’t even dare to imagine.

And the reason Concubine He was able to become a concubine of the Xie family was all due to Madam’s scheming.

Madam was setting herself against the entire Xie family.

A cold sweat broke out on Tingshuang’s forehead. "M-Madam, shouldn’t we return to the Yun family and discuss this with the Eldest Young Master?"

Yun Chu asked her, "Discuss what?"

"Y-You… You are standing in opposition to the entire Xie family…" Tingshuang’s voice dropped to a whisper. "Why… why?"

She had always thought Madam allowed He Shi to become a concubine to better control her. She never imagined the truth was a hundred times more terrifying than she had thought.

Yun Chu said, "Xie Jingyu is not a good husband. I endured him for years, but I can’t endure it any longer."

Tears streamed down Tingshuang’s face. "Then return to the Yun family and ask the Old General to intervene. Let Madam seek a divorce from Master."

"No, I will not seek a divorce." Yun Chu smiled. "I will not leave the Xie family."

She would not give the Xie family any chance to rise again. She wanted to watch with her own eyes as the Xie family slowly perished.

At that moment, the matrons who had come to report matters entered. Seeing Tingshuang crying loudly, they were all startled.

The matrons did not dare to act freely in front of the mistress. Seeing that even the most authoritative maid at Madam’s side had been scolded to tears, how could they dare to cause trouble? One by one, they respectfully reported all the matters of the residence that had occurred during the time Madam had been ill.

Yun Chu calmly gave her instructions for each matter.

She sat in the seat of honor, her demeanor as light as a breeze, yet this brought great comfort to the matrons. With Madam in charge, even if something went wrong, there would be a solution. Unlike when the eldest daughter managed the household, her orders were chaotic, leaving them at a loss for what to do first…

After the matrons left, Yun Chu ordered a carriage to be prepared and set off for the Yun family.

After such a major event at the Xie family yesterday, her family members must not have slept well last night. She had to go see them in person.

As soon as she arrived at the Yun residence’s gate, the guards hurried inside to report. Soon after, Madam Lin and Yun Ze came out to greet her.

"Mother, Eldest Brother." Yun Chu said lightly, "I heard that the Prince of Pingxi returned to the capital after suppressing bandits. Why didn’t Eldest Brother go to the Prince of Pingxi’s residence to celebrate?"

Yun Ze’s expression was very unpleasant. "With you involved in such a major incident, how could I have the mind to go to the Prince of Pingxi’s residence? Do you know how worried Mother was all night?"

"It’s just Xie Jingyu taking a concubine. Mother, don’t worry about such a small matter." Yun Chu linked arms with Madam Lin and smiled. "To me, having one more concubine or one less makes no difference."

Madam Lin’s heart ached as if twisted by a knife. "Chu’er, this marriage was carefully chosen for you by your mother. I never expected to pick such a heartless and ungrateful man. He rose from a mere seventh-rank official to a fifth-rank official in just five years, all thanks to our Yun family. How dare he treat you with such disdain? Your brother and I have discussed it. We will arrange for you to divorce Xie Jingyu. You’re still young…"

"Mother, don’t bring up divorce again." Yun Chu said seriously, "My life with Xie Jingyu is still manageable. I am also willing to continue living it."

Her gaze was firm, with no hesitation or conflict.

Madam Lin sighed.

Yun Ze said nothing more.

Though he was currently only a seventh-rank official, his surname was Yun, which meant his status was inherently different from that of an ordinary seventh-rank official.

He would do something to let Xie Jingyu experience what it was like to lose the support of the Yun family and see if the Xie family could still stand in the capital.

If he dared to disrespect his sister, he would have to bear the consequences.

"Alright, let’s not talk about this anymore." Yun Ze said warmly, "Your sister-in-law personally stewed some tonic soup. Make sure to drink plenty of it later."

Madam Lin led her toward the flower hall. "Wait a little longer. Your father will return to the capital soon. Then, we’ll have your father invite Xie Jingyu for a drink."

Yun Chu’s face lit up with joy. "Father is returning to the capital?"

In her past life, after the Yun family’s downfall, her father had been arrested by the court from the front lines and thrown into a dungeon. She had exhausted all her efforts but had never been able to see her father one last time.

Calculating the time, it had been at least ten years since she last saw her father.

"Look at you, so happy." Madam Lin also smiled. "Your father dotes on you the most. If he knew of the grievances you’ve suffered in the Xie family, it would be enough to make the entire Xie family drink a pot of poison."

Yun Chu happily ate lunch at home before preparing to return to the Xie residence.

Yun Ze personally saw her out and admonished, "Chu’er, I am your full-blooded elder brother. Don’t keep anything from me."

"I know, Eldest Brother." Yun Chu smiled as freely as she had when she was a child. "Just don’t find me annoying later, Eldest Brother. It’s getting late; I should go."

As she was about to board the carriage, suddenly, another carriage turned into the street, blocking her path.

The carriage curtain was lifted, and a man dressed in a black brocade robe jumped out.

Yun Ze and Yun Chu quickly bowed. "Greetings, Marquis of Xuanyu."

The newcomer was indeed Qin Mingheng, the Marquis of Xuanyu.

chapters.title: He Xu's Gambling Addiction
chapters.content:
"Lord Yun, Lady Xie."

Qin Mingheng greeted them one by one, his gaze casually passing over Yun Chu as usual.

Yun Ze spoke, "This official will first see my sister to the carriage. I trouble Lord Hou to wait a moment."

Qin Mingheng took a few steps back. "It's fine."

Yun Chu nodded to Qin Mingheng before supporting Tingshuang's hand to board the carriage. Yun Ze stood in place, watching the carriage disappear into the distance.

Only after the carriage vanished from the main road did he withdraw his gaze and look at Qin Mingheng. "Lord Hou, please."

Qin Mingheng's brow furrowed slightly. "Lord Yun, I suddenly remembered there is an urgent matter I need to attend to. Let us discuss that matter again at this time tomorrow."

Yun Ze cupped his hands in farewell and watched Qin Mingheng board his carriage.

Once the carriage was out of the Yun family's grounds, Qin Mingheng took out a white handkerchief from his sleeve.

Just now, as Yun Chu was boarding the carriage, this snow-white handkerchief had fluttered to the ground. From the corner of his eye, he had followed her, so he immediately went over, picked up the handkerchief, and hid it in his sleeve.

He picked up the handkerchief and sniffed it, a satisfied expression appearing on his face.

He thought of that night five years ago, when she had worn a red wedding dress and a red veil, lying on his bed.

He had been so close to tasting her, to taking her as his wife...

Thinking of what had happened five years ago, Qin Mingheng's face filled with deep hatred, and the handkerchief in his hand was torn in half.

The carriage slowly stopped at the Xie residence's gate.

Yun Chu habitually reached into her sleeve, but she couldn't find the handkerchief. "Tingshuang, is the handkerchief with you?"

Tingshuang shook her head and quickly searched around, but the handkerchief was nowhere to be found.

"Forget it, it's just an ordinary handkerchief. If it's lost, then it's lost."

Yun Chu waved her hand dismissively.

A handkerchief without embroidered names wasn't considered a personal item, so it didn't matter if someone else picked it up.

Next, Yun Chu carefully selected suitable young talents to find a good husband for her half-sister, Yun Ran.

Her grandfather and father had been at war for years, achieving great military merits, and her paternal aunt was a favored concubine in the palace. The entire Yun family was one of the top families in the capital. To avoid the royal family's jealousy, the Yun family's women could only marry down.

But marrying down didn't mean marrying just anyone; there were still many considerations.

She had been reborn once and knew the future developments of many things. It was best for her to choose a good husband for her half-sister.

After busy days of selection among the many young talents in the capital, Yun Chu finally chose two candidates. She wrote down the two families on paper, folded it into an envelope, and had Tingshuang find a servant boy to deliver it to the Yun family.

Her word wasn't final; her mother still needed to inquire about the situations of these two families, and ultimately, her half-sister would have to agree.

After finishing this, she continued to the courtyard to practice her horse stance.

In addition to the horse stance, Autumn Tong had arranged some basic moves. Later, the intensity would gradually increase. Yun Chu didn't feel tired; on the contrary, the more she learned, the more energetic she became. Perhaps it was because she was the daughter of a general, and she naturally enjoyed these things.

After practicing martial arts and bathing, Tingshuang entered to report, "Madam, Concubine Tao and Concubine He request an audience."

Yun Chu, of course, knew why these two had come to Shengju.

Ever since He became a concubine, Tao had always deliberately picked on her. The more He avoided her, the more Tao targeted her.

These past few days, He had been targeted countless times and could no longer endure it, so she had come to Yun Chu for help.

"Please, Madam, stand up for me." He lowered her head. "Concubine Tao is really too much. She has bribed all the maids and servants in my courtyard..."

Tao spoke calmly, "Madam doesn't know, but everyone in the Xie residence knows that Concubine He rose from a servant to a mistress. People are all discussing her behind her back. As we both serve the master, we are like sisters. How can I tolerate such things happening? So I spent a little silver to silence those maids and servants. I did this for Concubine He's sake. How can she accuse me in front of Madam?"

He was so angry that her chest hurt.

Ever since she moved into Bihe Yuan, she had not had a single peaceful day. Either a dead fish would be placed in her bed, or all the candles in her room would be broken, or there would be problems with her food... She had secretly paid attention and discovered that the two maids and two servants attending to her had all taken Tao's silver and deliberately caused these troubles.

She kept in mind Xie Jingyu's instructions not to cause any more trouble, so she endured it all in silence.

But this morning, the maid serving her had actually stolen her vanity case. There was no money inside, only the first hair and baby teeth of her children, An'er, Wei'er, and Gui'er, which she had always kept with her. Now it was gone, and she truly had no choice but to ask Madam for justice.

"Madam..." He took a deep breath. "I won't mention anything else. I just want Concubine Tao to return that case to me."

Upon hearing this, Tao began to cry loudly, "Madam, I have been wholeheartedly thinking of Concubine He, but she accuses me of stealing her case! Ever since I became pregnant, the master has sent me countless jewelry. Who would care about her case? Madam, I truly did not steal anything. Please stand up for me!"

Yun Chu took Tao's hand and spoke gently, "Don't cry. Be careful not to harm the baby."

Tao sobbed and secretly gave a signal to the maid beside her.

That maid immediately ran out.

After a while, the young maid serving He rushed in, "Madam, Concubine He's case was found under the bed. It must be that Concubine He hid it herself and forgot where she put it."

Tao cried even more pitifully, "What a good Concubine He! She wants to harm the child in my womb. I repay her kindness with kindness, but she is not satisfied and deliberately puts on this act to frame me for theft. Madam, I am truly wronged..."

Yun Chu's lips twitched.

Tao's acting was really too poor. Only she was willing to play along. If it were any other mistress of the house, Tao's behavior would have been punished long ago.

She gently patted Tao's hand and looked at He, speaking coldly, "Concubine He, you previously tried to harm the child in Concubine Tao's womb. The entire Xie family has not held it against you and even allowed you to become a mistress. Yet you have not repented and have tried to harm Concubine Tao again. If Concubine Tao's pregnancy is affected and the child is born prematurely, what crime should you bear?"

He was truly wronged to death. She hurried to defend herself, "Madam, I..."

"It's fine. No need to say more." Yun Chu interrupted her. "For the next three months, your monthly allowance will be given directly to Concubine Tao. Consider it a way to calm the unborn Young Master Xi."

He couldn't believe it.

A concubine's monthly allowance was two taels of silver. This was her only income now. If it all went to Tao, what would she use?

But facing Yun Chu's undeniable gaze, she knew that no matter how she defended herself, it would be meaningless because Madam clearly favored Tao.

Leaving Shengju, He felt a sense of helplessness and hugged her own shoulders.

Unless absolutely necessary, she would not seek help from her three children.

Xie Jingyu had slapped her, clearly impatient with her, so she would not go and ask for more humiliation.

Her brother, He Xu, had been beaten by the old madam a few days ago and thrown out. He was also an unreliable scoundrel.

She remembered that there was still a sum of money in He Xu's hands, a full two thousand taels of silver. With money, she didn't believe those maids and servants would still side with Tao.

Thinking of this, He hurriedly walked out of the residence.

---

chapters.title: Learning Martial Arts to Open Meridians
chapters.content:
Yun Chu continued to practice in the courtyard.

Autumn Tong carefully taught her the basic moves. After finishing a set, she was drenched in sweat.

"Mother..."

A figure appeared at the courtyard gate.

She wiped the sweat and looked over. It was Xie Shiwei.

She spoke indifferently, "Why is Wei'er here?"

The last time she had Xie Shiwei punished with family discipline, he had not set foot in her courtyard except for morning greetings. She also turned a blind eye and couldn't be bothered to pay attention.

"I also want to learn martial arts." Xie Shiwei walked in and gathered his courage to say.

Ever since he made that mistake, his food, clothing, and allowances had been reduced by half. Every day, he didn't have enough to eat, and he had no silver to spend.

He had come to apologize to his mother and seek forgiveness, hoping she would restore everything to the way it was.

But seeing his mother practicing martial arts, each move looking particularly graceful, he suddenly wanted to learn a few moves as well.

He was not good at studying, and his father scolded him every day. The old madam and grandmother also constantly advised him. He thought he was truly useless.

But now he suddenly realized that he was just not interested in studying. It didn't mean he couldn't learn anything. He felt that he could take the path of martial arts and might not be much worse than his elder brother.

Yun Chu looked down at Xie Shiwei's eyes.

This illegitimate son had not inherited Xie Jingyu's talent for studying but had a natural recklessness. When he had entered the Yun family's military camp, he had become a commander of a thousand soldiers in less than a year. With the help of the Yun family, Xie Shiwei had advanced extremely smoothly on the path of martial arts...

She would not give Xie Shiwei another chance to pursue martial arts.

"Rarely do you have the mind to improve yourself. Then you can learn together." Yun Chu spoke gently, "Autumn Tong, first open his meridians for him."

Autumn Tong was somewhat surprised. Madam should know that beginners only needed to practice the horse stance to strengthen their physique. Opening meridians was something to be done much later. It was impossible to do it now.

Tingshuang softly said, "Just follow Madam's orders."

Autumn Tong nodded and walked to Xie Shiwei's side. "Second Young Master, forgive me."

She directly reached out, grabbed Xie Shiwei's right arm, and pulled it down. A crack was heard, and Xie Shiwei let out a miserable scream, instinctively trying to escape.

But Autumn Tong gave him no chance. She found his meridian acupoints, pressed down hard, and pulled again forcefully.

"It hurts, it hurts, it hurts!" Xie Shiwei was covered in sweat. "Let go of me, let go quickly, I'm about to die from the pain."

Yun Chu, sitting on a rattan chair, said, "Your father told you to study hard, but you said studying was too boring. The old madam indulged you, so no one said anything. Now, it is your own choice to learn martial arts, so there is no reason to give up halfway. Opening meridians before learning martial arts is my Yun family's exclusive secret method and the foundation for my grandfather and father to achieve their excellent martial skills. I have always treated you as my own son, so I won't hide anything from you. It will hurt a bit at first, but it will get better gradually."

Xie Shiwei's face turned pale from the pain. "H-How long do I have to open the meridians?"

"Until you don't feel the pain anymore, then you won't have to continue." Yun Chu's lips curved into a smile. "My father took three months, and my brother tried for a year and still couldn't do it, so he gave up on the path of martial arts."

Xie Shiwei was so scared that he almost collapsed to the ground.

He stammered, "What if I don't open the meridians?"

"Without a good foundation, you will only be an ordinary warrior for life, only able to be a small soldier on the battlefield." Yun Chu said indifferently. "If you want to become a general like my grandfather and father, it will be impossible."

Xie Shiwei stood in place, tightening his lips.

He wanted to learn martial arts, but this process was too painful. He had to endure at least three months...

"Autumn Tong, continue."

At Yun Chu's command, Autumn Tong directly picked Xie Shiwei up, took off his shoes, and pressed hard on the acupoints on the soles of his feet with her fingers.

Xie Shiwei screamed in agony.

He had just returned to the Xie residence and was about to go to the main courtyard to report when he heard his son's miserable screams.

She quickly stepped in and saw the scene before her. She was greatly shocked and hurriedly asked, "Madam, what did Second Young Master do wrong?"

Tingshuang said, "Second Young Master wants to learn martial arts with Madam. This is the meridian opening."

Upon hearing this, He felt a surge of anger in her chest.

Madam originally didn't favor non-biological children. If Wei'er followed Madam to learn martial arts, wouldn't that be walking into a trap? He must be crazy.

Moreover, studying was much more comfortable. Why suffer to learn martial arts? Hadn't she seen that in the Yun family, only one old general remained from the previous generation, and only Yun Chu's father from the last generation? By Yun Chu's generation, they no longer let the younger generation study martial arts, which was enough to prove that this path was not good.

The Yun family was unwilling to take this path, yet Madam was letting her son take it. She really didn't know what she was thinking!

Yun Chu looked up. "Concubine He, why are you standing there not leaving? Do you also want to learn martial arts together?"

He quickly said, "Second Young Master seems tired. How about resting for a while before continuing?"

Yun Chu nodded. Autumn Tong immediately let go of the person, and Xie Shiwei collapsed to the ground.

He quickly rushed over to check on his son's condition.

Yun Chu stood up. "Concubine He and Wei'er have always been close. You can take care of him for a while."

She turned and entered the inner room, and the maids outside also followed her in.

He took the opportunity to say, "Wei'er, learning martial arts is useless, completely useless. Quickly tell Madam that you don't want to learn anymore."

Xie Shiwei had just been tormented half to death, and his voice was hoarse from screaming. He was not a person with a firm character. Hearing He say this, he was completely crushed. "But Mother said not to give up halfway."

"You just say you are willing to study hard, and that's it." He helped him up. "The Xie family is a scholarly family. Shouldn't the younger generation study?"

Xie Shiwei pouted. "But studying is so hard..."

"Is learning martial arts not hard? Look at how you were tormented on the first day. Will there be good days ahead?" He said earnestly, "Some unnecessary suffering, we don't have to endure. Be good, okay?"

Just as she was speaking, Yun Chu came out from the inner room. "Wei'er, let's continue opening the meridians. Just now, Autumn Tong only used one-tenth of her strength. Next, she will use five-tenths. Are you ready?"

Xie Shiwei was so scared that he took a step back.

Just now, with that little strength, he had almost died from the pain. If the strength increased, he would really die here.

"Mother, can I... not learn anymore..."

Yun Chu's expression darkened. "No, you must learn. This is the path you chose for yourself. Autumn Tong, go ahead."

Autumn Tong walked towards Xie Shiwei.

Xie Shiwei was so scared that he suddenly started crying. "Mother, I was just curious. I didn't really want to learn. I was wrong, truly wrong..."

Yun Chu frowned. "Learning is not child's play. You can't just stop when you say you want to stop."

"I will definitely study hard in the future." Xie Shiwei kept backing away. "Father said that the Xie family passes down through scholarship, and every child must study. I will listen to Father."

Yun Chu's lips twitched.

Children at this age were like this. The more you made them do something, the less they wanted to do it.

At least for the next few years, Xie Shiwei would not bring up learning martial arts again. By the time he was twelve or thirteen, it would be much more difficult to learn martial arts.
