Ever since he could remember, his mother had been bedridden. He had two greatest wishes: one was to become an official and bring glory to the Xie family, and the other was to cure his mother's illness.

How he wished his mother could sit in the seat of honor and drink the wedding wine at his and Yun Chu's wedding.

He inquired everywhere and finally learned that the Marquis of Xuanyu had a divine medicine passed down from his ancestors, said to cure all diseases.

Through the Yun family's connections, he was able to visit the marquis's residence. When he knelt before the Marquis of Xuanyu and begged for the divine medicine, the marquis made a request that still made him shudder to this day.

"Can I attend Lord Xie's wedding night?"

He still remembered the sinister look in the marquis's eyes when he said that, as if he wanted to devour him alive.

It was then that he realized that the Marquis of Xuanyu, who had married a woman from the Luo family, actually harbored unusual feelings for Yun Chu, the legitimate eldest daughter of the General's mansion.

"What is Lord Xie thinking about? Why does your face look so ugly?" Qin Mingheng's mockery deepened. "Blame me for being a bad host. Someone, serve tea to Lord Xie and Madam Xie."

A maid brought two cups of tea and placed them in front of Yun Chu and Xie Jingyu.

Yun Chu's upbringing told her that when the host served tea, regardless of whether she was thirsty or not, she should symbolically take a sip as a gesture of courtesy.

She picked up the teacup and brought it to her lips.

"Madam."

Xie Jingyu called out in a choked voice.

Yun Chu paused her action and turned her head. "What is it?"

Qin Mingheng leaned back in his chair. "What, does Lord Xie think there's something wrong with my tea?"

Xie Jingyu gripped the cup tightly.

He had brought Yun Chu here precisely because he had anticipated this scene.

Five years ago, Yun Chu had used that night to save his mother's life.

Now, Yun Chu was no longer the pure eldest daughter of the General's mansion. What was one more night to ensure the peace of the Xie family?

Even though he had made such a decision, why did he hesitate when he saw this cup of tea?

He realized for the first time that he was truly a hypocritical man.

Xie Jingyu spoke slowly, "Be careful, the tea is hot."

Yun Chu lowered her gaze. "Thank you for the reminder, husband."

She brought the teacup to her lips and took a light sip, but she did not swallow it. Instead, she subtly spat the tea into her handkerchief.

Her movement was small, but Qin Mingheng had been watching her from the corner of his eye and naturally saw it.

He couldn't help but sneer. His tea had nothing in it, yet she was so cautious that she didn't drink a single drop.

But five years ago, the wine she and Xie Jingyu had drunk during their wedding night had contained a drug strong enough to make a grown man fall into a deep sleep.

At this moment, Luo Shi arrived with her maids, smiling. "Lord Xie and Madam Xie have come to the door. Marquis, you should let go of yesterday's matter."

The Xie family's second young master had not only broken his leg but had also been sent far away from the capital by the Xie family. This was equivalent to the Xie family abandoning the child.

Although this child was only a concubine's son and could not be compared to the marquis's legitimate heir, the Xie couple had already gone this far. If the marquis's residence still held a grudge, it would be somewhat unreasonable.

"I have some good tea. Madam Xie, please come to my courtyard and sit for a while." Luo Shi smiled at Yun Chu. "It's almost noon. Madam Xie, would you like to stay and have lunch with me?"

Yun Chu naturally would not refuse. She stood up and followed Luo Shi to the inner courtyard.

As soon as they left, the smile on Qin Mingheng's face disappeared completely. He coldly said, "Lord Xie, are you not leaving? Do you want to stay and have a meal with me?"

Xie Jingyu clenched his fists. "This official takes his leave."

Watching his figure disappear at the gate of the marquis's residence, Qin Mingheng's expression grew colder.

How could such a selfish and despicable man be worthy of Yun Chu? How could Madam Yun have been so blind as to marry her daughter to such a vile person?

He walked to the study and pressed a mechanism. Inside was a painting room. The walls were covered with portraits of the same woman, and there was a handkerchief on the table.

He took down a portrait and murmured, "Yun Chu, it is I who have wronged you. If I had defied the imperial decree and not married Luo Shi, could I have married you..."

The Marquis of Xuanyu was an idle title without real power. He didn't understand why the emperor had arranged a marriage for him when he was still a prince.

If only he had waited two more years, until Yun Chu came of age, he could have convinced his mother to propose early. But in the end, he was too late.

He married a Luo family woman, and she became the wife of the Xie family.

Yun Chu drank tea in Luo Shi's courtyard and accompanied her for a meal. She was extremely careful, secretly spitting out everything she put in her mouth into her handkerchief.

It wasn't that she was too suspicious of others, but it was clear that the Marquis of Xuanyu and Xie Jingyu were at odds. She had to be cautious.

After chatting with Luo Shi for a while, she learned that the rumors outside were true. Apart from Luo Shi, there were no other women in the Marquis of Xuanyu's residence.

In this dynasty, which man didn't have three wives and four concubines? Yet the Marquis of Xuanyu had managed to do this for Luo Shi.

When the time was about right, Yun Chu bade farewell to Luo Shi and went to the front courtyard to meet up with Xie Jingyu.

A young servant in the front courtyard told her that Xie Jingyu was in the marquis's study, discussing business, and asked her to wait in the side hall of the study.

Yun Chu nodded and followed him to the side hall to sit down.

The side hall had ice basins placed on all four sides. Even with the fierce sun outside, she didn't feel the slightest heat.

chapters.title: Xie Jingyu is Unworthy
chapters.content:
Yun Chu sat briefly in the side hall.

Soon, a figure slowly approached. She stood up and greeted, "Marquis."

Out of the corner of her eye, she glanced back but did not see Xie Jingyu.

"Is Madam Xie waiting for Lord Xie?" Qin Mingheng sat down in the chair. "Then I must apologize. In fact, Lord Xie left a long time ago."

Yun Chu frowned.

If Xie Jingyu had left early, why did the servant of the Marquis's mansion lead her here?

She turned her head and found that the maids and servants who had been waiting at the door of the side hall had all retreated.

Qin Mingheng looked at Tingshuang, who was standing behind her. "You may leave first."

Tingshuang did not move.

Yun Chu spoke calmly, "It is improper for a man and a woman to be alone in a room. This is my trusted maid. Marquis, please feel free to speak."

Qin Mingheng looked up at her. "Xie Jingyu left Madam Xie alone in the Marquis's mansion. Doesn't Madam Xie find it ridiculous to still guard her chastity for such a husband?"

Yun Chu raised her eyes. "It is also amusing to me that the Marquis meets a married woman alone. They say the Marquis of Xuanyu is deeply devoted to his wife. Is that truly the case?"

A man who deeply loves his wife would never deceive a married woman like this.

Even if there was something extremely important, he should have sent a maid or a servant to deliver a message, or found a suitable opportunity to talk in a public place.

If Lady Luo saw them here, the Marquis of Xuanyu might escape unscathed, but her reputation, Yun Chu, would be completely ruined.

Thinking of this, Yun Chu turned and left.

She respected the Marquis of Xuanyu because she was merely the family of a fifth-rank official.

She had the confidence to turn and leave because she was the eldest legitimate daughter of the Yun family.

In the past, she had always been reluctant to rely on the Yun family's influence. Now, thinking about it, she was a member of the Yun family. Why should she endure injustice when she had such a powerful backing?

She had just taken a step when an angry voice came from behind her, "Stop."

Yun Chu paused for a moment, then continued walking out.

"Madam Xie, some time ago, you reburied your deceased children. Are you so sure that those two skeletons were your children?"

Yun Chu tightened her lips.

The man behind her had accurately pinched her weak spot.

She could be sure that the Marquis of Xuanyu had been watching her for a long time. What was his intention?

She took a deep breath, turned around, and coldly said, "Marquis, what do you want to say? Please speak plainly."

"Madam Xie, this status is unworthy of you. You are so intelligent, why don't you think about why Xie Jingyu left alone?" Qin Mingheng approached her. "He is not even afraid of leaving you alone in the Marquis's mansion to cuckold him. Why are you afraid of being alone in a room with me?"

Yun Chu took a step back, avoiding his approach.

She felt that this man was talking nonsense, not getting to the point, yet every word was striking her heart.

She seemed to understand, but when she thought carefully, she couldn't figure it out.

"Yun Chu."

Qin Mingheng called her by her name.

Yun Chu's eyebrows furrowed tightly. She felt a surge of disgust and stepped back again.

She should have left, but she couldn't take a step. She always felt that the Marquis of Xuanyu seemed to know something about her, something very important.

"Divorce him. Xie Jingyu is unworthy of you." Qin Mingheng placed one hand on the door frame behind Yun Chu and the other on the wall, trapping her in a small space.

Tingshuang was so scared that she lost her voice and hurried to stand in front of Yun Chu.

Qin Mingheng pushed her aside with a wave of his hand.

He leaned down, close to Yun Chu's ear, "If you divorce him, I will also divorce immediately. I can marry you..."

*Slap!*

A loud slap landed on Qin Mingheng's face.

This was the second time Yun Chu had slapped someone.

She hadn't expected herself to slap the Marquis of Xuanyu.

"Marquis of Xuanyu, please respect yourself!" Yun Chu pushed away his hand from the door frame, stepped out of the doorway, and turned to the side. Her eyes flashed with icy coldness. "You should indeed divorce. You are not worthy of your wife."

After saying this, she turned and left. Tingshuang quickly supported her, and the two of them ignored the iron-green face of Qin Mingheng and walked straight out of the Marquis's mansion.

The carriage they had arrived in was no longer there.

Yun Chu's face turned extremely cold.

She did not return to the Xie mansion but went to the ice shop that was about to open.

Chen Defu had bought a large courtyard. The front was used as the shop, and the back as a warehouse. Chen Defu's distant nephew was the shopkeeper, and it was called Chen's Ice Shop.

It was set to open in mid-May. Since those who could afford ice were wealthy, the price of ice was set high at two taels of silver per jin. By the peak of summer in July, this price would continue to rise.

She gave Chen Defu some of her own suggestions and adjusted the price increase trend before leaving the ice shop.

At this time, it was still early. Yun Chu had barely eaten at noon, so she found a restaurant and ate heartily with Tingshuang.

After the meal, they slowly drank some tea, and dusk gradually fell.

Yun Chu was not in a hurry to return. She took Tingshuang to stroll through the capital's night market.

When the lanterns were first lit, many small vendors would push their carts onto the street to sell various trinkets. Since she got married, Yun Chu had not been to the night market.

She saw kite sellers and thought that Yu Ge'er would definitely like to fly kites. It would be great if they could fly kites together in the future.

She saw sugar figure sellers and thought that Changsheng would definitely like to eat candy. She loved seeing Changsheng's sweet smile.

She saw pottery figure sellers and thought that if the two children were there, they would definitely want to make three pottery figures that looked exactly like them...

Before she knew it, Yun Chu had bought a lot of things.

When the sky was completely dark, Yun Chu and Tingshuang boarded a carriage arranged by Chen Defu and returned to the Xie family.

As soon as she entered the door of Sheng Ju, Xie Jingyu arrived right behind her.

Yun Chu sat in her place and coldly looked at him. "Why did you leave without waiting for me, husband?"

Xie Jingyu examined her from her hair to her feet. She seemed the same as when she left in the morning, yet somehow different.

His gaze made Yun Chu's heart grow cold bit by bit.

It turned out that for the sake of the Xie family, he could hand her, a living person, over to another man.

If she hadn't noticed something was wrong, after drinking that cup of tea, who knew what would have happened. She didn't even dare to imagine.

It turned out that Xie Jingyu had started plotting against her from this moment.

Even when the Yun family was at its peak, he dared to have such wicked ideas about her. Where did he get the courage?

"Madam, why are you back so late?" Xie Jingyu asked softly.

He wanted to know if that thing had happened.

He wanted to know if she knew what he had done.

"Why am I back so late? Why don't you ask yourself?" Yun Chu stared at him. "The carriage took you back to the mansion but did not return to the Marquis's mansion to pick me up. I walked back, so of course it took some time."

Seeing that she was only slightly emotionally disturbed, Xie Jingyu guessed that she must have been drugged like on their wedding night and did not know what had happened.

So, she did not know of his despicable actions.

He let out a sigh of relief and said with apology, "It's my fault. I should not have been so busy with official duties that I neglected you."

"We are husband and wife, there's no need to say such things." Yun Chu seemed not to care about this matter at all and asked with concern, "Has the Marquis of Xuanyu accepted the Xie family's apology?"

Xie Jingyu nodded. "The Marquis said he would not pursue this matter any further."

He had given up his son and offered his wife. If Qin Mingheng still refused to let it go, it would be too much.

Yun Chu smiled.

The Marquis of Xuanyu had been slapped by her. This matter would not be so easily forgotten.

---

chapters.title: The Ice Shop Opens
chapters.content:
As Yun Chu had expected.

The next day, she heard that Lord Yu had scolded Xie Jingyu at the palace gate and had taken all the official documents that Xie Jingyu was responsible for and given them to Lord Yuan.

Although Xie Jingyu had the Yun family as his backing, he had not smoothly risen to the fifth rank. Additionally, with the recent series of embarrassments for the Xie family and the offense against the Marquis of Xuanyu, many people in the court were waiting for an even bigger joke. Xie Jingyu was indeed a man of strong character. Even though he was ridiculed, he still went to court early every day and had never taken a day off.

On the surface, Xie Jingyu did not show any abnormalities. Only the young servant in his study knew how many tea cups he had smashed.

"Father, this might be a good thing." Xie Shian picked up the pieces from the ground and said calmly, "In the past five years, the Xie family has been too prominent. The number one scholar paraded on horseback, then married the legitimate daughter of a first-rank general's family. Within five short years, he was promoted twice. There are very few people in this dynasty who have risen so quickly. Many people are jealous of Father. Now that Father has been relieved of his official duties, it is a chance for those people to get what they want. Father can take this opportunity to rest for a while."

Xie Jingyu's face was gloomy. "The Marquis of Xuanyu does not plan to let our Xie family off."

"There is another reason: the Yun family has not taken a stance." Xie Shian continued, "As long as someone from the Yun family is willing to stand with Father, the Marquis of Xuanyu will be deterred and will not dare to incite the court officials to isolate Father."

Xie Jingyu drank the tea on the table in one gulp.

He had already sent Yun Chu to the Marquis of Xuanyu's mansion. Should he ask Yun Chu to seek Lady Yun to go to the Marquis of Xuanyu's mansion to mediate?

"Asking the Yun family to intervene is unnecessary." Xie Shian said, "Father, I still say the same thing: misfortune may be a blessing in disguise. Since things have come to this point, we should go with the flow, retreat, and prepare for the next opportunity."

Xie Jingyu knew that this was the only path they could take at the moment.

Leaving the study, Xie Shian sighed.

In the end, it was because his father and mother's marital affection was too weak. Otherwise, his mother would have taken the initiative to solve his father's current predicament.

As soon as he reached the door of his own courtyard, He Shi came out from the side, her face full of worry. "An Ge'er, your younger brother went to the manor and hasn't sent any news back. Can you ask your father to allow me to go to the manor to take care of him for a few days?"

"Concubine, if you want to go, you can go at any time. But remember, if you go, you may never be able to return to the Xie mansion." Xie Shian said coldly, "What I mean is, leaving is good for all of us. Concubine, you might as well find an excuse to live in the manor permanently."

He Shi instinctively opposed, "How can I leave when you and Wan Jie'er are still in the Xie family? What if something happens to you and Wan Jie'er like it did to Wei Ge'er?"

"If you are unwilling to leave the Xie family, then be a proper concubine." Xie Shian said with some fatigue, "Father's official career is hindered. Don't provoke Father and add to his troubles."

He pinched his forehead and entered his room.

He Shi bit her lower lip.

After becoming a concubine, she had lost her freedom to leave the mansion. The madam was truly clever.

Fortunately, there was a young nun in the temple willing to do things for her. Otherwise, she would not have been able to sell the embroidered screens and handkerchiefs she made.

Yun Chu sat on the couch while Tingshuang stood beside her and reported, "In these past few days, the Marquis of Xuanyu has not attended court and there has been no news of him."

She had seen with her own eyes that after the Marquis of Xuanyu was slapped by the madam, his face had swollen immediately. Anyone else would not have let this matter go so easily.

It was fine for the Marquis of Xuanyu to suppress the Xie family, but she was worried that the madam would be troubled.

Yun Chu sipped her tea.

She tried hard to recall her past life. Until her death, she had had no interaction with the Marquis of Xuanyu.

Who would have thought that the Marquis of Xuanyu would harbor such dark thoughts about her? No wonder he had suggested she divorce at Lady's birthday banquet last time.

A person who harbored impure thoughts about her was someone she naturally wanted to stay away from.

Losing her own reputation was a minor matter, but implicating the Yun family's reputation was a major one...

"Madam, the maids, servants, and young servants from the Second Young Master's courtyard have arrived." Tingxue came in to report.

Yun Chu nodded and let them enter the garden.

Xie Wei had only taken one personal young servant with him to the manor, leaving the rest behind. There were two maids, two servants, and one young servant, all five standing with their heads lowered on the steps.

Now that Yun Chu was in charge, she no longer used her dowry to subsidize the Xie family. The money in the Xie family's accounts was all from her father-in-law's manor income.

She had no intention of saving money for the Xie family.

She said, "The old lady is advanced in years and has been ill. She needs people to take care of her. You two servants can go to the old lady's courtyard. The Third Young Master is growing up. You two can go to the Third Young Master's courtyard to serve."

In the end, only Jiu'er was left standing in the courtyard.

Yun Chu looked at her and said, "You will stay and work for me."

Jiu'er nodded. "Yes, Madam."

She knew things she shouldn't have known. She had long known that Madam would not let her serve in another courtyard.

"I have a manor in the suburbs of the capital. There are many things I will entrust to you." Yun Chu said, "I have asked the doctor. There are still three silver needles in your body. You need to soak in hot springs regularly to possibly remove them. Coincidentally, there is a hot spring in that manor. Take good care of yourself. Once you are healed, I still have important tasks for you."

Jiu'er's eyes widened in shock.

When the doctor had mentioned the hot spring to her, she hadn't dared to imagine it. This was a luxury only the rich and noble could afford. How could a lowly servant girl like her have such fortune?

She thought that if there were needles in her body, so be it. When she died would be her fate.

But she hadn't expected that Madam would send her to a manor with a hot spring, let her soak in the hot spring to heal, and save her life. Wasn't Madam afraid that she would tell the Xie family that the Second Young Master's matter had Madam's involvement?

Why did Madam trust her so much?

Before she could think more, Tingshuang took her away.

Yun Chu looked down at the tea foam.

She would eventually promote a few maids. Because soon, she would marry off Tingshuang and Tingxue. She needed people around her to handle matters.

Although Jiu'er was young, after going through this, she had gained some insight and foresight. With slow cultivation, she could become a capable assistant in the future.

As for trust, it did not exist.

Even the children she had raised with her own hands could betray her one by one. How could she fully trust a maid she was not very familiar with?

It was just that Jiu'er was currently the best choice.

During this period, Xie Jingyu returned home after court to avoid meeting him. Yun Chu basically did not leave Sheng Ju.

Until mid-May, when the ice shop opened, she finally ordered a horse to be prepared and went out to see the lively scene.

She ordered a pot of tea at a teahouse across from the ice shop and sat by the window, looking at the shop.

Because it was getting hotter, the number of people coming to the ice shop was not small.

"I don't know why, but the ice shops that usually sell ice don't have any ice this year. I heard that a southern merchant bought all the ice in March and April."

"My master also didn't buy ice in advance because of this. Now, he has hurriedly sent me to buy more."

"It's ridiculous that the entire capital only has this one ice shop."

...

Yun Chu also found it ridiculous.

Could it be that all the ice in the capital and nearby cities had been bought by Chen Defu in March and April?

If it was true that only her shop sold ice, something might happen.

Yun Chu spoke and gave Tingshuang a few instructions. Tingshuang's eyes gradually brightened.

At this moment, a voice suddenly came from behind, "Madam Xie."

Yun Chu turned her head and saw a man in a black brocade robe standing a table away. It was Prince Pingxi, Chu Yi.

If it were true that only her family was selling ice, there might be trouble.

Yun Chu spoke, giving Ting Sheng a few instructions. Ting Sheng’s eyes gradually brightened.

At this moment, a voice suddenly came from behind: "Madam Xie."

Yun Chu turned her head and saw a man in a black brocade robe standing a table away. It was Chu Yi, the Prince of Pingxi.

---

chapters.title: Agreeing to Marry the Princess
chapters.content:
Yun Chu quickly stood up to pay her respects.

"There’s no need for such formalities, Madam Xie," Chu Yi said. "I have a matter I’d like to ask Madam Xie to help with."

Only heaven knew how difficult it was to meet Madam Xie.

His residence had no women, so there was no pretext to invite her over.

If he were to visit the Xie residence, it would be improper for the lady of the house to receive an unrelated man.

He had no choice but to have people keep a close watch on the Xie residence. Finally, when she stepped out of the door, he immediately mounted his horse and followed.

He entered this teahouse and, at a glance, saw her sitting by the window drinking tea. She wore a moon-white dress, her raven-black hair coiled up, revealing her fair neck... At this point, he immediately averted his gaze.

He stood in place for a long while before approaching and calling out, "Madam Xie."

Yun Chu had no idea about the turmoil in his heart. She was only somewhat surprised that the Prince of Pingxi had come specifically to find her, rather than it being a chance encounter.

She lowered her head. "It would be my honor to assist Your Highness. Please give your instructions."

The words "your servant’s wife" made Chu Yi’s brows furrow slightly.

He ignored this slight discomfort and said, "A few days ago, my son and daughter mistakenly entered the Xie residence. I hope they did not disturb Madam Xie."

Yun Chu’s expression froze.

She suddenly looked up, meeting Chu Yi’s dark gaze.

She had thought she had concealed everything well that day, but in reality, this man had seen through it all.

So, had he come to confront her?

But it didn’t seem so. His expression was too gentle, not like someone looking for trouble.

Yun Chu quickly lowered her gaze and said, "I did not intend to conceal it. That day, the young prince and the young princess..."

"I don’t blame Madam Xie," Chu Yi sighed. "After my daughter returned to the prince’s residence, she was depressed for many days, painting every day. All the paintings were portraits of Madam Xie. She probably wants to see Madam Xie. I wonder if Madam Xie can fulfill her wish?"

At the mention of Chu Changsheng’s depression, Yun Chu’s heart felt as if it had been tugged.

Without any hesitation or thought, she immediately nodded.

Chu Yi relaxed and said softly, "If Madam Xie were to visit the prince’s residence, it might draw attention. I’ll have someone take the children to the Yin family."

Yun Chu knew that the Yin family was the maternal family of Chu Yi’s mother, the princess consort.

Chu Yi’s mother had originally been a low-ranking palace maid. She had been favored by the emperor and became pregnant, giving birth to the third prince. After that, she was promoted to a noble consort, and after Chu Yi’s achievements, she was elevated to a princess consort.

Chu Yi’s mother was not one of the major empresses or consorts of the Western Palace. The head of the Yin family, Lord Yin, who was Chu Yi’s maternal uncle, was merely an obscure sixth-rank official. Therefore, even though Chu Yi held military power and was deeply trusted by the emperor, he had not aroused the jealousy of the empress or the crown prince...

Chu Yi rode his horse at the front.

Yun Chu followed in a carriage far behind.

Ting Sheng sat beside her, somewhat worried. "Madam, if you and the young prince and princess are too close, won’t the Prince of Pingxi misunderstand?"

"Should I not see Yu’ge and Changsheng just because he might misunderstand?" Yun Chu’s heart was also conflicted. "Changsheng is only four years old, but she has been ill for over three years. If she wants to see me, no matter how difficult it is, I must go."

The carriage moved slowly forward, passing through the busiest streets before turning into a small alley, finally arriving at the Yin residence.

Princess Yin had originally been a low-ranking palace maid, so it was clear that the Yin family was not a prominent aristocratic clan. Now that the Yin family had entered the court, it was all due to Princess Yin’s influence.

They understood the principle of moderation. After reaching the sixth rank, they did not seek further promotion, content to be idle minor officials who did not involve themselves in court disputes.

"Uncle, Aunt," Chu Yi dismounted and cupped his hands in greeting.

"Yi’er, today is truly strange," Madam Yin said. "That little rascal Yu’ge never comes back without chasing chickens, catching dogs, or climbing onto roofs, causing chaos everywhere. This time, he actually sat obediently in a chair drinking tea. He’s really grown up and become sensible. And Changsheng; she has never been willing to see outsiders since she was born. How come she was willing to come to the Yin residence today?"

Chu Yi was also secretly amazed.

Although Yu’ge was outgoing, he wasn’t the type to accept just anyone. It was indeed strange that he had taken a liking to Madam Xie.

And Changsheng, who was naturally reluctant to communicate with anyone, even her own father found it difficult to enter her heart, had somehow been easily remembered by Madam Xie...

As they spoke, the Xie family’s carriage slowly stopped at the entrance of the Yin residence.

Yun Chu, supported by Ting Sheng, stepped down from the carriage and bowed. "Your Highness, Lord Yin, Madam Yin."

Madam Yin, of course, recognized her as the legitimate daughter of the General’s residence and the current Madam Xie. Just as she was about to return the greeting, she heard hurried footsteps behind her. Immediately afterward, two exquisitely beautiful children rushed out from the gateway, one from the left and one from the right, both throwing themselves into Yun Chu’s arms.

"Mother!"

Chu Hongyu, not content with just being in Yun Chu’s arms, climbed up with his limbs, soon wrapping his arms around her neck.

The word "Mother" caused everyone nearby to freeze.

Even Chu Yi, who usually showed no emotion, had a look of surprise on his face.

Was "Mother" a title that could be used so casually?

The key point was that Madam Xie didn’t seem to find it strange at all...

Could it be that when Madam Xie was alone with the children, Yu’ge had been calling her "Mother" all along?

"Ah, this..." Madam Yin was flustered. "Isn’t this Madam Xie?"

Was she mistaken, or how could Madam Xie become the mother of these two children...

Or perhaps it wasn’t Madam Xie, but another miss from the General’s residence who resembled Madam Xie?

But the woman in front of them was dressed as a married woman, clearly someone who had already married. How could His Highness allow a married woman to be the mother of his children?

Yun Chu finally noticed the expressions on the faces of the people in front of her.

She suddenly realized that the title "Mother" should not exist at this moment.

She secretly pinched Chu Hongyu’s bottom.

Chu Hongyu coughed. "I mean, Aunt Yun looks like our mother..."

"I knew it," Madam Yin sighed in relief. "I’ve seen Madam Xie a few times before, so I knew I couldn’t be mistaken. Come, come, please come in. Someone, serve tea."

She led the way inside, with Yun Chu following behind.

She held Chu Hongyu in her arms and held Chu Changsheng’s hand.

Once they entered the courtyard and Yun Chu sat down, the little girl couldn’t wait to climb onto her lap, pushing Chu Hongyu away with all her might.

"Chu Changsheng, you’re being too much," Chu Hongyu protested, hands on his hips. "Aunt... cough, Aunt Yun has two legs and two arms. We each get half. Don’t push me again, humph!"

Yun Chu: "..."

With both children on her lap, their limbs wrapped around her neck and waist, she felt as if she were tied up with ropes.

But she knew this time was fleeting. In less than an hour, she would have to part with the children.

It was also at this moment that Madam Yin realized that Chu Yi had brought the children to the Yin residence to meet this Madam Xie.

chapters.title: Truly Foolish
chapters.content:
Soon, the two children finally quieted down and sat in their seats to eat snacks.

Madam Yin kept Yun Chu company with tea and said, "Yi'er is always away on business and rarely spends time with the children. It would be better if there were a princess consort, but Yi'er has a heart of iron and refuses to marry one, no matter what. It's a pity the children have no mother to dote on them."

Otherwise, why would they cling to Madam Xie and call her mother.

"His Highness must have his own considerations," Yun Chu knew that in her past life, the Prince of Pingxi had not married even at the age of thirty. If nothing unexpected happened, it would likely be the same in this life.

The children did need a mother, but no one could guarantee that a future princess consort would genuinely care for these two children.

The Prince of Pingxi must have considered this, which was why he had not married.

While the two women discussed this, Chu Yi and Lord Yin were also talking about it in the study.

"Yi'er, you are twenty-five this year. It's time to consider marriage," Lord Yin said after taking a sip of tea. "A few days ago, your aunt entered the palace, and Concubine Yin gave a list of names, asking for help in selecting a few women for you to consider. Your aunt was afraid you would be displeased and dared not handle this matter. It was fine when you refused before, but now, you've seen how much Yu'er and Changsheng need a mother's companionship. Are you going to have them see Madam Xie every time they miss their mother?"

Lord Yin shook his head. "Once or twice is fine; Madam Xie won't say anything. But over time, do you think Madam Xie will develop resentment? These are your children, Prince of Pingxi. Why should an unrelated person always be the one to comfort them? Furthermore, General Yun is on good terms with you. If you frequently invite Madam Xie to the Yin residence, and someone with ill intentions sees it, it might harm Madam Xie's reputation and affect your friendship with General Yun."

Chu Yi looked up.

Outside the window was the pavilion where Madam Yin and Yun Chu were sitting and drinking tea. The two children were squatting on the ground, playing with something.

Every so often, the children would look up at Yun Chu before continuing their play.

Changsheng, who had been gloomy these past few days, now showed no sign of resistance to communication. Her eyes sparkled, and a smile played at the corners of her mouth.

He could feel that Changsheng genuinely liked Madam Xie.

If Madam Xie were unmarried...

At this thought, Chu Yi was startled. How could he have such an idea?

He spoke, "I understand your good intentions, Uncle. Let's proceed according to my mother's wishes."

Lord Yin looked incredulous, then delighted, "Very well, very well. Once your aunt selects suitable women, their portraits will be sent for your approval."

Chu Yi drained the tea in front of him.

Seeing that it was about time, he finally left the study and walked to the pavilion.

Upon seeing him, Yun Chu realized that it was already almost evening. Time had passed so quickly while she was with the children.

"Your Highness, this concubine should take her leave," Yun Chu said. As soon as these words left her mouth, she felt two pairs of legs wrapping around her. Looking down, she saw the two children gazing at her with tearful eyes.

She crouched down and gently touched the children's heads. "Little Prince, Little Princess, it's getting late. You should go back too."

"No!" Chu Hongyu's nose twitched with emotion. "Aunt Yun, I don't want to go back. You shouldn't go back either. We want to be together forever!"

Although Chu Changsheng couldn't speak, she hugged Yun Chu tightly with her arms and legs, fully demonstrating her feelings through actions.

"Chu Hongyu, Chu Changsheng," Chu Yi said coldly, "What did you promise me when you invited Madam Xie?"

His voice was cold and sharp. As soon as the children heard him speak, they immediately let go of Yun Chu and stood obediently to the side, their big, dark eyes looking pitifully at Yun Chu.

Yun Chu forced a smile. "Little Prince, Little Princess, we'll see each other next time."

Her relationship with the children had been established. It should be easier to meet them in the future.

She steeling her heart, turned and walked away.

Chu Yi escorted her out, and Madam Yin quickly followed to avoid any improper appearances.

At the gate of the residence, Yun Chu turned and bid farewell once more.

"Thank you, Madam Xie, for coming," Chu Yi said. "This autumn, the list of students for the Imperial College will include the name of Madam Xie's eldest son."

Yun Chu understood immediately.

After Xie Shian topped the provincial examinations, he would naturally become a student at the Imperial College. However, because the Xie family had offended the Marquis of Xuanwu, and with the Marquis's interference, this opportunity was lost.

But now, since she had comforted the Prince of Pingxi's two children, out of gratitude, the Prince of Pingxi was willing to intervene and restore this opportunity to the Xie family.

Yun Chu lowered her head. "This concubine came because she likes the Little Prince and Little Princess, not to use the two children to gain anything. Your Highness's action insults my genuine affection for the children. I beg Your Highness to withdraw the offer."

Chu Yi frowned. "This is originally something that belongs to your Xie family."

"Gain it by fortune, lose it by fate. There is nothing in this world that originally belongs to anyone," Yun Chu said calmly. "If Your Highness truly wants to thank this concubine, then please take better care of the Little Prince and Little Princess. This concubine takes her leave."

With that, she turned and got into the carriage.

In the evening sun, the Xie family carriage slowly disappeared down the alley.

"Madam Xie is truly a gentle and generous person," Madam Yin couldn't help but say. "Yi'er, you should marry a wife like her."

Chu Yi shook his head. "Aunt, please don't say such things anymore."

Don't tarnish Madam Xie's reputation.

He walked into the courtyard and beckoned to the two children. "Come, let's go back."

Chu Hongyu reluctantly walked towards him. After a couple of steps, he noticed his sister wasn't following. He turned back and saw his sister lowering her head, playing with her hands. Her two hands moved around each other like flowers, an action she often did and could spend an entire day doing. It was quite unsettling.

He walked over and shouted, "Changsheng! Let's go home!"

Hearing the voice, the little girl slowly lifted her head. Her dark eyes turned sluggishly before she took her brother's hand and walked towards Chu Yi.

Chu Yi felt a pang in his heart.

Just a moment ago, Changsheng had been a lively little girl.

But as soon as Madam Xie left, she reverted to her usual self, always in a daze, as if she couldn't hear the outside world and had no reaction to anything.

Chu Yi crouched down. "Changsheng, let Father carry you."

The little girl tightly held onto Chu Hongyu's hand and didn't even glance at him.

He sighed. "Father promised that the kitten you wanted to raise has just been brought to the prince's residence. You can see it when we get back."

Only then did a hint of emotion flicker in Chu Changsheng's eyes as she reached out her small arms to Chu Yi.

He picked up the little girl.

In her world, there had only been her brother and the kitten. Now, there was also Madam Xie.

He spoke, "Changsheng, Yu'er, Father has decided to find a mother for you. You and Father will choose together."

"Let Aunt Yun be our mother!" Chu Hongyu said happily. "Yu'er and Changsheng both like Aunt Yun. Father, you will definitely like her too."

Chu Yi's expression remained calm. "She is already married. Choose someone else."

"Can't she marry again?" Chu Hongyu asked hopefully. "I really like her."

Chu Yi didn't say anything more.

He thought back to when he was fifteen and had followed General Yun on a campaign. She had stood on the city wall to see them off. Back then, she was only ten years old.

Five years later, he had returned to the capital with General Yun. As soon as they arrived, he had followed General Yun back to the Yun residence and attended her wedding.

Just like that, she was married.

Many things happened too quickly to think about, and there was no way to think about them.

---

chapters.title: The Palace is Not at Peace
chapters.content:
By the time the last trace of the evening glow had faded, Yun Chu had returned to the Xie residence.

The maids served dinner one by one. By the time the meal was finished, it was completely dark.

She went back to change into a short tunic and practiced some basic moves with Qiutong in the courtyard for half an hour, working up a sweat.

Tingxue had the servants bring hot water and prepared a bath for Yun Chu, scattering some dried flower petals into the bathwater.

As Yun Chu was undressing, Tingfeng came to report from outside the door, "Madam, the master and the eldest young master have arrived."

Her eyebrows furrowed slightly. What were these two doing here so late at night?

But recalling the Prince of Pingxi's words, she could guess it was probably related to the Imperial College quota.

She calmly said, "Tell them I am bathing. Any business can be discussed tomorrow."

Tingfeng nodded and left.

Yun Chu leaned back in the bath, casually picking up a book to read. When the water had cooled somewhat, she finally got up.

Tingshuang stood behind her, drying her hair. Once her hair was mostly dry, she put on her outer robe and lounged on the couch, continuing to read.

She hadn't been sleeping well lately and could only manage to fall asleep around the Hai hour (9-11 PM). Before sleep, she would read various kinds of books she hadn't read before.

"Madam, the master and the eldest young master have not left yet," Tingfeng entered and said softly. "Does Madam wish to see them?"

Yun Chu let out a cold, mocking laugh.

They came to her as soon as trouble arose, treating her like a lifeline.

A grown man of twenty-eight, running to his wife at every problem. Deep down, she despised Xie Jingyu.

Putting down the book and putting on her outer robe, she stood up and walked to the side hall. "Husband and An'er, what brings you here so late?"

As soon as she entered, Xie Jingyu caught the unique fragrance that belonged to her. Suppressing the tender feelings in his heart, he said, "I apologize for disturbing Madam's rest. It's just that this matter is truly too important."

Xie Shian took over, "Originally, I could study at the Imperial College, but because Marquis Xuanwu interfered, Father found out that the Chancellor of the Imperial College has removed my name from the list."

"Such a thing happened?" Yun Chu displayed just the right amount of indignation. "How can Marquis Xuanwu bully us like this? Our Hui'er was already ruined by him, and now he wants to ruin An'er too? His son, the Marquis's heir, merely grazed his finger, yet our Xie family has paid such a heavy price. Husband, you must submit a memorial to the Emperor. I refuse to believe the Emperor will ignore this!"

Xie Jingyu sighed, "The Emperor has recently taken a new concubine into his favor. He has no mind to attend to such matters."

The current Emperor was not exactly incompetent; his greatest flaw was his lechery. Once he took a fancy to a woman, he would shower her with favor for days and nights on end.

If he were to write about the Xie family's minor troubles in a memorial, even if the Emperor's study presented it to His Majesty, the Emperor probably wouldn't even glance at it.

"So what should we do?" Yun Chu asked, feigning urgency. "We can't let An'er's future be ruined like this."

"Father, Mother, please don't worry about me," Xie Shian lifted his head. "Not all top scholars and officials come from the Imperial College. While a teacher's guidance is important, I believe personal hard work and dedication are even more crucial. As long as I study hard and diligently, whether I am at the Imperial College or not, I will definitely achieve success and rise above others."

Yun Chu was filled with scorn.

If Xie Shian truly didn't care about the Imperial College quota, he wouldn't be waiting here for her late at night.

He said those words clearly as a retreat to advance, wanting her, as his legitimate mother, to willingly pave the way for him.

She looked up at Xie Shian. "An'er, it's rare to see you have such spirit. As you said, we won't go to that Imperial College. Let your father find you a famous teacher."

"Even the best teacher can't compare to the Imperial College," Xie Jingyu said with a complex expression. "Madam, the Yun family is a first-rank general's residence. Could An'er use the Yun family's quota to enter the Imperial College?"

Yun Chu lowered her gaze and took a sip of tea.

Xie Jingyu had said the exact same words as in her past life, except that in her past life, he had requested the Yun family to send the third young master, Xie Shiyou, to the Imperial College.

In this life, since Xie Shian had caused trouble, the request had come ten years early.

She still remembered that back then, when Xie Shian entered the Imperial College as the top scholar, she had taken the initiative to visit her aunt, Consort Yun, in the palace, requesting that Xie Shian become a study companion for the Eighth Prince.

Although both were studying at the Imperial College, becoming a prince's study companion meant access to completely different resources.

Back then, she had racked her brains to plan for Xie Shian. Now, recalling it, she wished she could slap herself to death. Truly foolish.

"Husband, what you say is reasonable," Yun Chu said. "But I still need to ask my elder brother for his opinion."

The Yun family had gradually achieved too much merit, so naturally, they would not send any children to the Imperial College to get involved in the royal power struggle. Otherwise, they would only die faster.

But why should the Yun family give what they don't want to the Xie family?

The next day, after Xie Jingyu returned from court, he came to Sheng Ju, hinting between the lines that Yun Chu should go to the Yun family soon to settle this matter.

Yun Chu delayed until the following day before returning to the Yun family.

Passing through the bustling market, she saw that a second ice shop had opened on the capital's streets.

She had to admit, Chen Defu was quick. She had only given the order the day before yesterday, and today it was already done.

The new ice shop's price was 2 taels and 200 copper coins per jin, which was much more expensive than the previous shop. As a result, business at the original shop suddenly picked up.

People on the street were discussing it animatedly.

"Such a swindler! Ice is just water, yet they sell it so expensively. What's the difference between this and robbery?"

"Which year hasn't it been expensive? Basically, it's always been 1 tael of silver per jin. It's just that this year, there's less ice, so the price has gone up to over 2 taels."

"It doesn't matter to us common folks anyway. We can't afford 1 tael, so who cares if it's expensive or not?"

...

Tingfeng muttered, "Even if they sell it at cost price, these common folks still can't afford it. What right do they have to call others swindlers?"

Tingshuang sighed, "Common folks only save about 3 taels of silver a year..."

For a wealthy family, one piece of ice was equivalent to a year's worth of firewood, rice, oil, and salt for a commoner.

Yun Chu looked thoughtfully out of the carriage window.

The bustling crowd was mostly ordinary, lower-class commoners.

In her past life, after the Yun family's downfall, it was these commoners who knelt in front of the imperial city, petitioning the Emperor to re-investigate the Yun family's case.

Although the Emperor had not taken the commoners' petition to heart, she still remembered the kindness the commoners had shown the Yun family...

"Tingshuang, later, tell Mr. Chen that starting from the scorching month of June, under the Yun family's name, set up a cooling pavilion. Every afternoon for two hours, place ice blocks there to create a place for the commoners to escape the heat," Yun Chu said slowly. "Also, increase the price of ice by a fixed amount every half month, with no upper limit."

As long as she did something for the commoners, they would remember and reciprocate when needed.

She didn't know if the Yun family in this life would face the same fate as in her past life, but she would make full preparations to deal with it and never let the tragedy happen again.

chapters.title: Concubine Rain’s Betrayal
chapters.content:
Two carriages were parked in front of the Yun residence.

Yun Chu sat in the front carriage, while the one behind was filled with ice blocks just retrieved from the warehouse.

Madam Lin’s heart ached at the sight. "Child, why are you wasting money like this? A whole carriage of ice must cost a fortune."

Though the Yun family held high rank and power, they were not particularly wealthy. Spending thousands of taels of silver on ice was, in Madam Lin’s eyes, an extravagant act.

"The Chen’s Ice Shop on the street, that’s mine," Yun Chu said. "If Mother needs ice, just send someone to fetch it."

Madam Lin was stunned. "So you’re the southern merchant who stockpiled ice in the third month?"

"This matter is between you and me," Yun Chu changed the subject. "Last time, the Xie family and Marquis Xuanwu had a falling out, which cost An’ge the chance to study at the Imperial College. If Big Brother doesn’t plan to send Jiang’ge to the Imperial College, why not give this opportunity to An’ge?"

Jiang’ge was Yun Chu’s eldest nephew, Yun Zhenjiang, the five-year-old son of her eldest brother, Yun Ze. Like Xie Shian, he was currently studying at Huai De Academy, a government-run school in the capital.

Madam Lin replied casually, "Your eldest brother didn’t go to the Imperial College, so naturally Jiang’ge won’t either. Since the spot is empty anyway, let An’ge take it."

Yun Chu knew no one in the Yun family would object, not even her sister-in-law, Liu Qiaoqiao. Everyone in the Yun family understood they were barred from the Imperial College, so they’d be more than happy to give up the spot.

In her past life, Xie Shiyou had been the one to benefit from this.

In this life, would she let Xie Shian get his wish?

A faint, deep smile curled on Yun Chu’s lips.

Madam Lin, smiling, brought up another topic: "Mei’jie’s marriage has been arranged."

Yun Chu was surprised. "So soon?"

"Mei’jie is already seventeen, how can we delay any longer?" Madam Lin said. "The Dai family’s son is nineteen. Other families’ children his age already have their own kids. The Dai family is anxious, and so are we. So we’ve set the wedding for autumn, which gives us enough time to prepare the dowry."

Yun Chu nodded and began discussing the dowry for her half-sister with Madam Lin.

After they had finished, Madam Lin lowered her voice: "Tomorrow, come with me into the palace to visit Imperial Concubine Yun."

Yun Chu detected the unusual tone. "Has something happened to Aunt?"

Madam Lin shook her head. "Wasn’t the Crown Prince ill a few days ago?"

Yun Chu knew about the Crown Prince’s illness, Xie Yuge had told her just yesterday when she visited the Yin family.

Originally, Prince Pingxi was supposed to go to Ji Province to suppress bandits, but because the Crown Prince was gravely ill, the Emperor ordered Prince Pingxi to stay in the capital.

At first, she hadn’t understood why the Crown Prince’s illness would keep Prince Pingxi in the capital. But now, seeing Madam Lin’s solemn expression, Yun Chu began to grasp the situation. The Crown Prince’s illness was likely man-made…

"Prince Xi visited the Eastern Palace, and then the Crown Prince started vomiting and having diarrhea. The imperial physicians found that the food Prince Xi had sent to the Eastern Palace was tainted." Madam Lin’s voice was barely a whisper. "The Emperor was furious and punished Prince Xi by sending him to Qing’an Temple outside the city to pray for the Crown Prince’s recovery… Now that all the princes in the palace are grown, some have developed… improper ambitions. The palace won’t be peaceful for years to come. Your grandfather asked me to enter the palace to advise Imperial Concubine Yun, to keep a close watch on the Eighth Prince and make sure he doesn’t get involved in these matters."

Yun Chu recalled this event from her past life. Prince Xi had been punished and sent to Qing’an Temple to pray. After the Crown Prince recovered, Prince Xi was allowed to return. Later, when the Crown Prince re-examined the poisoning, it was discovered that someone else was responsible. Prince Xi was cleared of suspicion, and the Emperor, realizing his mistake, bestowed many gifts upon him to make amends. That period had been the happiest and most comfortable time of Prince Xi’s life.

But less than half a year later, disaster struck.

Yun Chu stayed at the Yun residence, keeping General Yun company for dinner, before finally returning to the Xie family in her carriage.

A young servant waiting at the gate saw her return and hurriedly said, "Madam, you’re finally back! The master has been waiting for you."

Yun Chu asked calmly, "Where is the master?"

"At Anshou Hall," the servant replied respectfully. "Shall I have the master come to Shengju Pavilion instead?"

Yun Chu headed straight for Anshou Hall.

The entire Xie family was gathered there, waiting for news. The concubines were present too, and the room was lively.

"Chu’er, come sit." The old matriarch beamed. "What did Madam Yun and your eldest brother say about An’ge’s matter?"

Yun Chu took a sip of tea before speaking leisurely: "My eldest brother feels that because he didn’t attend the Imperial College, he only managed to pass the imperial examination as a third-class Jinshi. He regrets it deeply and plans to send Jiang’ge to the Imperial College once he turns eight."

The old matriarch’s smile gradually faded.

She had placed too much hope in this daughter-in-law. The greater the expectation, the greater the disappointment.

Xie Jingyu furrowed his brows slightly.

From what he knew of Old General Yun, there was no way he would allow the Yun family to have close contact with the imperial princes. How could he possibly send Yun Zhenjiang to the Imperial College?

Could it be that Imperial Concubine Yun planned to use the Yun family’s influence to help the Eighth Prince seize the throne?

At this thought, Xie Jingyu broke out in a cold sweat.

Though he relied on the Yun family, he had no intention of aligning with them to support the Eighth Prince. The Eighth Prince was far too young; it would be extremely difficult for him to claim the throne…

"But I advised my eldest brother," Yun Chu said, her face filled with relief as she looked at Xie Shian, "Jiang’ge is only five years old. We don’t even know if he’s good at studying or martial arts. Wouldn’t it be a waste to take this opportunity now? An’ge, on the other hand, is a true man of talent, well-versed in the classics and with a prodigious memory. The Imperial College should have a place for him."

Xie Shian’s face lit up with joy, though he quickly suppressed it. His voice trembled with barely contained excitement: "Thank you, Mother."

Only after losing this opportunity did he realize how precious it was.

And he never would have imagined that, between Jiang’ge and himself, his mother would choose him.

He would not let her down.

"Chu’er, you truly are the blessing of our Xie family," Yuan Shi said, filled with emotion. "Without you, An’ge’s life would have been ruined."

The old matriarch added, "Chu’er, An’ge will surely be filial to you and repay the Yun family in the future…"

Yun Chu exchanged a few casual words with the old matriarch before taking her leave from Anshou Hall.

Xie Jingyu followed her out. "Madam."

Yun Chu paused. "Does my husband have something else to discuss?"

"Earlier today, I saw a hairpin on the street that would suit you perfectly." Xie Jingyu took a butterfly jade hairpin from his sleeve. "Let me put it on for you."

Yun Chu glanced at it.

The hairpin was worth no more than ten taels of silver, suitable for a little girl, perhaps. She was already twenty and long past the age of being swayed by small gifts.

Her voice was indifferent: "This hairpin is indeed nice. Later, I’ll give it to Wa’jie. It would suit her better."

Xie Jingyu’s expression stiffened.

This was the first time in five years of marriage that he had bought her jewelry, and she had only given it a cursory glance before deciding to pass it on to someone else.

The heart he had offered her felt as if it had been thrown to the ground.

"If you have nothing else, I’ll take my leave."

Yun Chu turned away calmly, her figure quickly disappearing from the entrance of Anshou Hall.

Xie Jingyu clenched the hairpin tightly, his chest heaving violently.

"Master."

A soft, tender voice called out. Immediately after, his hand was taken, and the hairpin was slipped from his grasp.

He turned his head and saw Tingyu standing beside him.

---

chapters.title: Revoking Custody Rights
chapters.content:
Tingyu had mustered her courage to follow him.

She picked up the butterfly hairpin and said softly, "Master, I’ve served Madam since I was a child. I know what kind of jewelry and hairpieces she prefers. If you’d like, I can tell you all about it."

Xie Jingyu’s face was cold. "I don’t need to know these things."

If Yun Chu didn’t appreciate the gift, then he simply wouldn’t give her any more. One humiliation was enough.

"I don’t believe that, Master." Tingyu’s hand lightly rested on Xie Jingyu’s shoulder. "Madam has devoted herself to the Xie family’s interests. No matter what, you can’t truly neglect her. But these past five years, Madam’s heart has indeed grown cold. Why not come to my courtyard for a while? I know how to make Madam change her mind."

Xie Jingyu’s lips tightened.

He had to admit, Yun Chu had truly dedicated herself to the Xie family. She had even secured the Imperial College spot, originally meant for the Yun family, for An’ge.

What had he done in return? He had sent Yun Chu back to Marquis Xuanwu.

Marquis Xuanwu had oppressed the Xie family so harshly. Once the Xie family rose in power, he would never let the Marquis’s household off the hook.

But right now, he was the one who had wronged Yun Chu.

He did want her to soften her heart toward him. If she and he shared a deep marital bond, her heart would be even more aligned with the Xie family.

With this thought, Xie Jingyu turned and followed Tingyu to her small courtyard.

Tingyu lived in a secluded corner of the Xie residence. The front of her courtyard was planted with bamboo, giving it a unique charm.

Xie Jingyu followed her inside. He sat on a couch, while Tingyu stood before him, head lowered. "Ever since I was old enough to understand, I’ve served Madam. When she was young, she liked bright and colorful jewelry and clothes. Later, she began to prefer lighter colors, and her jewelry tastes became simpler…"

By the time Yun Chu returned to the residence, the sky had already darkened. It was nearly the end of the Xu hour, and the night outside grew deeper and darker.

Tingyu’s voice grew even softer. "It’s getting late, Master. Why not rest here for the night?"

Xie Jingyu had intended to refuse, but when he looked up at Tingyu’s face, he realized hazily that it had been a long time since he had stayed overnight in the rear courtyard.

In the past, he and He Shi had shared mutual affection, but ever since He Shi entered the Xie family as a servant and became Mama He, the spark between them seemed to fade. Even after she became a concubine, when he had every right to visit her at night, he had never once set foot in Bihe Garden.

Tingyu’s body softened, and she collapsed into Xie Jingyu’s embrace…

After their passion subsided, Tingyu lay on Xie Jingyu’s chest and whispered, "Master, there’s something I’m not sure if I should say."

Xie Jingyu’s voice was indifferent. "Just say it."

Tingyu hesitated before speaking: "A few days ago, Yun’ge saw a three-year-old boy in Shengju Pavilion…"

She had wanted to keep this secret for Madam, but why should Master adopt a child from the Yun family? It was unfair to the Xie family, and to Yun’ge.

Besides, the adoption would be exposed sooner or later. It was better for her to inform Master now so he could prepare.

"What did you say?" Xie Jingyu’s face showed disbelief as he sat up. "She wants to adopt a Yun family child into the Xie family?"

Throughout history, adopted children were always chosen from the husband’s clan. When had a wife ever been allowed to raise a child from her own family under her husband’s name?

If the Xie family truly adopted a Yun child, then the Xie family would become the biggest joke in the entire capital.

Tingyu also sat up. "Master, these were Madam’s own words to me. She ordered me not to tell anyone. Please, Master, observe quietly for now and don’t make a scene."

She feared that if Master confronted Madam, she would be caught in the middle.

Xie Jingyu placed a hand on her shoulder. "You are the one Madam trusts the most. I naturally won’t let you and her grow apart. I’ll have someone investigate this matter thoroughly."

Tingyu exhaled in relief.

The night passed silently.

The weather grew hotter, and dawn arrived earlier each day.

After washing up, Yun Chu was about to step outside when she heard Tingfeng speaking in the courtyard.

"Climbing into beds is something you’ve mastered, isn’t it?" Tingfeng stood in the courtyard, looking at Tingyu, who had come to pay her respects. Her eyes were full of ridicule. "It seems our Concubine Rain will soon bring another child to the Xie family. Let me offer my congratulations in advance."

Tao Concubine rubbed her pregnant belly and sneered. "Concubine Rain, you’re so skilled. With all the troubles in the Xie family, you still managed to invite Master to your own courtyard. Truly impressive."

Tingyu lowered her head. "As a concubine, it is my duty to serve Master. This is only natural."

She had merely kept Master with her for one night. Now, in the morning, none of the maids or servants dared to give her any trouble.

This was the Xie family, after all. As long as she maintained her hold on Master, her and Yun’ge’s days in the Xie residence wouldn’t be too difficult.

At that moment, Yun Chu stepped out, her expression indifferent. "Why are you all standing in the courtyard? Come in and sit."

Everyone took their seats in the side hall.

"In a few days, it will be Madam’s birthday," Yun Chu got to the point. "I’ve come to ask for your opinions on how to celebrate it."

Since the old matriarch was still alive, any birthday celebrations in the Xie family were kept low-key, with only family members present. The specifics of the celebration needed careful discussion.

The concubines each offered their own suggestions.

Yun Chu smiled. "Wa’jie, I’ll leave Madam’s birthday arrangements to you. This time, I’ll have Tingshuang assist you. What do you think?"

Xie Wa was overcome with gratitude. "Thank you, Mother, for giving me this opportunity. I won’t let you down."

"You don’t need to put too much pressure on yourself," Yun Chu said gently. "This is just a family gathering. Even if something goes wrong, it’s fine."

As they spoke, Xie Jingyu entered through the doorway.

His expression was grim, and he coldly ordered, "All of you, leave."

The concubines were taken aback. Master rarely showed such an expression, let alone direct it at Madam. What had happened?

Only Tingyu knew, Master must have found evidence of Madam’s intention to adopt a child from the Yun clan. He was here to confront her.

She hoped Madam wouldn’t blame her. She had done it for Yun’ge, so he could have a place in the Xie family… She was a mother. No matter what she did, her first consideration was always her own child. Madam would probably never understand that…

The people in the room filed out, and Tingshuang gently closed the door.

Yun Chu’s brows furrowed slightly. "What does my husband intend to do?"

"Lately, you’ve been frequently returning to the Yun family. Are you hiding something from me?" Xie Jingyu asked coldly.

Yun Chu’s voice turned icy as well. "My husband should just say what he means."

"Are you planning to adopt a child from the Yun family as our legitimate son?" Xie Jingyu got straight to the point. "I had someone look into it. There’s a three-year-old child in a branch of the Yun family who visited the main house a few days ago. Is he the one you want to adopt?"

Yun Chu’s face showed sheer disbelief. "Husband, have you lost your mind? The Xie family has so many children. Why would I adopt a child from the Yun family?"

chapters.title: The Fish Takes the Bait
chapters.content:
As soon as Tingyu returned to her own courtyard, Tingshuang followed closely behind: "Aunt Yu, the master wants you to go see him."

Tingyu's fingers tightened. The master had said he wouldn't let her and the mistress grow apart, but now he was summoning her. The mistress would surely guess that it was she who had informed on her.

How would she face the mistress in the future?

"Third Young Master need not come," Tingshuang said, "Aunt Yu, please."

Tingyu had no choice but to let go of her son and hand him to the wet nurse before following Tingshuang to Shengju Hall.

As soon as she entered, she sensed something was amiss. Climbing the steps and reaching the side hall entrance, she caught a glimpse of Yun Chu and Xie Jingyu sitting on the host seats, drinking tea, one on the left and one on the right.

Her heart suddenly lurched.

"Yun Chu, do you know why I called you here?" Yun Chu put down her teacup, her voice cold. "Will you say it yourself, or should I?"

Tingyu lowered her head, clenching her jaw: "This concubine does not understand what the mistress wants me to say."

"Yun Chu," Yun Chu said, her face filled with disappointment, "When you climbed into the master's bed behind my back, I thought it was because of your deep affection, so you did something inappropriate. Considering your years of service, I never blamed you once. I truly do not understand why you would sow discord between me and the master."

Tingyu quickly defended herself: "This concubine did not—"

"Was it not you who told the master that I planned to adopt a child from the Yun family into the Xie family?" Yun Chu's voice turned icy. "Did you or did you not say such things to the master?"

Her sharp words left Tingyu defenseless.

She knew she couldn't deny it. She had no choice but to harden her heart and say: "Mistress, this concubine thought such a big matter should be known to the master. I'm sorry, mistress, I should not have betrayed you. Please punish me."

She knelt down on the ground.

Yun Chu gave a small laugh: "I thought you were smart, but it turns out you're so foolish. The Yun family is of such high status, and the Xie family is so lowly. Do you think any child from a branch of the Yun family would willingly change their surname to Xie? Such an impossible thing, how could you speak of it so confidently to the master? And what's even more ridiculous is that my husband actually believed you."

Xie Jingyu's expression darkened.

Everyone knew it was good to enjoy the shade under a big tree, and the Yun family branches understood this principle well. Unless they had lost their minds, they would never give their sons to the impoverished Xie family.

How could he have believed Tingyu's baseless words?

He lifted his foot and kicked Tingyu's shoulder.

Tingyu was kicked backward, falling onto her back. She looked at Xie Jingyu in disbelief. The man who had been so tender with her last night was now being rough with her.

Kneeling on the ground, she sobbed: "Master, these were truly the mistress's own words to me. I did not lie. Even Young Master Yun saw a boy in the mistress's courtyard. Master, you may not believe me, but you can call Young Master Yun to ask. He would never lie."

Yun Chu's voice was cold: "You sowed discord between me and the master, and I could have let that go. But what you absolutely should not have done is teach Young Master Yun to lie. Young Master Yun is not even four years old. If he is taught to lie at such a young age, what kind of person will he become when he grows up? Will he follow in the footsteps of Young Master Wei? I dare not think about it."

"I did not teach Young Master Yun to lie!" Tingyu felt a sense of helplessness for the first time. She shouted, "Master, I truly did not. I am wronged..."

It dawned on her too late that this was all a trap.

The mistress had deliberately told her about wanting to adopt a child from the Yun family, deliberately let her go to the master to inform on her, deliberately set up this play.

And she had fallen into the mistress's trap without any defense, leaving no room for her own justification.

"Enough!" Xie Jingyu said coldly, "You were able to betray your mistress and climb into my bed before, so it's no surprise you would do something like this now. Wife, how should we deal with her?"

Yun Chu shook her head: "If the punishment is too light, she won't learn her lesson. If it's too heavy, she might resent me. Husband, you decide."

She looked at Tingyu kneeling on the ground with deep disappointment.

For the sake of their childhood friendship, she had given her a chance, but Tingyu had not cherished it at all and had betrayed her so quickly.

"You sowed discord between me and the mistress, clearly with ill intentions. So, you are fined half a year's allowance and must copy the Buddhist scriptures a hundred times to reflect on your actions," Xie Jingyu said slowly. "With such conduct, you are also unfit to raise Young Master Yun. Since Young Master Yun is registered under the mistress's name, he will live in Shengju Hall from now on. Wife, I will trouble you to discipline him."

His words were like a bolt of lightning exploding in Tingyu's mind.

Although all the children in the mansion were registered under the mistress's name, in reality, they were still raised by their birth mothers.

Only when Young Master Yun was first born, because the mistress had just lost her own child, did she personally take care of him for a while. Later, it was mostly Tingyu who raised him.

Now, the master's words meant that she would be separated from Young Master Yun, and she would no longer have the right to raise him...

"Master, this concubine truly did not lead Young Master Yun astray. Please, master, take back your order!" Tingyu panicked, but Xie Jingyu remained unmoved. She quickly crawled to Yun Chu: "Mistress, this concubine should not have betrayed you. I know I was wrong. Please, mistress, persuade the master to take back his order. Young Master Yun is still young and is used to my care. He cannot do without me..."

Yun Chu lowered her head and drank her tea, showing no reaction throughout.

"Someone, take Yun Chu back!" Xie Jingyu said coldly, "Bring Third Young Master to Shengju Hall."

The servants immediately went to carry out the order.

After Tingyu was dragged away, Yun Chu finally turned and said: "Husband, I have been busy with many things lately and really cannot find the time to discipline Young Master Yun. How about this: there is only He Concubine in the mansion who has no children. She has nothing to do all day and might start causing trouble out of boredom. Why not entrust Young Master Yun to He Concubine for discipline?"

Xie Jingyu thought seriously.

Although He Concubine had many flaws, it had to be admitted that An Ge'er's excellence was partly due to her efforts.

These past few days, He Concubine had been constantly talking about going to the estate to see Wei Ge'er. It was indeed time to find something for her to do to prevent her from causing trouble.

With this in mind, Xie Jingyu nodded: "Then we will follow the mistress's suggestion."

Yun Chu smiled.

With He Concubine and Tingyu scheming against each other, she could enjoy some peace for a while.

After lunch, Yun Chu prepared to go to the Yun family.

Hearing that she was going to enter the palace with Lin Shi, Xie Jingyu felt a surge of longing.

If the Xie family also had a woman enter the palace as a concubine, how good that would be. The emperor was most influenced by the whispers of his concubines. With a Xie family woman speaking for the family in the palace, the Xie family would not have fallen to such a state.

But the emperor was already fifty years old, and Xie Pin was only thirteen. At present, it was simply impossible.

Seeing Xie Jingyu's expression, Yun Chu knew what he was thinking.

In her previous life, after the Western Prince's incident, Xie Pin had given up on the idea of becoming the Western Prince's concubine and instead entered the palace to become one of the emperor's women.

She found it hard to believe that a teenage girl could have such grand schemes. There must have been Xie Jingyu pushing from behind, and perhaps Xie Shian had also contributed ideas.

Sending a girl of only a dozen years into the palace to be a concubine for an emperor in his fifties was something the Xie family was capable of.

---

chapters.title: Don’t Stop Me
chapters.content:
In the afternoon, the Yun family's carriage stopped at the palace gate.

Yun Chu followed Lin Shi out of the carriage, presented their palace passes, and only then did a young eunuch lead them into the palace through a side gate.

After walking through the long palace corridors, they finally reached the imperial harem. They had to first pay their respects to the empress before they could go to Concubine Yun's residence.

The two arrived at Kunning Palace. The towering and majestic palace walls were bustling with palace maids and eunuchs. After standing briefly at the palace entrance, an old matron came out to lead them inside.

"Subject wife and daughter pay respects to Her Majesty the Empress."

Lin Shi led Yun Chu in a graceful bow.

The empress was nearly fifty years old but had taken excellent care of herself. She looked kind and approachable. She had them rise and granted them seats.

"It has been peaceful in the palace lately. It has been a long time since I last saw Lady Yun," the empress said with a smile. "Lady Yun, you should come to Kunning Palace more often."

Lin Shi quickly replied: "This subject wife feared that coming too often would bother Her Majesty. Just now, there was a matter I wished to ask for Her Majesty's help. My daughter, Chu Er, has not been in good health since her premature birth years ago and has been unable to conceive. I have heard there is a divine physician treating Her Majesty. Would it be possible to ask the divine physician to diagnose my daughter?"

The empress had heard about this matter. Her gaze fell on Yun Chu with sympathy: "Poor thing, still so young, without a child. How will she spend the long years ahead? Lady Yun, rest assured. I will keep this in mind and arrange it as soon as possible."

Lin Shi was overjoyed: "Many thanks to Her Majesty the Empress."

The empress knew that their main purpose was to see Concubine Yun. After a brief chat, she let them go to Concubine Yun's residence.

Concubine Yun was one of the Western Consorts and had given birth to the Eighth Prince, so her living quarters were naturally not bad, with a large number of servants attending to her.

"Greetings to Concubine Yun."

Lin Shi and Yun Chu both saluted Concubine Yun.

Concubine Yun knew this was proper etiquette and did not stop them. After dismissing all the attending servants, she helped the two of them up.

"Sister-in-law, Chu Er, please sit," Concubine Yun sighed. "These past few days, the emperor has been preparing to take a new concubine, and the empress has been busy advising him, making the harem restless as well."

Lin Shi asked in surprise: "Is it the little palace maid he currently favors?"

Yun Chu did not feel the least bit surprised.

In the year she had died, the emperor was already over sixty years old and was still constantly taking new women to fill the harem.

The emperor's mind was entirely focused on the affairs of the harem, leading the front court to become increasingly chaotic. She did not know in the end on whose head the throne would fall.

"The Crown Prince is firmly seated in the Eastern Palace. The Second Prince, the Duke of Gongxi, is highly talented. The Third Prince, the Prince of Pingxi, holds military power. The Western Prince also received his title early," Lin Shi said. "The Fifth and Sixth Princes are also growing up. The factional struggles in the palace are gradually surfacing. Father's opinion is that the Eighth Prince should maintain a neutral stance and must not get involved in matters he should not."

Concubine Yun nodded: "I know all this."

Yun Chu spoke softly: "Aunt, if the Eighth Prince receives a title in the future, it would be better to send him to his fiefdom. Only then can he truly stay out of it."

In her previous life, her aunt and the Eighth Prince had never participated in the struggle for the throne, but in the end, the Eighth Prince was somehow schemed against and died in a hunting accident. Her aunt also fell victim to Xie Pin...

As long as the Eighth Prince bore the surname Chu, he would definitely not be able to escape this whirlpool.

If they couldn't win, then it would be better to go far away and never return to the capital. At the very least, they could preserve their lives.

Concubine Yun couldn't help but laugh: "Our Chu Er has grown up and is now giving advice to her aunt. However, the fiefdoms the emperor grants are all in the remote northwest and southern borders. It's too far away. I cannot bear to let Lao Ba go and suffer. If he stays by my side, I can at least protect him a little."

Yun Chu did not say anything more.

She was too young, and her words carried no weight. Naturally, her aunt would not listen to her.

There was still time. She would slowly persuade her. She believed her aunt would eventually see reason.

Yun Chu had not even stayed in the palace with Lin Shi for an hour before they took their leave. Sitting in the carriage, she looked up at the high palace walls and couldn't help but sigh.

Her aunt was confined here for life. She had entered the palace at the age of ten and had never been able to leave since.

Concubine Yun had given Yun Chu some beautiful palace flowers to take back. Upon returning to the Xie family, Yun Chu distributed these flowers to her two nieces, Xie Pin and Xie Xian.

"Mistress, Concubine Yu caused a commotion earlier," Tingxue came to report. "She found out that Third Young Master was sent to be raised by Concubine He and could not accept it. She rushed to Concubine He's room to take him back. The two of them quarreled, startling Third Young Master into wailing. Since you were not at home, the matter was brought to the Old Madam."

Yun Chu gave a cold laugh.

Tingyu had been reluctant to have Xie Shiyun registered under her name.

Previously, Concubine He had almost caused Concubine Tao to miscarry. How could Tingyu allow her own child to fall into Concubine He's hands? She was bound to make a big scene.

As for whether Concubine He would deliberately mistreat Shiyun, that was no longer Yun Chu's concern.

"The Old Madam knew this was the master's and mistress's joint decision, so she scolded Concubine Yu and did not pursue the matter further," Tingxue continued. "Earlier, Concubine Yu came to Shengju Hall but was scolded away by Tingfeng. Does the mistress wish to see Concubine Yu?"

Yun Chu curled her lips: "She brought this upon herself. She must bear the consequences."
