The next morning, Xie Pin came to discuss with Yun Chu the matter of Yuan Shi's birthday. The Xie family did not have many people, so they prepared two tables of food. After the meal, they arranged a tea party where the family could sit together, drink tea, play cards, and chat.

Yun Chu took a look and said: "You arranged the tea party in the Xie family's back garden. In this weather, sitting in the courtyard drinking tea will make everyone sweat."

Xie Pin spoke: "I will have someone buy more ice."

"Eldest Miss, that may not be possible," Tingshuang said. "Only two hundred taels of silver were allocated for Madam's birthday. If we buy ice, the expenses will exceed the budget."

Xie Pin sighed: "I don't know why the price of ice is so high this year. Two taels of silver for a catty of ice. Just for the Old Madam's room, two catties of ice are needed per day."

And this was only May. Summer had just begun. As time went on, the demand for ice would only increase.

Yet the silver in the public account was dwindling.

She said, "Mother, I will see where I can save some silver."

Yun Chu shook her head: "No matter how much we save, we won't be able to afford ice. Go to the Old Madam and ask her to send someone to the estate to request some silver from your grandfather. Otherwise, we won't be able to get through this summer."

In previous years, it was she who used her dowry to buy ice. This year, either the Xie family had to provide the money themselves, or the whole family would have to endure the heat. She was not going to concern herself with it.

Xie Pin lowered her head and accepted the order.

Yun Chu looked at her and said: "Recently, many bad things have happened to our Xie family. I originally planned to take you to Qing'an Temple to pray for blessings, to wish for smooth sailing for our Xie family. Who knew that yesterday, when I entered the palace, I learned that the Western Prince is staying at Qing'an Temple. After thinking it over, we should not go for now."

Xie Pin's head snapped up: "The Western Prince is at Qing'an Temple?"

Only she knew how many dreams she had had after seeing the Western Prince at the Grand Princess's residence.

She had once dreamed of becoming the Western Prince's consort. Later, she slowly realized that with her status, she was not even worthy of being a concubine to a prince.

It was so difficult for her to see the Western Prince, like scaling the heavens...

Upon hearing that the Western Prince was at Qing'an Temple, how could she resist? She quickly said: "Ordinary people wouldn't know the Western Prince is in the temple. We should go as planned. Mother, since you intended to go to Qing'an Temple to pray, then let's go. We just need to be careful not to run into the Western Prince."

Yun Chu's expression was a mix of amusement and disdain.

She had only slightly let out the bait, and the fish had already taken it.

How could such a foolish Ping Er have caused her aunt such a tragic fate in her previous life...

chapters.title: Journey to Qing'an Temple
chapters.content:
Yun Chu nodded in agreement to go to Qing'an Temple.

Xie Pin's mood instantly improved, her mind filled with thoughts of what to wear tomorrow.

However, there were still matters to attend to. She took the list to the Old Madam's Anshou Hall to request money: "...This summer, the price of ice has been too high. We spend at least five hundred taels of silver extra each month. The silver in the accounts is completely insufficient. My mother suggests asking Grandfather for more silver..."

The Old Madam glanced at the accounts. The silver spent made her heart ache.

But every expense seemed necessary; each had to be paid.

Originally, with Chen Defu managing the Xie family's business, they could earn five to six thousand taels of silver a year. Later, when He Xu took over the shops, that scoundrel embezzled all the silver from the shops, which also affected the business. It was said that He Xu frequented gambling dens every day, owed a lot of debts, and was eventually castrated and driven out of the capital by creditors.

Daring to owe money to a gambling den was like asking for a short life.

The Old Madam silently despised He Xu, then said, "Since Concubine Yu made a mistake, the ice ration for her courtyard is canceled. Concubine He has brought nothing but shame to the Xie family, so the ice for her courtyard is also canceled. Since these two have theirs canceled, Concubine Jiang's is canceled too. Concubine Tao is still pregnant, so she can have half a jin of ice per day."

Xie Pin fully agreed. This way, they could save nearly twenty taels of silver a day.

Although some expenses were saved, the Old Madam knew that some expenditures were unavoidable. She still sent someone to the countryside estate outside the capital to get the harvest from Xie Zhongcheng.

"Old Madam, why not let me go?" Concubine He entered from outside at some point, "It just so happens that Yun'er is in a bad mood. I can take him to the estate to relax."

The Old Madam glanced at her. As if she would go to the estate just to relax; clearly, she wanted to see Wei'er.

Wei'er had caused a catastrophic disaster, destroying the Xie family's foundation built over many years. Jing Yu had lost the favor of Minister Yu, and the future would be even more difficult.

Whenever the Old Madam thought of Wei'er, she was filled with anger. She coldly said, "A round trip to the outskirts takes almost the whole day. Yun'er is too young to endure such a journey. Since Jing Yu and Chu'er have entrusted Yun'er to your care, you should focus on that and not always think about things you shouldn't."

Concubine He's mouth turned bitter.

He was her own flesh and blood. How could she not think about him?

Wei'er had been at the estate for so many days. She didn't know if he was eating well, sleeping well, or if his leg injury was healing...

She just wanted to see him, just one glance. Why wouldn't the Old Madam even grant this simple request?

She wanted to say more, but Xie Pin glared at her, forcing her to swallow her words.

After leaving Anshou Hall, Xie Pin coldly said, "Wei'er almost destroyed our entire Xie family. By mentioning him in front of the Old Madam, you are stabbing her in the heart. If you still want to stay in the Xie family, don’t bring up Wei'er again. Rest assured, this time the Old Madam has arranged for someone to go to the estate. I will give them some silver to check on Wei'er."

Concubine He knew she had no choice but to accept this. She helplessly nodded.

"And—" Xie Pin lowered her voice, "I... I am going to Qing'an Temple with my mother tomorrow."

Concubine He said, "Remember to pray for safety and good fortune for An'er and Wei'er. All I want now is for the three of you to be safe and sound."

"Prince Xi, the Prince of Anjing, is staying at Qing'an Temple for a short time." Xie Pin's eyes sparkled with a strange light, "Auntie, what do you think—"

As soon as Concubine He saw her eyes, she knew what she was planning. She quickly covered Xie Pin's lips and pulled her into a small grove: "Pin Jie'er, don't be reckless. He is Prince Xi!"

"But I know he is Prince Xi, which is why I want to do this." Xie Pin gritted her teeth, "Auntie, I need your help. Do you have that kind of medicine? Give it to me."

Concubine He's eyes almost popped out: "Have you gone mad? You really have gone mad! You are not even of age yet. Do you know the consequences of doing this?"

"Prince Xi also has feelings for me." Xie Pin bit her lower lip, "That day at Princess Zhang's residence, he picked up my handkerchief for me and even put a flower in my hair... If there is something substantial between us, he will definitely take responsibility for me. If he is a man of honor, he will make me his concubine."

"Unless you are the legitimate daughter of a madam, you could possibly become Prince Xi's concubine." Concubine He mercilessly shattered her dreams, "Moreover, do you know why Prince Xi is staying at Qing'an Temple?"

Xie Pin shook her head.

As long as Prince Xi was at Qing'an Temple, that was enough. She didn't need to know the reason.

That was a place anyone could go. This was her only chance to meet Prince Xi.

No matter what, she had to make this happen.

Even if Prince Xi was not a man of honor, she could at least enter the Prince of Anjing's residence. If she couldn't be a concubine, she could still be a lower-ranking concubine.

"Auntie, don't try to persuade me. I have already decided." Xie Pin's eyes were firm, "Moreover, you yourself became a concubine this way, so why stop me? If you don't help me, I will do it myself."

Concubine He grabbed her hand: "Pin Jie'er, I beg you as if I were your mother, let's not do this, okay? Marrying someone of a similar status and becoming the mistress of the household isn't good enough?"

"Xie Pin turned her gaze, "Auntie, do you know why An'er studies so hard? He wants to stand high, to have the ability to clear our external family's name. If I can enter the Prince of Anjing's residence, it will be a great help to An'er. Very soon, we can restore our external family's reputation..."

Concubine He's grip on her hand slowly loosened.

She closed her eyes, remembering the flourishing scenes of her family when she was a child...

She also wished more than anything to return her entire family to that former prosperity...

"Please help me." Xie Pin spoke slowly, "If we can clear our external family's name, then I will have the qualifications to become the Princess of Anjing. It's only a matter of time."

"Alright!"

Concubine He nodded heavily.

She didn't have many people she could use, so she could only seek out the young nun she had some connection with and ask the nun to find a way to do this.

The nun arrived at Sheng Ju and informed Yun Chu of this matter.

Yun Chu smiled: "Do as she says."

It was indeed unexpected that Concubine He would actively help Xie Pin with such a thing.

After the young nun left, Yun Chu wrote a letter and handed it to Tingshuang: "Send this to the Ji residence immediately and give it to Madam Ji."

Madam Ji was the eldest daughter of the Minister of Justice, Du Ling, whose maiden name was Du. She and Yun Chu were born in the same year, and the two had known each other since childhood as they accompanied their mothers to various banquets.

However, after they each got married, Du Ling married into a high-ranking family while Yun Chu married into a humble one. The banquets they attended were different, and gradually, they lost contact.

But she knew that in her past life, after the Yun family was imprisoned, Du Ling's father, Minister Du of the Ministry of Justice, did not use torture on any member of the Yun family.

Yun Chu remembered every bit of kindness shown to the Yun family, no matter how small, and kept it in her heart.

After being reborn, apart from protecting the Yun family, she also wanted to do what she could.

She hoped to protect Du Ling's only younger sister, the would-be Princess of Anjing from her past life...

---

chapters.title: Xie Pin Disappears
chapters.content:
Yun Chu woke up at dawn.

Xie Shian came early to pay his respects and then left for Huai De Academy to study.

He would probably study at Huai De Academy for a few more months. By the autumn of the ninth month, he would be able to enter the Imperial College and become a classmate of the princes and noblemen.

As he walked out of Sheng Ju, Yun Chu could see his departing figure exuding youthful vigor.

She smiled. Xie Shian was still too young after all. If it were the Internal Cabinet Minister Xie from over a decade later, she would definitely not be his match.

Soon after, the concubines and children from the rear courtyard arrived. Xie Pin was dressed in bright purple and red, with a gold hairpin in her hair, a pair of pearl earrings, and two crystal-clear jade bracelets on her wrists.

"Isn't Eldest Miss going to Qing'an Temple with Madam?" Concubine Tao looked her up and down, "Isn't it disrespectful to Buddha to dress like this when going to a temple?"

Yun Chu's expression was calm: "Many female believers seeking romantic matches dress like this. It should be fine. However, there are too many accessories. Remove a couple."

Xie Pin secretly glared at Concubine Tao.

She had the maid remove the gold hairpin from her hair and took off the earrings and bracelets, placing them in the maid's hands.

Yun Chu stood up: "Since it's still early, let's go."

Xie Pin followed behind her out.

Concubine He watched them leave, her heart feeling as if it had been thrown into a pot of boiling oil. She clasped her hands together and prayed silently in her heart.

A carriage had already been prepared at the gate of the Xie residence. Yun Chu and Xie Pin got into the carriage one after another, and the carriage slowly made its way to the city gate.

When they reached the city gate, the carriage stopped.

Xie Pin asked uneasily, "Mother, are we not going to Qing'an Temple anymore?"

"We have an appointment with Madam Ji to go together." Yun Chu smiled, "You also know Madam Ji. We met her at the Yun family's spring banquet last year."

Xie Pin felt a pang of jealousy.

Madam Ji was the eldest daughter of Minister Du of the Ministry of Justice, married to the eldest son of the Grand Secretary of the Hanlin Academy. Although her status was not as high as the royal family, it was still one of the most prominent families in the capital.

Her mother must only know high-ranking noblewomen like her.

If her external family had not fallen, she would have been born into a high-ranking family as well, and the people around her would all be daughters of noble families...

As Xie Pin was lost in thought, Tingshuang's voice came from outside: "Madam, Madam Ji has arrived."

Yun Chu lifted the carriage curtain and looked at the opposite carriage. A bright and beautiful smiling face appeared at the window: "Mrs. Xie, long time no see."

Yun Chu also smiled. If counting from her past life, she and Du Ling had not seen each other for over a decade.

After exchanging greetings, the carriage finally set off toward the outskirts of the city. After about half an hour, they finally arrived at Dayan Mountain outside the city. Qing'an Temple was built halfway up the mountain.

After getting out of the carriage, Du Ling walked towards Yun Chu and coldly snorted: "Ever since you got married, I invited you so many times, but you refused every time. Even the last time we met was because of the Yun family's spring banquet. I am, after all, the wife of the eldest son of the Grand Secretary of the Hanlin Academy. Mrs. Xie, you really give me no face at all."

Yun Chu liked her lively demeanor.

After marrying into the Xie family, she had lost her child and her ability to have more children. Her husband also treated her coldly. Her life gradually lost its hope, and she had no desire to meet old friends.

"Ling Ling, don't use 'Mrs. Xie' to mock me anymore." Yun Chu pulled her hand, "It was my fault before. I will change."

The single word "Ling Ling" brought the two of them much closer. Du Ling sighed: "Chu Chu, the Guanyin of Qing'an Temple for praying for children is very effective. Many women have become pregnant after praying. Let's go in."

Du Ying stood in front of Yun Chu and said, "Sister Yun, do you want to learn how to make pomegranate knots? It's very simple. I'll teach you later."

Yun Chu smiled in gratitude.

Du Ying was skilled in embroidery. Even the Empress praised her pomegranate knots. So, Yun Chu used the excuse of wanting to learn pomegranate knots to write to Du Ling.

The pomegranate knot symbolized many children and blessings. She knew that Du Ling felt sorry for her childlessness and would definitely bring Du Ying to the meeting.

Xie Pin followed behind them, her jealousy growing stronger.

Now, her mother was just the wife of a fifth-rank official, yet Madam Ji was still on such good terms with her. This kind of friendship made her envious.

The noblewomen she usually knew were daughters of fifth, sixth, or seventh-rank officials. She was too lazy to befriend them, so she had no close friends.

The group entered the temple.

Qing'an Temple was the most popular temple near the capital, with a constant stream of devout men and women coming to pray.

After reaching the temple gate, they had to queue to enter. Yun Chu donated two hundred taels of silver as incense money, and a young monk led them straight in.

The incense smoke curled, and the great Buddha statue was solemn. Yun Chu knelt on the prayer mat and kowtowed sincerely.

She was not praying for a child but for the Yun family to have a smooth life in this lifetime and for her two children who had died young to be reborn into a good family...

Xie Pin silently prayed for everything to go smoothly. This was the boldest thing she had ever done in her life. She hoped Buddha would grant her wish...

After the prayer, the group stood up. Yun Chu smiled: "Ling Ling, let's have a vegetarian meal before we leave."

Du Ling also had many things she wanted to say to Yun Chu, so she naturally nodded. The group followed the young monk to the back courtyard of the temple.

The back courtyard of Qing'an Temple was quite spacious, as it often received many noble and high-ranking families. However, at the entrance of a door on the east side of the corridor, two guards stood watch.

Du Ying asked curiously, "Those look like imperial guards. Which noble has come?"

Du Ling shook her head.

With her status, of course, she knew who was staying there. But if her younger sister found out that Prince Anjing was confined to Qing'an Temple, her heart would surely break.

Xie Pin glanced at the door a couple of times and secretly memorized its location.

The group entered the side room arranged by the young monk. As soon as they went in, Xie Pin said, "I saw many peonies blooming in the back courtyard. Miss Du, why don't we go take a look?"

Du Ying was two years older than Xie Pin and also had a childish temperament. Unable to sit still in the side room, she immediately nodded and followed Xie Pin to the back courtyard to appreciate the flowers.

"Little Ying is fifteen years old now, right?" Yun Chu asked, "Has her marriage been arranged?"

Du Ling spoke, "Two years ago, the Emperor had my father take Prince Anjing to the Ministry of Justice for training. Because of this, Prince Anjing frequently visited the Du family. Somehow, Little Ying took a liking to Prince Anjing... But I heard that the Crown Prince's serious illness was related to Prince Anjing, which is why he was sent to Qing'an Temple. Now, the Emperor is still in his prime, yet such turmoil has already arisen. Who knows what other troubles lie ahead? Recently, Noble Consort De tried to sound out my mother, hoping to marry Little Ying into the Prince of Anjing's residence. My mother pretended to be ignorant and muddled through it. We can't let Little Ying know about this, or she will surely make a fuss..."

Yun Chu sighed.

As the saying goes, parents cannot resist their children's wishes. Indeed, no matter how much Madam Du opposed it, Du Ying was determined to marry him.

Around June or July of this year, Noble Consort De would request the Emperor to bestow the marriage. However, before Du Ying could marry into the Prince of Anjing's residence, Prince Xi would die in a hunting accident in the autumn.

On the day the Emperor was assassinated, Prince Xi, the prime suspect, disappeared. When Prince Xi was found months later, he was already a corpse...

Du Ying refused to believe that Prince Xi would assassinate the Emperor. She couldn't accept that her fiancé had died like this. She threw herself against Prince Xi's coffin.

Yun Chu couldn't understand how a mere man could make Du Ying abandon her parents, abandon her entire family, and die young for love...

chapters.title: Do You Deserve It?
chapters.content:
Yun Chu and Du Ling chatted for a long time.

From childhood anecdotes to the troubles after marriage, they talked about everything, and the more they talked, the more they had to say.

At this moment, the young monk led people to serve the vegetarian meal. A table of more than a dozen dishes, all vegetarian, yet each was made with excellent color, aroma, and taste.

Du Ling was about to send a maid to fetch Du Ying and Xie Pin back when suddenly, Du Ying rushed in from the entrance, panicked. "It's not good, Sister Yun, Miss Xie is missing!"

Yun Chu stood up. "Xiao Ying, don’t panic. What do you mean by missing?"

"After Miss Xie and I admired the peonies, we both wanted to ask Buddha for another fortune slip, so we went to the front together," Du Ying replied. "After I drew my fortune and came out, I couldn’t find Miss Xie anymore. The maid and I searched the front and the back, but we couldn’t find any trace of her."

Du Ling’s expression changed. "Last time, after Prince Pingxi defeated the bandits, some remnants were still at large. I heard that several farm girls outside the city have gone missing. Could it be—"

"It shouldn’t be." Yun Chu remained calm. "Qing’an Temple is full of people. Bandits wouldn’t dare to abduct someone here. Sister Pin is playful; she probably just lost her way. Let’s go out and look for her."

They no longer had the mind to eat. Everyone hurried out to search for Xie Pin.

The backyard of Qing’an Temple was vast, with several small courtyards specifically for receiving high-ranking officials. Since it wasn’t a festival, most of the courtyards were empty. Yun Chu was about to search each courtyard one by one when two guards rushed over from the east corridor, clearly looking for someone.

"Madam Ji, Madam Xie." The two guards didn’t recognize everyone, but the two ladies before them, one was the daughter of the Minister of Justice, and the other was the daughter of a great general, were naturally familiar to them. They quickly bowed and asked, "Have the two ladies perhaps seen Prince Anjing?"

Du Ying’s eyes lit up. "Prince Anjing is also at Qing’an Temple?"

Du Ling shot her sister a look of exasperation. How could she be so overjoyed just at the mention of Prince Anjing’s name?

She spoke up, "Prince Anjing’s disappearance is no small matter. Hurry and have the abbot arrange for people to help search."

The two guards had initially held a glimmer of hope, but thinking of the bandits still at large outside the city, if something happened to Prince Anjing, their heads would roll.

They were about to go to the front courtyard to find the abbot.

Yun Chu frowned. "There seems to be a noise in this courtyard."

This was an empty small courtyard. As soon as they entered, they saw a side room, the noise was coming from inside.

"That’s His Highness’s voice." The two guards exchanged a glance, seeing the joy of survival in each other’s eyes. They hurried toward the side room.

Without a second thought, Du Ying followed the guards.

It had been a long time since she had seen Prince Anjing. She never expected to meet him at Qing’an Temple. Had Buddha heard her earlier prayer?

Du Ling turned to Yun Chu. "Since we’ve encountered Prince Anjing, we should pay our respects first, lest His Highness later accuse us of being rude."

Yun Chu’s heart was as clear as a mirror.

She followed along.

As they got closer, the noise became clearer.

"Pin’er, the fact that you came to see me at this time proves your sincerity. I will not let you down..."

Then came a soft female voice.

"Ever since that day we met, Pin’er has deeply admired Your Highness. To be able to spend even this short time with you is a blessing from my past life."

Prince Anjing pulled Xie Pin into his embrace in one motion.

The crown prince was gravely ill, and all evidence pointed to him. For no reason, he had been exiled to this temple by the emperor. Eating vegetarian every day was one thing, but not even having a woman by his side was unbearable.

Originally, he had been a man of nightly revelry and daily leisure.

Now, living such a dry and dull life, he truly couldn’t endure it any longer.

Seeing the pretty young girl before him, how could he restrain himself? He reached out and stripped the clothes from Xie Pin’s shoulders...

Rustling sounds came from the side room.

Du Ling suddenly understood. She turned to look at Yun Chu.

Before she could read any emotion on Yun Chu’s face, she saw Du Ying dash up the steps in a flash.

She reached out to grab Du Ying but missed.

Du Ying raised her hand and pushed open the door to the side room with force.

When she saw the scene before her, her fair, delicate face turned deathly pale in an instant.

"Your Highness... you..."

Her voice caught in her throat, as if someone was forcefully choking her.

She stared at Prince Anjing, her eyes slowly shifting from disbelief to utter disappointment...

Just a few months ago, under the moonlight, they had admired the flowers and the moon together. He had said he would ask the virtuous consort to bestow a marriage, that he would not betray her sincerity.

But how long had it been? Yet here he was, holding another girl, whispering sweet nothings, doing such shameless things...

Prince Anjing was just embracing Xie Pin on the couch when the door was suddenly pushed open. Sunlight streamed in from outside, momentarily blinding him.

It took him a while to adjust before he finally saw who had entered.

He quickly pulled over a thin blanket to cover himself.

Xie Pin, in a panic, scrambled to pick up her long skirt from the floor and held it to her chest.

Du Ying wanted to say something, but Du Ling yanked her back sharply and whispered, "This has nothing to do with you. Shut up."

The emperor had not bestowed the marriage, and the Du family had not discussed marriage with Prince Anjing, let alone exchanged birth dates. No matter who Prince Anjing was with, it was none of the Du family’s concern.

Du Ying was pulled outside, tears streaming down her face.

"This humble wife greets Prince Anjing." Yun Chu spoke coldly. "I wonder if Prince Anjing can give me an explanation?"

Prince Anjing had already calmed down by now.

Although being caught in such an act was somewhat embarrassing, he was a prince. Who dared to say a word against him?

He lifted his eyelids and looked at Yun Chu. "Oh, so it’s Madam Xie. Since Madam Xie has seen it, I might as well tell the truth. I and Miss Xie are deeply in love, and I intend to take her as a concubine. What does Madam Xie think?"

Xie Pin, half-sitting on the couch, suddenly looked up.

A concubine... Prince Anjing only wanted her as a concubine?

In a prince’s harem, women had ranks. The highest was the princess consort, then the secondary consort, then the tertiary consort, and the lowest was the concubine.

Her expectations were not high. As long as she could be given the status of a tertiary consort, she would be satisfied...

She and Prince Anjing were here, and she hadn’t even used the aphrodisiac given by Madam He. Yet His Highness had been moved by her. She had thought he felt differently about her.

But this concubine status made her suddenly realize: if it weren’t for her mother and Madam Ji bursting in, after Prince Anjing had taken her, she might not even have been granted the status of a concubine... This realization made Xie Pin unable to help but cry.

"What a fine display of mutual affection," Yun Chu said, her angry face breaking into a smile. "If Miss Xie is crying like this, I hardly think it’s willing! If Prince Anjing truly cherishes Miss Xie, he should send matchmakers to her door. Even if he only wants her as a concubine, it should be done properly. This is Qing’an Temple, beneath Buddha’s feet. Prince Anjing, disregarding Miss Xie’s wishes and committing such an act of defilement in a sacred place, what’s the difference between you and the bandits in the mountains? Not to mention, Miss Xie has not even come of age! This matter, I will demand an explanation!"

---

chapters.title: Only One Path
chapters.content:
Yun Chu stepped forward.

She grabbed Xie Pin’s wrist and led her out.

"Mother..."

Xie Pin cried so hard her legs went weak.

If she left like this, all her plans and schemes would be ruined. Her reputation would be destroyed, and her life would be over...

"Madam Xie, please wait."

Prince Anjing called out angrily.

He was currently being punished at Qing’an Temple. The emperor had ordered him to reflect on his mistakes here and copy Buddhist scriptures daily to calm his mind.

If his affair with Miss Xie in a temple was exposed to the emperor, his father would certainly not let him off so easily. He might never be allowed to return to the capital in this lifetime.

Yun Chu’s footsteps paused. Without turning her head, she said, "Although my Xie family is only a fifth-rank household, and an ant cannot shake a tree, no matter the cost, the Xie family will seek justice for our daughter!"

Prince Anjing clenched his fists.

Although the Xie family was nothing special, Madam Xie’s maternal family, the Yun family, was someone even the emperor feared to some extent. How could he dare to act recklessly?

He took a few deep breaths, exhaling the frustration in his chest, and stepped out the doorway. Just as he was about to speak to Yun Chu, his peripheral vision caught sight of Du Ying standing on the steps below, her eyes red from crying.

If nothing unexpected happened, his birth mother would ask the emperor to bestow a marriage between him and Du Ying.

But now, that was probably ruined.

Fortunately, there were countless noble ladies in the capital. He didn’t have to marry a Du family girl.

What was most urgent now was to appease Madam Xie.

"Madam Xie, you speak too harshly." Prince Anjing ignored Du Ying and walked up to Yun Chu. "I never forced Miss Xie. It was Miss Xie who invited me to meet in the side room. My feelings for her are sincere. In a moment of passion, I acted inappropriately. This is indeed my fault. What can I do to make Madam Xie less angry?"

Yun Chu’s expression was cold and severe. "My Xie family’s eldest legitimate daughter has not yet come of age. Even if Prince Anjing were to plead guilty with a branch of thorns on his back, this humble wife’s anger would not be appeased. Prince Anjing need not say more. We will discuss this further at the Ministry of Justice!"

Prince Anjing’s face darkened. She wanted to take this to the Ministry of Justice?

He slightly turned his eyes and saw the Du sisters. His first thought told him that Madam Ji of the Du family would certainly be willing to testify.

At that time, the charge of forcing himself on an underage girl would surely be pinned on him.

He had already angered the emperor. Adding this charge, he might be exiled far away to his fiefdom.

While he was lost in thought, Xie Pin cried even harder.

If this really went to the Ministry of Justice, then everyone in the capital would know she had lost her chastity. Who would dare marry her then...? It would be better to just be Prince Anjing’s concubine and then slowly scheme later...

She reached out to grab Yun Chu’s sleeve, sobbing, "Mother, I am willing..."

"There is no room for you to speak here." Yun Chu said coldly. "Tingshuang, take the young lady to the next side room to tidy up."

Without another word, Tingshuang pulled Xie Pin away.

Xie Pin’s tears had dried up. Because she was not her mother’s biological daughter, her mother didn’t care about her life or death at all...

"Madam Xie, I am willing to grant Miss Xie the position of secondary consort." Prince Anjing lowered his head. "I hope Madam Xie will calm down."

The position of a prince’s secondary consort was not something any woman could easily obtain. Because it had to be recorded on the imperial jade tablet, it required the queen’s approval to be finalized.

By offering the position of secondary consort here, it was enough to prove his sincerity.

But Yun Chu shook her head. "My Xie family’s eldest legitimate daughter was raised to be the mistress of a household, observing all rules and etiquette. If not for Prince Anjing’s coercion, my daughter would never have done something so shameful as to bring disgrace to the family!"

Prince Anjing’s face showed utter disbelief.

Madam Xie’s tone was far too bold. How dare she demand the position of princess consort?

A daughter of a fifth-rank official, and seemingly born of a concubine, merely a foster daughter registered under the main wife’s name, she wasn’t even qualified to be a secondary consort, yet she dared to covet the position of the main consort?

Xie Pin, who had been taken to the side room, was completely stunned.

Her mother was actually trying to secure the position of princess consort for her? Was she crazy?

Secondary consort was already more than enough. If she pushed too far and angered Prince Anjing, causing the negotiations to collapse, then she would truly be finished...

"Madam Xie, let me tell you something: a greedy heart leads to ruin." Prince Anjing referred to himself as "this prince" again, lifting his head and becoming overbearing. "Some things that don’t belong to you, don’t even think about them!"

Yun Chu curtsied. "Then this humble wife and my daughter will take our leave."

She walked to the door of the side room, took Xie Pin, and left the backyard of Qing’an Temple without looking back.

The Du sisters also had no mind to stay any longer. Everyone left the temple and silently walked down the mountain. After a long time, they finally reached the foot of Wild Goose Mountain.

Tingshuang helped Xie Pin into the carriage. Du Ying, with the help of her maid, also got into the Du family’s carriage first.

Du Ling looked at Yun Chu with a complicated expression.

Just now, standing outside the side room, she hadn’t said a word because she felt that today’s matter seemed to be part of Yun Chu’s scheme.

But in her impression, Yun Chu was a simple and passionate woman who would never stoop to such calculations. This was not the Yun Chu she knew.

But no matter what, today’s incident had severed her younger sister’s hopes. No matter what Miss Xie ended up with, the Du family would never have any further connection with Prince Anjing.

"Chu Chu, if you decide to take this to the Ministry of Justice, I will testify for you," Du Ling said slowly. "I hope you get what you want."

Yun Chu took her friend’s hand. "Ling Ling, today’s matter was not my intention, but since it has come to this, I can only ask you to apologize to Xiao Ying on my behalf."

Du Ling shook her head. "Xiao Ying won’t blame you. Alright, it’s getting late. Let’s return to the city."

She turned and got into the carriage.

Yun Chu pressed her lips together.

Du Ling was a smart woman. She would definitely see that today’s matter was not simple.

Although the Du family did not covet the position of princess consort, there was a difference between not wanting it themselves and being schemed out of it by others.

Moreover, she had used Du Ling as a witness to force Prince Anjing into a disadvantageous position...

It seemed that in this lifetime, her relationship with Du Ling would end here.

But it didn’t matter. As long as Du Ying gave up on Prince Anjing, she wouldn’t foolishly sacrifice herself for love again.

Even if life were to start over, not everything would go as wished, right?

Yun Chu boarded the carriage.

Before the carriage could move, Xie Pin, sitting beside her, knelt on the floor and grabbed the hem of Yun Chu’s dress.

"Mother, please save me..." Xie Pin’s voice was hoarse from crying. "I’m not worthy of being a princess consort. Prince Anjing won’t agree, the virtuous consort won’t agree, and the imperial family won’t agree... I’m willing to be a secondary consort. Please, Mother, don’t take this to the Ministry of Justice..."

Yun Chu kicked her away with one foot. "After all your schemes, is it just for a mere secondary consort position?"

Xie Pin’s pupils suddenly contracted. As soon as she met Yun Chu’s gaze, she understood, her mother knew everything she had done.

"You should be grateful that Madam Ji and I arrived early. Otherwise, once the deed was done, and Prince Anjing lost interest in you, he could have accused you of seduction. Do you know what the consequences would be?" Yun Chu spoke each word clearly. "At best, you’d be given a cup of poisoned wine. At worst, the entire Xie family would suffer because of you. Do you deserve that?"

chapters.title: Change the Perspective
chapters.content:
The carriage stopped at the entrance of the Xie residence.

Xie Pinji cried so hard she nearly fainted. Supported by two maids, she stepped out of the carriage and into the Xie residence. As soon as she entered, He Shi emerged from the side.

This morning, He Shi had been restless, waiting anxiously. Finally, Xie Pinji returned, but seeing her in such a state, He Shi knew something terrible had happened. She quickly asked, "Madam, what happened to Eldest Miss? What occurred?"

"Madam He, you've come at the right time," Yun Chu said coldly. "Please go and invite the Old Madam and the Madam to the ancestral hall. If the Master is also present, invite him as well."

After saying this, she led Tingshuang straight to the ancestral hall in the back courtyard. Xie Pinji was thrown inside and knelt, pale-faced, before the ancestral tablets of the Xie family.

Soon, footsteps approached, and the members of the Xie family entered one by one.

"Chu'er, why have you gathered everyone to the ancestral hall?" The Old Madam entered and, seeing Xie Pinji kneeling on the ground, frowned. "What has Pinji done wrong?"

Yuan Shi spoke up, "Why is Pinji crying like this? What exactly happened?"

Xie Jingyu also arrived, his eyes filled with confusion.

Yun Chu spoke, "Xie Pinji, tell us yourself what happened. Explain clearly to the ancestors of the Xie family."

"I... I followed my mother to Qingshan Temple to pray. Hearing that the Western Prince, Anjing Wang, was staying at Qingshan Temple, I found a way to meet him..." Xie Pinji knelt on the ground, her voice hoarse. "Anjing Wang and I got along very well, so in the side room..."

She couldn't continue.

But everyone present understood.

"You... you have too much audacity!" The Old Madam was so shocked she nearly lost her balance. "You haven't even come of age, how dare you do such a thing!"

Yuan Shi felt dizzy, "Did you and Anjing Wang actually..."

Xie Jingyu raised his hand and slapped Xie Pinji hard across the face, "How could I have given birth to such a shameless creature!"

Xie Pinji was slapped until she was dizzy and remained on the ground for a long time, unable to get up.

"Master, now that things have come to this, even if you beat Eldest Miss to death, it won't change anything," He Shi said urgently. "Eldest Miss is at fault, but isn't Anjing Wang also to blame?"

The Old Madam was enlightened, "Pinji is not even fifteen years old. Anjing Wang dared to do such a thing. No matter what, it's his fault. Our Xie family cannot suffer this injustice in silence."

Yuan Shi was so anxious she paced in circles, "Our Xie family is of such low status. What can we use to confront Anjing Wang? What should we do? How can this be resolved?"

Xie Jingyu turned to Yun Chu, "Madam, what does Anjing Wang think about this?"

"Anjing Wang is willing to take Pinji as a concubine," Yun Chu said. "What do you think, husband?"

The Old Madam sighed in relief. As long as Anjing Wang was willing to take responsibility, it was fine. Otherwise, Pinji would have lost her chastity and no one would want her, which would be a thorny issue.

Xie Jingyu's expression was not good. A concubine was not even as good as a mistress in an ordinary family. It was equivalent to a maid who only warmed the bed. After all, she was a daughter of an official family. To be reduced to warming a man's bed was a disgrace to the Xie family's reputation.

Yun Chu continued, "However, when I suggested reporting to the Ministry of Justice, Anjing Wang relented and promised Pinji the position of a secondary consort."

"What? Secondary consort?" The Old Madam's eyes showed disbelief. "I heard that the Second Prince's secondary consort is the legitimate second daughter of the Third Rank Guanglu Temple Minister's family. If Pinji can become a secondary consort in Anjing Wang's household, it would be a great honor for our Xie family ancestors."

"But Mother refused!" Xie Pinji cried loudly. "Mother did not agree to me being Anjing Wang's secondary consort. The negotiations fell through, and Anjing Wang was angered. My life is ruined..."

She had calculated everything but had not expected her mother to refuse.

Her life was going to be destroyed by her mother's hands.

"Madam, is what Pinji said true?" Seeing Yun Chu nod, Xie Jingyu pursed his lips. "Madam, do you really want to report to the Ministry of Justice?"

"No, no, we cannot report it." Yuan Shi shook her head like a rattle drum. "If the matter becomes public, Pinji's reputation will be ruined, and our Xie family will become the biggest joke in the capital. Chu'er, we cannot go to the Ministry of Justice!"

The Old Madam, leaning on her cane, said sternly, "Chu'er, you are the mistress of our Xie family. No matter what you do, you should always put the Xie family's reputation first. You must go see Anjing Wang now and say that we agree to let Pinji be the secondary consort. Jingyu, you will accompany Chu'er!"

"Then I must say something ugly first." Yun Chu said calmly, "Pinji schemed against Anjing Wang. Anjing Wang might not understand it for a while, but De Fei, who has been in the imperial harem for so many years, would certainly see through it. Once Pinji becomes a secondary consort, she will be like a fish on a chopping board. She will have to endure Anjing Wang's coldness, De Fei's difficulties, and the future Wang Fei's torment. She is only thirteen years old. Will she spend the rest of her life aging in Anjing Wang's household?"

Xie Pinji couldn't help but shiver.

Yes, even her mother could see through her scheme. How could De Fei not see it?

She dared to scheme against Anjing Wang. De Fei would probably flay her alive.

And in the future, if Anjing Wang's wife entered the household, she would certainly find ways to make her establish rules...

"You all only think about taking the opportunity to climb up to Anjing Wang's household but do not consider how Pinji will live in the future." Yun Chu shook her head. "The Xie family's reputation is important, but in my opinion, it is more important for Pinji to have a good life."

Xie Pinji couldn't help but have hot tears well up in her eyes again.

So, her mother refused to let her be a secondary consort because she was afraid that she would be bullied in Anjing Wang's household. She truly considered her as a daughter and thought about these things.

The people in the ancestral hall fell silent. They indeed had not considered Pinji's future.

The Old Madam even thought that this was something Pinji had schemed for herself. No matter what kind of life she lived in the future, it was her own doing.

Of course, she only thought this briefly in her heart because once she said it out loud, it would distance her from Pinji...

"Eldest Sister now has only one path to take." Xie Shian walked into the ancestral hall. "Since she has already schemed against Anjing Wang, she can only go all the way and make Anjing Wang's household take the initiative to ask for Eldest Sister's hand as the official consort."

She had calculated so much, but it was only to become a secondary consort, subject to others' control. The Xie family would also be affected by Anjing Wang's anger.

But becoming a Wang Fei was different. A Wang Fei must be married by the Emperor's decree and is a legitimate member of the royal family. Even if it was a prince, he could not deliberately humiliate the Wang Fei. Even if Anjing Wang despised Eldest Sister, at any royal banquet, he would have to bring Eldest Sister along. The major and minor matters of Anjing Wang's household would also be handled by Eldest Sister.

As long as Eldest Sister found a way to bear Anjing Wang's eldest legitimate son, she would have no worries for the rest of her life.

Yun Chu looked at Xie Shian, "It seems An Ge understands my meaning."

Xie Pinji only then understood why, at Qingshan Temple, her mother had suggested making her the mistress of the prince's household. It turned out this was her only path.

Xie Jingyu spoke, "I will go to the Censorate now."

Going to the Censorate was not to file a complaint but to inform De Fei that the Xie family could have the censor impeach at any time...

Yun Chu nodded, "An Ge, you take the Xie family's carriage to the entrance of the Ministry of Justice and stay there for a night. I will go to the Yun family."

The Old Madam was worried, "Will this work?"

Would De Fei believe such a simple bluff?

She was afraid that if they completely angered Anjing Wang and De Fei, the good days of the Xie family would be over.

Xie Jingyu replied, "Whether it works or not, we can only try this first."

He thought that even if the matter became public, the Xie family would lose face, but in reality, the one most affected would still be Anjing Wang.

He suddenly felt a little fortunate that Pinji had not yet come of age...

---

chapters.title: Xie Pinji Becomes Wang Fei
chapters.content:
Xie Pinji knelt in the ancestral hall for an entire night.

Yun Chu did not allow anyone to send food, and not even a sip of water was given.

He Shi peeked through the small window into the ancestral hall and saw Xie Pinji kneeling weakly on the ground. She felt immense distress.

She gave most of the silver she had earned from embroidery in recent days to the gatekeeper and entered with a food box. She whispered, "Pinji, I'm here. You should eat something."

Xie Pinji raised her head, grabbed He Shi's hand, and asked urgently, "What's happening? Is there any news?"

He Shi advised, "The sky has just brightened. Even if there is news, it won't be this fast. You should eat something first. Don't ruin your health."

Xie Pinji couldn't eat at all. Her whole body was uncomfortable. The current discomfort was temporary, but she was afraid that this matter would not have a good outcome.

At this moment, the servant outside the door suddenly spoke, "Madam He, it seems there are guests at the residence. You should leave quickly!"

Xie Pinji's eyes lit up, "It must be someone sent by Anjing Wang. Madam He, you should go out and find out the news."

He Shi gave a few more instructions and immediately left the ancestral hall, heading to the front courtyard.

Indeed, guests had arrived in the front courtyard. It was a palace matron, Tang Mama, a confidante of De Fei, one of the Western Consorts.

Tang Mama greeted each member of the Xie family. She was a favorite of De Fei, and the Xie family members did not dare accept her greetings. They quickly offered her a seat and tea.

"Our Wang Ye was at Qingshan Temple to pray for the Crown Prince. During this time, he has been copying Buddhist scriptures every day, maintaining a pure mind and few desires. He would never do such absurd things." Tang Mama's voice carried a cold tone. "Last night, Master Xie went to the Censorate, and Young Master Xie led people to linger at the entrance of the Ministry of Justice all night. What is the meaning of this?"

In the Xie family, the Old Madam usually had the final say, but now, faced with the overbearing palace matron, she couldn't utter a single word.

Yun Chu smiled, "Madam Tang means that Anjing Wang did such a thing at the feet of Buddha, and the blame falls entirely on my daughter? Originally, our Xie family was considering whether to invite the Minister of Justice to uphold justice. Now it seems very necessary."

Tang Mama's expression stiffened.

She had intended to put on airs and intimidate the Xie family first, but she hadn't expected Madam Xie to completely disregard De Fei's face.

But thinking about it, she could understand. Madam Xie was the legitimate eldest daughter of the General's residence. General Yun commanded a large army, and with the Yun family backing her, she had no reason to fear a mere imperial consort.

Tang Mama took a white jade pendant from her sleeve and softened her tone, "This is a jade pendant that De Fei has carried for more than twenty years. She specifically asked me to bring it here to bestow upon Eldest Miss Xie. When the Crown Prince recovers, our Madam will have the Ministry of Rites arrange for Eldest Miss Xie to be taken as Anjing Wang's secondary consort."

The Old Madam Xie was overjoyed. It seemed the position of secondary consort was secured.

Although Pinji's life would be difficult in the future, at least the Xie family had connected with Anjing Wang's household, and Jingyu's current predicament would be resolved.

Xie Jingyu frowned.

Last night, he went to the Censorate, An Ge went to the Ministry of Justice, and Yun Chu visited the Yun family. They intended to use the influence of these three to pressure De Fei.

De Fei had made a concession, but at most, she could only offer the position of secondary consort.

In fact, he could understand De Fei's perspective. Given Pinji's status, she truly was not worthy of the position of Wang Fei.

"This jade pendant is too precious. Our Xie residence does not dare accept it." As he pondered, Yun Chu spoke up, "Could we trouble Madam Tang to ask De Fei to send an imperial physician to diagnose my daughter's pulse? Since returning to the residence yesterday, my daughter has refused food and water, attempted suicide multiple times, and now she is breathing more out than in..."

Tang Mama's expression turned ugly.

Madam Xie wanted to tell her that if De Fei could only offer the position of secondary consort, then Eldest Miss Xie would take her own life.

A lowly creature who seduced Anjing Wang was not worth mourning, but the Xie family thought differently. If Eldest Miss Xie died, the Xie family would likely make a huge fuss.

She stood up and took back the jade pendant, "Our Madam will certainly give the Xie residence an explanation. Please, Master Xie, do not spread this matter. I will return to the palace to report."

Tang Mama quickly left the Xie residence.

"Madam, this action will surely enrage De Fei." Xie Jingyu frowned. "De Fei dotes on Anjing Wang, who was born after two princesses. The Xie family has schemed against Anjing Wang and also covets the position of Wang Fei. De Fei will likely not let the Xie family off easily. Does Madam have another plan?"

The Xie family members all looked at Yun Chu.

Yun Chu said calmly, "Husband, you should pay more attention to court affairs. Currently, the Crown Prince is seriously ill, and the Emperor believes it is Anjing Wang's doing. Only by proactively marrying a woman of low status can the Emperor's suspicions be cleared. De Fei will not fail to understand this reasoning."

The Old Madam asked, "What if De Fei refuses?"

"Then it can only be said that De Fei is foolish and cannot see the situation clearly." Yun Chu sneered. "With such a foolish birth mother, Anjing Wang will not amount to much in the future. Pinji would be better off not marrying him."

With that said, the Old Madam did not dare ask any more questions. Asking more might make it seem like she was also foolish.

After Tang Mama left the Xie residence, she returned to the palace and reported the matter in detail to De Fei.

De Fei was so angry that she smashed all the cups.

"How can Lao Xi be so brainless!" she raged, her head pounding. "To be schemed against by a girl who hasn't even grown up properly, and in a place like a temple, and while the Emperor has punished him to reflect on his actions. It's not enough that he angers me to death; I'm afraid he'll anger the Emperor into exiling him to a remote, cold, and barren place. How can he endure such hardship!"

"Your Majesty, please calm down." Tang Mama lowered her head. "Looking at it from another angle, this might be a way to break the deadlock."

De Fei said in a deep voice, "What do you mean?"

"Currently, the Emperor suspects that Wang Ye is contending for the Crown Prince's position, which is why he was punished and sent to Qingshan Temple to pray." Tang Mama began to explain slowly, "Although our Wang Ye was framed, as long as the Emperor and the Empress believe this, they will not easily allow Wang Ye to leave Qingshan Temple. If Your Majesty takes the initiative to ask for Wang Ye to marry a woman of low status as his official Wang Fei, it would be equivalent to telling the Emperor that our Wang Ye has no intention of contending for the throne. Wang Ye would then naturally be allowed to return."

De Fei knew this reasoning, but she was still reluctant, "Even if it's a woman of low status, it cannot be that cheap creature!"

"Madam Xie of the Xie family is the legitimate eldest daughter of the Yun family. If she is determined to make this matter public, Wang Ye may never be able to return to the capital." Tang Mama advised, "Once that Eldest Miss Xie becomes Wang Fei, won't she still be at Your Majesty's mercy? You can find a suitable excuse later to depose her from the position of Wang Fei. It won't be difficult."

De Fei clenched her back teeth tightly.

If the Xie family made this matter public, a simple investigation would reveal the numerous noble women in Anjing Wang's rear courtyard. Anjing Wang would likely be drowned in spit by the common people.

Although they were not contending for the throne, they could not become a prince despised by the common people.

After much thought, it seemed there was only one path forward.

De Fei had no choice but to get up, change her clothes, and head to the Kunning Palace where the Empress resided.

chapters.title: Able to Conceive
chapters.content:
Xie Pin knelt in the ancestral hall for three days and three nights.

Only He Shi would secretly bring her some food, but she couldn’t eat anything and only forced herself to drink a little water. She was so weak that she was at her limit.

Finally, on the third day, someone from the palace arrived.

It was the Grand Eunuch by the Emperor’s side and the Minister of Rites, who came together to deliver the imperial decree.

"By the will of Heaven, the Emperor decrees: Xie Jingyu, the eldest daughter of the Ministry of Revenue’s Director Xie Jingyu, is virtuous, obedient, and kind. She is hereby bestowed the title of Princess Consort of Anjing, and a wedding date shall be chosen. May she cultivate her virtue, conduct herself properly, and serve the Emperor with diligence and caution..."

The Xie family knelt on the ground. Except for Yun Chu, everyone was overjoyed.

They truly never expected that the Emperor himself would issue a decree for the marriage, and that Pin would actually become the Princess Consort of Anjing.

"We accept the decree. We are deeply grateful for the Emperor’s grace. Long live the Emperor, long live the Emperor, long live the Emperor forever!"

Xie Jingyu raised both hands to receive the imperial decree, and the entire Xie family kowtowed in gratitude.

The Grand Eunuch smiled and said, "Congratulations, Minister Xie. The Emperor originally intended to arrange the marriage after Miss Xie’s coming-of-age ceremony, but Her Grace, the Virtuous Consort, believes that Prince Anjing is young and inexperienced and needs a capable wife to manage the affairs of the prince’s residence. After discussing with Her Majesty the Empress, they decided to set the wedding in three months, after Miss Xie’s coming-of-age ceremony, and the marriage will be consummated then."

Old Madam Xie couldn’t stop smiling and quickly ordered the maids to bring red envelopes. Everyone who came to deliver the decree received at least twenty taels of silver.

After the messengers left, Old Madam Xie sincerely said, "Chu’er, it’s all thanks to you. Otherwise, such a good thing wouldn’t have fallen upon our Xie family."

Yuan Shi held Yun Chu’s hand. "Only you truly have the children’s best interests at heart. For Pin to have a mother like you is a blessing from her past life."

"Madam, you’ve worked hard." Xie Jingyu looked steadily at Yun Chu. "Though you are a woman, you are in no way inferior to a man."

Every step she took was calculated so precisely that if she were a man serving as an official, with such foresight and planning, she might soon rise to the top of the imperial court.

Yun Chu smiled slightly.

All her schemes were based on the foundation of living a second life. Because she had experienced her past life, she knew what kind of person the Virtuous Consort was, what Prince Anjing’s temperament was like, how perilous the struggle for the throne was, and how events would develop... So, she could effortlessly plan many things.

Xie Pin knelt on the ground, weeping with joy.

She had once only hoped for the position of a concubine, but in the end, she became a legitimate princess consort. This joy was indescribable.

She supported herself with the maid’s help and stood up weakly, then walked to Yun Chu and slowly knelt down. "Mother, it was I who did wrong and brought shame to the Xie family. Mother punished me by making me kneel in the ancestral hall, but I harbored resentment in my heart. Only now do I realize that it was Mother who worked so hard to plan and pave the way for me. I am endlessly grateful. No matter what happens in the future, I will always honor and respect Mother, and I will never let Mother regret planning for me."

Yun Chu twitched the corner of her lips.

In her past life, when Xie Pin had tried to scheme against Prince Anjing, she had stopped her in advance, which caused Xie Pin to resent her for a long time.

The sincerity she had once shown had been trampled under Xie Pin’s feet.

Now, she feigned concern for Xie Pin, only to receive Xie Pin’s genuine gratitude in return.

She found it utterly ironic.

She reached out and helped Xie Pin up. "The Virtuous Consort and Prince Anjing will certainly not be willing. Remember to be cautious in your words and actions. Do not let others find fault with you, or else your position as princess consort will not be secure. Do you understand?"

Xie Pin nodded. "Yes, Mother."

He Shi, standing to the side, felt a pang of sadness.

She had carried her daughter for ten months and knew her best. In the past, when Pin called her "Madam" and "Mother," it was out of necessity, but now, this address came from the heart.

Because Madam had planned for Pin, Pin truly acknowledged Madam as her mother.

In Pin’s heart, Madam’s position had certainly surpassed her, the biological mother...

She suppressed her emotions and spoke up. "Eldest Miss is going to marry into the Prince Anjing’s residence as the princess consort. The dowry might be a bit difficult to prepare..."

Old Madam Xie immediately realized. Yes, how could a princess consort have no dowry? Ten li of red dowry might be too much to ask, but at least a hundred and twenty sedan chairs should be prepared...

Where could the entire Xie family come up with so much for the dowry?

They could only rely on their daughter-in-law.

As the mother of Pin, it was only right for the daughter-in-law to prepare the dowry for her.

She was about to speak when Yun Chu said, "The Xie family is a fifth-rank official family. It is natural that we cannot afford the dowry befitting a princess consort. There is no need to put on airs. Pin, Mother will only tell you one thing: a person does not rely on their family or money to stand firm, but on their own intelligence and wisdom. If you want to establish yourself in the Prince Anjing’s residence, think carefully before doing anything."

Xie Pin engraved these words in her heart. "Pin will remember Mother’s teachings."

"As for the dowry..." Yun Chu said calmly, looking at Xie Jingyu, "Although we don’t need to put on airs, we still need to have what is necessary. Husband, you will have to figure this out."

Xie Jingyu’s lips parted slightly. He wanted to say that the dowry should be handled by the mistress of the household.

But thinking that the reason Pin could become the Princess Consort of Anjing was all due to Yun Chu’s planning, he couldn’t possibly leave everything to Yun Chu.

He had no choice but to agree. "Madam, rest assured. I will handle this matter."

Yun Chu lowered her head to drink tea, hiding the sarcasm in her eyes.

Xie Jingyu was a man who liked to network in the official circles. From time to time, he would send gifts to his superiors, and at the same time, he would accept gifts from lower-ranking officials of the sixth and seventh ranks.

After today, everyone below would know that the Xie family had connected with the Prince Anjing’s residence. They would probably come one after another to send gifts.

Occasionally accepting gifts was not a big deal, but Xie Jingyu was short on money now and would certainly not refuse any.

If he accepted too many, it would only be a matter of time before trouble arose.

The next day, Madam Lin came to the Xie residence to offer her congratulations.

Old Madam Xie, who had always felt inferior in front of the Yun family, finally had a reason to hold her head high. Even her speech carried a lot of confidence.

"Madam Yun, in the future, when you attend any banquets, you can bring our Pin along." The old madam said with a smile. "Pin will become the Princess Consort of Anjing. She will inevitably need to get to know the ladies of the noble families. Getting to know them in advance will save a lot of trouble."

Madam Lin casually replied, "Naturally."

After finishing her conversation with Old Madam Xie, Yun Chu took Madam Lin to her own Shengju Chamber.

"Young Lady Pin is still so young. How come her marriage is decided so early?" Madam Lin sensed something unusual. "The Virtuous Consort dotes on Prince Anjing the most. How could she suddenly allow the daughter of a fifth-rank official to become the princess consort? Did something happen?"

Yun Chu knew that anyone would question this matter.

She calmly recounted the events that had taken place at Qing’an Temple.

"He, he actually had the audacity!" Madam Lin was stunned. "Although the marriage is set, the Virtuous Consort will definitely not let this go easily. Pin will have a hard time in the future."

Originally, she had prepared a shop as part of Pin’s dowry, but now it seemed completely unnecessary.

A granddaughter with such schemes, who completely disregarded the family’s reputation, made the Yun family hesitate to acknowledge her. They felt that taking her out would be embarrassing...

"Alright, let’s not talk about this anymore." Madam Lin shook her head. "Divine Physician Si is going out of the palace to collect herbs. Her Majesty the Empress ordered Divine Physician Si to take the opportunity to diagnose your pulse. Let’s go. Mother will go with you."

---

chapters.title: Mama Teaches the Rules
chapters.content:
Yun Chu had long heard of Divine Physician Si.

He had become famous in his early thirties. He had served as an imperial physician in the palace for a few years but yearned for a life of leisure, so at the age of forty, he resigned and traveled around.

He returned to the capital roughly every three to five years to diagnose members of the royal family. Of course, he would also take this opportunity to earn some extra money. He usually stayed in the capital for about half a month.

Yun Chu followed Madam Lin into the pharmacy where Divine Physician Si was temporarily seeing patients.

Everyone knew the divine physician’s name, but few knew that he was consulting here. The place was very quiet inside.

"You must be Madam Xie." Divine Physician Si stroked his beard and looked at Yun Chu. "Judging by Madam Xie’s appearance, you do not seem like someone who cannot bear children. Let me take your pulse to confirm."

After saying this, he gestured for Yun Chu to sit down and expose her wrist.

Yun Chu curtsied slightly. "Thank you for your trouble, Divine Physician Si. However, it is not for me, but for someone else."

As soon as she said this, Madam Lin’s expression changed abruptly. "Chu’er, what nonsense are you spouting? Do you know how busy Divine Physician Si is? Do you know how difficult it is to get him to diagnose someone?"

"Mother, please don’t be angry." Yun Chu said softly. "I have never thought of having another child. Why bother the divine physician with a meaningless task?"

She gave Tingshuang a look. Tingshuang turned and went out, leading someone inside.

Madam Lin looked over and saw a person dressed in a black cloak and a black veil hat. It was impossible to tell whether they were male or female.

The person seemed uneasy after entering. Only when Yun Chu spoke did they look up. "Young Master Wu, come over here. Remove your hat and let Divine Physician Si examine you."

Young Master Wu stepped forward and extended his hand. Madam Lin saw the hand and was so frightened that she quickly stepped back. What kind of hand was that? The skin was black, the veins were bulging, and it was covered in round, fleshy lumps. The largest lump was as big as a baby’s fist, oozing pus...

When the veil hat was removed, Madam Lin was so scared that she almost fainted and didn’t dare to look.

"This..." Divine Physician Si’s gaze tightened as he placed his index finger on Young Master Wu’s pulse. "You, you are from the Wu family!"

Young Master Wu’s eyes showed disbelief. "Does the divine physician know the Wu family?"

Divine Physician Si nodded. "More than ten years ago, the Wu family sought my master’s help to treat a unique hereditary disease. Unfortunately, at that time, my master’s abilities were limited. He only prescribed a few medicines to control the symptoms before leaving the Wu family. But over the years, my master never stopped researching this disease. He passed all his research findings to me, and I have improved upon his work to develop a treatment method... But more than twenty years ago, when I went to the Wu family, I received unfortunate news that all the Wu family members had died."

Tears welled up in Young Master Wu’s eyes. "The entire Wu family... only I have survived until today..."

Neither human nor ghost, he had lived for more than twenty years.

If it weren’t for his mother insisting that he live, he would have taken his own life long ago.

"I have found a breakthrough for your Wu family’s disease." Divine Physician Si said, "But I thought the Wu family was extinct. The medical records for treating this disease are kept in my old residence in Qingzhou. After I finish treating Her Majesty the Empress, you can come with me to Qingzhou."

Hope appeared in Young Master Wu’s deadened eyes. "Thank you, Divine Physician!"

He immediately knelt and kowtowed.

Divine Physician Si helped him up. "This disease is not easy to cure. After going to Qingzhou, you will need to stay there for at least five to ten years for treatment. If you have any unfinished business, settle it as soon as possible, then come with me."

Young Master Wu quickly nodded and withdrew.

Yun Chu took a box from Tingshuang’s hands and handed it to Divine Physician Si. "This is the consultation fee for treating Young Master Wu."

The diagnosis fee was five thousand taels of silver. She had also prepared ten thousand taels for the treatment. Since she had obtained the Wu family’s ancestral hot spring, she had a responsibility to take care of Young Master Wu to the end.

Unexpectedly, Divine Physician Si waved his hand. "More than ten years ago, my master already accepted the Wu family’s consultation fee. I will not accept it a second time. Also, I have my own reasons. If I can cure Young Master Wu, then when I meet my master in the afterlife, I can hold my head high before him."

Divine Physician Si insisted on not accepting the money, and Yun Chu had no choice.

Fortunately, Young Master Wu’s illness could be treated, which was better than anything else.

After resolving Young Master Wu’s matter, Yun Chu asked to take her leave.

Divine Physician Si spoke up. "I am here under Her Majesty the Empress’s order to diagnose Madam Xie. Does Madam Xie intend to have me defy the Empress’s decree?"

Madam Lin pressed down on Yun Chu’s shoulder, forcing her to sit, then rolled up her sleeve to let the divine physician take her pulse.

Divine Physician Si placed his index finger on Yun Chu’s pulse and said, "There is some uterine coldness, but it is not serious. Although there is blood stasis, after regulation, it should not be difficult to conceive... Madam Xie and Minister Xie, have you not shared a bed in the past year?"

Yun Chu’s expression stiffened.

Could the divine physician even tell that?

Divine Physician Si withdrew his hand and picked up a brush, quickly writing a prescription. "Follow this prescription to get the medicine. Persist with the treatment for three months, and the uterine coldness can be completely cured. Then, increase the frequency of marital relations, and you should be able to conceive."

Madam Lin took the prescription as if it were a treasure and tucked it into her sleeve. Then she took out a large stack of silver notes from her sleeve and handed them over.

This time, Divine Physician Si did not refuse. He took the silver notes and casually tucked them into his medicine box.

After leaving the pharmacy, Madam Lin sighed. "Back then, I don’t know how many doctors we saw. They all said your infertility was incurable and that you would never be able to conceive... In reality, it was never your problem. Those quacks simply didn’t have the skill. Look, the divine physician has only just examined you and already knows why he is called a divine physician. From now on, you will be able to have your own child."

Yun Chu’s expression remained blank.

The mother and daughter got into the carriage one after another. After they were inside, Madam Lin finally asked, "Has Jingyu not visited your room for a whole year?"

Yun Chu didn’t want to answer this question at all. She changed the subject. "Is the dowry for Sister Ran ready?"

"Chu’er!" Madam Lin raised her voice. "Tell me, is what the divine physician said true?"

"Mother, why do you need to know these things?" Yun Chu pinched the space between her eyebrows. "Husband and I live in harmony, with children and daughters. Our days are very comfortable. Mother need not worry about me."

Madam Lin’s breath hitched.

The more she said their days were comfortable, the less likely it was that they actually were.

She didn’t dare to think about why Chu’er would not want a child of her own.

Did Chu’er not like children? No, Chu’er treated the illegitimate children as if they were her own. She couldn’t possibly dislike children.

That left only one possibility: Xie Jingyu was unwilling to have a legitimate child with Chu’er.

"Alright, I won’t ask anymore." Madam Lin lifted the carriage curtain and looked outside. "Look, that silk shop over there is the dowry I prepared for Sister Ran. Do you want to go take a look and pick out a few bolts of fabric to make some clothes?"

Yun Chu was about to speak when she saw a palace carriage pass by their own.

She recognized it as a palace carriage.

Madam Lin took a glance and said, "It seems Yin Pin has arranged for someone to invite the second miss of the Tan family into the palace. It appears to be for the Prince of Pingxi to choose his future princess consort."

chapters.title: Consort De's Rage
chapters.content:
Yun Chu recalled that in her previous life, the Prince of Pingxi had not married by the age of ten.

She had never heard of Concubine Yin being considered as a potential princess consort for the Prince of Pingxi.

Of course, it was also possible that in her previous life, she rarely left the Xie family's residence, so naturally, she was unaware of such royal matters.

Unconsciously, she thought of the two children at the Prince of Pingxi's residence.

Although she had seen them not long ago, it felt as if it had been a very long time, and a wave of longing surged within her.

She didn’t understand why she missed these two children so much, as if there had been some kind of bond between them in her previous life...

When Yun Chu returned to the Xie family, Chen Defu happened to come to deliver the account books.

The ice shop had been open for more than half a month, and the accounts showed that it had already earned nearly 70,000 taels of silver.

As the temperature continued to rise in June, the price of ice would increase further, and profits would only grow.

"Madam, the Summer Retreat Courtyard has been arranged," Chen Defu said with a bow. "It can open its doors to the common people tomorrow. Does Madam have any further instructions?"

The Summer Retreat Courtyard was a place Yun Chu had previously proposed to provide free relief from the summer heat for the common people. Under the Xie family's name, every afternoon at the hottest time, the courtyard would be filled with ice blocks on the west side, allowing those who couldn’t afford ice to dispel some of the summer heat.

After a moment of thought, Yun Chu said, "Prepare some cool tea to be placed in the courtyard as well. Those in need can take it themselves."

Chen Defu nodded and went to carry out the task.

These days, business at the ice shop had been exceptionally good, earning a fortune every day was no exaggeration.

Fortunately, she had anticipated this and opened several more ice shops in advance, dispersing the customer base. Otherwise, it would have attracted too much envy.

At the same time, Xie Jingyu gradually began to get busy.

Previously, because he had offended the Marquis of Xuanwu, many of his official duties had been taken away by Director Yu.

Now, he had suddenly become the future father-in-law of Prince Anjing. Between Prince Anjing and the Marquis of Xuanwu, there was no need to choose, more and more people came to flatter him.

The dark cloud that had loomed over the Xie family seemed to have dissipated just like that.

Although the old madam disliked Yun Chu, she couldn’t help but admire her daughter-in-law from the bottom of her heart. If it weren’t for Yun Chu’s foresight, how could the Xie family have suddenly become royal relatives?

Once Ping sister officially became the princess consort, the entire Xie family would rise to another level. They would no longer be the small, insignificant family they once were, subject to others’ whims.

Yun Chu received some invitation cards from other madams, but she declined them all under the pretext of being busy with wedding preparations.

While she was busy looking at the account books, she saw Tingshuang hurriedly enter from the doorway: "Madam, someone from the palace has arrived."

It turned out that Consort De had sent a Foster Mother Fu to teach Xie Pin some palace rules.

A smile appeared on Xie Pin’s face. Consort De’s actions showed that she had accepted her as a future daughter-in-law. She would not disappoint Consort De.

She respectfully greeted the arriving Foster Mother Fu: "In the future, I will trouble Foster Mother Fu."

"An old servant like me is unworthy of such a greeting from the young mistress," Foster Mother Fu avoided her bow and raised her eyes. "Miss Xie’s posture in this greeting is incorrect. If you enter the palace and use this manner to greet the Empress and the Emperor, you will surely be punished."

Yun Chu interjected: "Ordinary families rarely have the chance to enter the palace. I have also neglected to teach Ping sister these things. I beg Foster Mother Fu to instruct her carefully. It would be a minor matter if our Xie family were punished, but we fear implicating Consort De and Prince Anjing."

Foster Mother Fu lowered her gaze: "Madam Xie, rest assured. This old servant has come to the Xie family precisely to teach the future Princess Consort Anjing these etiquettes. If Miss Xie does not learn them in a day, this old servant will stay at the Xie residence for a day."

Yun Chu nodded and had someone arrange accommodations for Foster Mother Fu, in the east side room of Xie Pin’s courtyard.

In her mind, she calculated that the wedding was in three months. Xie Pin would be the Princess Consort Anjing for about half a month, so her hard-earned etiquette lessons wouldn’t be in vain.

Xie Pin was indeed suffering.

She had thought learning palace etiquette would be like studying, but who knew it would be so grueling.

Early in the morning, Foster Mother Fu made her stand in a pavilion with a book balanced on her head and a tray in each hand, standing for a full hour.

After that came walking lessons. Walking seemed simple, but Foster Mother Fu made her clamp a fruit between her legs. While walking, the fruit must not fall or be crushed. If she made a mistake, she had to start over. Only when her skirt showed not the slightest sway did Foster Mother Fu reluctantly express satisfaction.

During this process, Foster Mother Fu frequently struck her with a ruler.

Her arms were red from the strikes, and she didn’t even dare to touch them, continuing to practice walking on an empty stomach.

After a day of training, Foster Mother Fu placed a bowl of dark, foul-smelling medicine in front of Xie Pin: "Miss Xie, drink this medicine."

Xie Pin wrinkled her nose at the nauseating smell: "What is this?"

"A miscarriage drug," Foster Mother Fu coldly replied. "A woman can conceive seven days after intimacy. Drinking this will ensure Miss Xie does not become pregnant."

In the Prince Anjing’s residence, any woman who shared the prince’s bed would be given a contraceptive decoction the next morning.

It had been delayed for so many days, so only a miscarriage drug would work now.

Xie Pin’s face stiffened.

She and Prince Anjing had not gone that far. She couldn’t possibly be pregnant.

"Miss Xie and Prince Anjing are not yet married. If you were to become pregnant before the wedding, wouldn’t that bring shame upon our prince?" Foster Mother Fu said coldly. "Moreover, Miss Xie has not yet come of age. It is not suitable for her to bear a child. Drink it."

Xie Pin bit her lip: "Foster Mother, rest assured. I will not cause such a scandal."

She knew that both contraceptive decoctions and miscarriage drugs could greatly harm a woman’s body. She feared she might end up like her mother, unable to conceive again. She couldn’t drink this.

Foster Mother Fu stared at her coldly. Seeing that she had no intention of drinking the medicine, she stepped forward and pinched Xie Pin’s chin.

"Forgive this old servant."

A bowl of dark medicine was poured down Xie Pin’s throat. She choked and coughed, clutching her throat: "Foster... Foster Mother, you are teaching me etiquette. How can you be so discourteous yourself? I... I am the future Princess Consort Anjing. How dare you be so rude!"

"You are still Miss Xie of the Xie family," Foster Mother Fu took a step back. "When Miss Xie becomes Princess Consort Anjing, this old servant will be at your mercy."

Xie Pin coughed until tears streamed down her face.

This was still at the Xie family residence, and a servant dared to force her to do something against her will.

When she married into the Prince Anjing’s residence and entered Consort De’s domain, would she even have a voice?

Would every servant dare to bully her?

Xie Pin bit her lower lip, went into the inner room, and tried to stick her fingers down her throat, desperately trying to vomit up the medicine.

But it was all in vain.

The events in Xie Pin’s courtyard naturally reached Yun Chu’s ears.

She shook her head: "This is only the beginning."

Being bullied by a foster mother was nothing. The real disaster would come after she married into the Prince Anjing’s residence, when Prince Anjing himself turned against her.

As she pondered, she looked up and saw Xie Jingyu enter Shengju Hall.

Dressed in a light moon-white robe, his scholarly demeanor was evident. His long strides showed that he was in a very good mood.
